-- ActivityConfig (2026-10-02, Claude): timed events, daily rewards, quests and achievements.
-- Shared by ServerScriptService.ActivityService / BoostService (server) and StarterGui.RNGGui.ActivityClient.
-- Promo codes are NOT here (clients can read ReplicatedStorage); they live in ServerScriptService.ActivityService.
local A = {}

-- BOOSTS: personal timed boosts. Getting a boost you already have adds time (up to MaxBoostSeconds).
-- Personal boosts don't multiply each other (the best Snow and best Luck count), but they DO multiply with events.
-- Timers only run while the player is in the game.
A.MaxBoostSeconds = 3600
A.Boosts = {
	Snow2 = {Name = "2x Snow", Icon = "❄️", Snow = 2, Luck = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 255)},
	Luck2 = {Name = "2x Luck", Icon = "🍀", Snow = 1, Luck = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 225, 120)},
	Super = {Name = "Super Boost", Icon = "⭐", Snow = 2, Luck = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60)},
}
A.BoostOrder = {"Super", "Snow2", "Luck2"}

-- EVENTS: server-wide, one at a time, picked at random by Weight.
A.EventGap = {600, 900}        -- seconds between events
A.FirstEventDelay = {90, 180}  -- after a server starts
A.Events = {
	{Id = "Snowstorm", Name = "SNOWSTORM", Text = "2x Snow for everyone!", Icon = "🌨️", Snow = 2, Luck = 1, Duration = 180, Weight = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 190, 255), Effect = "Snow"},
	{Id = "LuckyWind", Name = "LUCKY WIND", Text = "2x Luck for everyone!", Icon = "🍀", Snow = 1, Luck = 2, Duration = 180, Weight = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 110), Effect = "Sparkle"},
	{Id = "Aurora", Name = "AURORA NIGHT", Text = "2x Snow AND 2x Luck!", Icon = "🌌", Snow = 2, Luck = 2, Duration = 120, Weight = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 110, 255), Effect = "Both"},
}

-- DAILY REWARDS: one claim per day (20 h cooldown), 7-day streak; missing 48 h restarts at day 1.
-- SnowMinutes = Snow worth that many minutes of the player's recent digging (so it fits every stage).
A.DailyCooldown = 20 * 3600
A.DailyStreakReset = 48 * 3600
A.Daily = {
	{Boost = "Snow2", Seconds = 600},
	{Boost = "Luck2", Seconds = 600},
	{SnowMinutes = 5},
	{Boost = "Snow2", Seconds = 1200},
	{Boost = "Luck2", Seconds = 1200},
	{SnowMinutes = 10},
	{Boost = "Super", Seconds = 1800},
}

-- QUESTS: QuestSlots at a time, each with one reward from QuestRewards (one of each per set).
-- When the whole set is claimed, the next set arrives after QuestRefresh seconds.
A.QuestSlots = 3
A.QuestRefresh = 30 * 60
A.Quests = {
	{Id = "Roll", Text = "Roll %s times", Stat = "Rolls", Amounts = {25, 40, 60}},
	{Id = "Dig", Text = "Dig %s snow", Stat = "SnowEarned", Minutes = {3, 4, 5}}, -- goal = minutes of recent digging
	{Id = "Hatch", Text = "Hatch %s pets", Stat = "Hatches", Amounts = {3, 5, 8}},
	{Id = "Treasure", Text = "Find %s buried treasures", Stat = "Treasures", Amounts = {1, 2, 3}},
}
A.QuestRewards = {
	{Boost = "Snow2", Seconds = 300},
	{Boost = "Luck2", Seconds = 300},
	{SnowMinutes = 2},
}

-- ACHIEVEMENTS: unlock automatically and give a PERMANENT bonus (Snow/Luck = +fraction, added together).
A.Achievements = {
	{Id = "Rolls1", Name = "First Spins", Text = "Roll 100 times", Stat = "Rolls", Goal = 100, Luck = 0.02},
	{Id = "Rolls2", Name = "Dice Fan", Text = "Roll 1,000 times", Stat = "Rolls", Goal = 1000, Luck = 0.03},
	{Id = "Rolls3", Name = "Dice Master", Text = "Roll 5,000 times", Stat = "Rolls", Goal = 5000, Luck = 0.05},
	{Id = "Snow1", Name = "Snow Collector", Text = "Dig 100K snow", Stat = "SnowEarned", Goal = 1e5, Snow = 0.02},
	{Id = "Snow2", Name = "Snow Hoarder", Text = "Dig 1B snow", Stat = "SnowEarned", Goal = 1e9, Snow = 0.03},
	{Id = "Snow3", Name = "Avalanche Maker", Text = "Dig 1T snow", Stat = "SnowEarned", Goal = 1e12, Snow = 0.05},
	{Id = "Hatch1", Name = "Pet Friend", Text = "Hatch 10 pets", Stat = "Hatches", Goal = 10, Snow = 0.02},
	{Id = "Hatch2", Name = "Pet Keeper", Text = "Hatch 100 pets", Stat = "Hatches", Goal = 100, Snow = 0.03},
	{Id = "Treasure1", Name = "Lucky Digger", Text = "Find 10 treasures", Stat = "Treasures", Goal = 10, Snow = 0.02},
	{Id = "Treasure2", Name = "Treasure Hunter", Text = "Find 100 treasures", Stat = "Treasures", Goal = 100, Snow = 0.03},
	{Id = "Shovels1", Name = "Shovel Spotter", Text = "Discover 10 shovels", Stat = "ShovelsFound", Goal = 10, Luck = 0.02},
	{Id = "Shovels2", Name = "Shovel Expert", Text = "Discover 20 shovels", Stat = "ShovelsFound", Goal = 20, Luck = 0.03},
	{Id = "Pets1", Name = "Pet Spotter", Text = "Discover 10 pets", Stat = "PetsFound", Goal = 10, Snow = 0.02},
	{Id = "Pets2", Name = "Pet Expert", Text = "Discover 25 pets", Stat = "PetsFound", Goal = 25, Snow = 0.03},
	{Id = "Rebirth1", Name = "Fresh Start", Text = "Rebirth once", Stat = "Rebirths", Goal = 1, Snow = 0.02},
	{Id = "Rebirth2", Name = "Reborn", Text = "Rebirth 5 times", Stat = "Rebirths", Goal = 5, Snow = 0.03},
	{Id = "World2", Name = "World Traveler", Text = "Reach World 2", Stat = "World2", Goal = 1, Snow = 0.05, Luck = 0.05},
	{Id = "Quests1", Name = "Helper", Text = "Complete 10 quests", Stat = "QuestsDone", Goal = 10, Luck = 0.02},
	{Id = "Quests2", Name = "Hero of Frostfall", Text = "Complete 50 quests", Stat = "QuestsDone", Goal = 50, Luck = 0.03},
}

-- lookups
A.AchievementById, A.EventById, A.QuestById = {}, {}, {}
for i, a in ipairs(A.Achievements) do a.Order = i; A.AchievementById[a.Id] = a end
for _, e in ipairs(A.Events) do A.EventById[e.Id] = e end
for _, q in ipairs(A.Quests) do A.QuestById[q.Id] = q end

-- "❄️ 2x Snow for 5 min" (SnowMinutes rewards are turned into an amount by the server)
function A.RewardText(r)
	if r.Boost then
		local b = A.Boosts[r.Boost]
		return string.format("%s %s for %d min", b.Icon, b.Name, math.floor(r.Seconds / 60 + 0.5))
	elseif r.SnowMinutes then
		return string.format("❄️ %d min of Snow", r.SnowMinutes)
	end
	return "?"
end

-- "+2% Snow  +5% Luck"
function A.BonusText(a)
	local t = {}
	if a.Snow then table.insert(t, string.format("+%d%% Snow", math.floor(a.Snow * 100 + 0.5))) end
	if a.Luck then table.insert(t, string.format("+%d%% Luck", math.floor(a.Luck * 100 + 0.5))) end
	return table.concat(t, "  ")
end

return A

-- BALANCE: core scaling formulas (tweak exponents to make progression faster/slower).
local Balance = {}

-- shovel damage per hit, from its odds (1 in N). Set Power on a shovel in RNGConfig to override.
--   1 in 2 -> 1   | 1 in 1K -> 77 | 1 in 1M -> 6K | 1 in 1B -> 467K | 1 in 100B -> 8.5M
-- 2026-10-01: raised 0.42 -> 0.63 when shovel luck was removed, so shovel power over play time stays close to before.
Balance.PowerExponent = 0.63
function Balance.ShovelPower(chance)
	return math.max(1, math.floor(chance ^ Balance.PowerExponent))
end

-- Shovels no longer give luck (2026-10-01): luck comes from upgrade tiles (+%), rebirths and friends.
-- Kept as a neutral x1 so any older caller still works.
function Balance.ShovelLuck(_chance)
	return 1
end

return Balance

-- Four collectible toy eggs. Shared by the world stands and hatch animation.
local M={}
local V,C=Vector3.new,Color3.fromRGB
local themes={
 SnowyEgg={C(219,243,255),C(72,181,241),C(255,255,255)},
 DesertEgg={C(255,211,130),C(214,143,61),C(57,199,190)},
 CursedEgg={C(55,36,87),C(144,78,213),C(235,117,255)},
 CrystalEgg={C(119,204,242),C(72,136,207),C(206,248,255)},
}
local function p(m,n,size,cf,col,shape,mat)
 local a=Instance.new("Part"); a.Name=n; a.Size=size; a.CFrame=cf; a.Color=col
 a.Shape=shape == Enum.PartType.Ball and Enum.PartType.Block or (shape or Enum.PartType.Block)
 if shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;mesh.Parent=a end
 a.Material=mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 a.Anchored=true; a.CanCollide=false; a.CanTouch=false; a.CanQuery=false; a.CastShadow=true
 a.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; a.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; a.Parent=m
 return a
end
local function ball(m,n,size,pos,col) return p(m,n,size,CFrame.new(pos),col,Enum.PartType.Ball) end
local function line(m,n,a,b,r,col,mat)
 return p(m,n,V((b-a).Magnitude,r*2,r*2),CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0),col,Enum.PartType.Cylinder,mat)
end
local function gem(m,n,pos,size,col)
 return p(m,n,V(size*.7,size,size*.7),CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/4,math.pi/4),col)
end
function M.create(id)
 local t=themes[id] or themes.SnowyEgg
 local m=Instance.new("Model"); m.Name=id
 -- A single smooth shell keeps the surface clean at every viewing angle.
 ball(m,"Shell",V(4.25,5.4,4.25),V(0,0,0),t[1])
 -- A little collar makes each egg read as a collectible on its existing pedestal.
 p(m,"Collar",V(.25,3.55,3.55),CFrame.new(0,-2.28,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),t[2],Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
 if id=="SnowyEgg" then
  -- Bold, readable six-armed snowflake emblem.
  ball(m,"FrostBadge",V(1.95,1.95,.18),V(0,.05,-2.04),t[2])
  local center=V(0,.05,-2.18)
  for i=0,5 do
   local a=i*math.pi/3; local dir=V(math.sin(a),math.cos(a),0)
   line(m,"Snowflake",center,center+dir*.75,.07,t[3])
   for s=-1,1,2 do
    local side=V(math.cos(a),-math.sin(a),0)*s
    line(m,"SnowflakeTip",center+dir*.48,center+dir*.33+side*.19,.045,t[3])
   end
  end
  for i=1,7 do
   local a=i*2.4
   local y=-.8+(i%3)*.9
   ball(m,"SnowSpot",V(.38,.38,.16),V(math.sin(a)*1.72,y,math.cos(a)*1.72),t[3])
  end
  gem(m,"IceCrown",V(0,2.82,0),.72,t[3])
 elseif id=="DesertEgg" then
  for i=0,11 do
   local a=i*math.pi/6
   gem(m,"TurquoiseBand",V(math.sin(a)*1.99,-.55,math.cos(a)*1.99),.39,t[3])
  end
  ball(m,"SunMedallion",V(1.22,1.22,.22),V(0,.62,-1.98),t[2])
  ball(m,"SunGem",V(.69,.69,.25),V(0,.62,-2.1),t[3])
  for i=0,7 do
   local a=i*math.pi/4
   line(m,"SunRay",V(math.sin(a)*.72,.62+math.cos(a)*.72,-2),V(math.sin(a)*.91,.62+math.cos(a)*.91,-1.95),.055,t[2])
  end
  p(m,"GoldCap",V(.3,1.18,1.18),CFrame.new(0,2.65,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2),t[2],Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
  gem(m,"TurquoiseCrown",V(0,2.99,0),.62,t[3])
 elseif id=="CursedEgg" then
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   line(m,"Horn",V(s*1.05,1.74,0),V(s*1.6,2.45,.1),.21,t[2])
   line(m,"HornTip",V(s*1.6,2.45,.1),V(s*1.47,2.99,.1),.11,t[3])
   local pts={V(s*.22,1.57,-1.65),V(s*.63,.87,-1.94),V(s*.34,.23,-2.12),V(s*.77,-.42,-2.04),V(s*.57,-1.25,-1.9)}
   for i=1,#pts-1 do line(m,"MagicSeam",pts[i],pts[i+1],.045,t[3],Enum.Material.Neon) end
  end
  gem(m,"VoidSeal",V(0,0,-2.16),.83,t[2])
  local core=gem(m,"SealCore",V(0,0,-2.48),.35,t[3]); core.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
  for i=0,4 do
   local a=i*math.pi*2/5
   gem(m,"OrbitShard",V(math.sin(a)*2.39,-1.24,math.cos(a)*2.39),.36,t[2])
  end
 elseif id=="CrystalEgg" then
  for i=0,7 do
   local a=i*math.pi/4
   gem(m,"CrystalFacet",V(math.sin(a)*1.84,-.46,math.cos(a)*1.84),.8,i%2==0 and t[3] or t[2])
  end
  for i=-1,1 do
   gem(m,"CrystalCrown",V(i*.64,2.48-math.abs(i)*.25,0),1.02-math.abs(i)*.2,t[3])
  end
  gem(m,"DiamondEmblem",V(0,.73,-1.98),1.02,t[2])
  gem(m,"DiamondHeart",V(0,.73,-2.36),.54,t[3])
  for s=-1,1,2 do line(m,"Glint",V(s*1.15,.82,-1.74),V(s*1.15,1.22,-1.6),.06,t[3]) end
 end
 local bounds=m:GetBoundingBox()
 for _,a in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do if a:IsA("BasePart") then a.CFrame=bounds:ToObjectSpace(a.CFrame) end end
 -- Hidden center anchor gives every prompt a stable position independent of decoration.
 local anchor=p(m,"HatchAnchor",V(.2,.2,.2),CFrame.new(),t[1]); anchor.Transparency=1
 m.PrimaryPart=anchor; m.WorldPivot=CFrame.new()
 m:SetAttribute("ArtVersion",2)
 return m
end
return M

-- Builds the visual for an item: its image if it has one, otherwise a drawn cartoon shovel.
local ItemIcon = {}
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

function ItemIcon.create(item)
	if item.ImageId and item.ImageId ~= "" then
		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Icon"
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.Image = item.ImageId
		img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		return img
	end

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "Icon"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	local a = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint"); a.AspectRatio = 1; a.Parent = root

	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	body.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	body.Rotation = 35
	body.Parent = root

	local function part(name, pos, size, color, rad)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.Name = name
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Position = pos
		f.Size = size
		f.BackgroundColor3 = color
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(rad, 0); c.Parent = f
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = 2.5; s.Color = OUTLINE
		s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent = f
		f.Parent = body
		return f
	end

	local wood = Color3.fromRGB(150, 95, 55)
	part("Shaft", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.38), UDim2.fromScale(0.09, 0.52), wood, 0.5)
	part("Grip", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.1), UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.1), wood, 0.5)
	local tint = item.Tint or Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 195)
	local blade = part("Blade", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.74), UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.38), WHITE, 0.3)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(tint:Lerp(WHITE, 0.45), tint)
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Parent = blade
	return root
end

return ItemIcon

-- NumberFormat: 950 -> "950", 1100 -> "1.1K", 2500000 -> "2.5M", ... up to trillions and beyond.
local NumberFormat = {}

-- edit these to change the letters (e.g. lowercase "k", "m")
NumberFormat.Suffixes = {"K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc"}

function NumberFormat.Abbreviate(n)
	n = tonumber(n) or 0
	local sign = n < 0 and "-" or ""
	n = math.abs(n)
	if n < 1000 then return sign .. tostring(math.floor(n)) end

	local suffixes = NumberFormat.Suffixes
	local i = math.min(math.floor(math.log10(n) / 3), #suffixes)
	local v = math.floor(n / 10 ^ (i * 3) * 10) / 10 -- round DOWN to 1 decimal
	if v >= 1000 and i < #suffixes then            -- float edge cases like 999,999.99
		i += 1
		v = math.floor(n / 10 ^ (i * 3) * 10) / 10
	end
	local text = (v % 1 == 0) and string.format("%d", v) or string.format("%.1f", v)
	return sign .. text .. suffixes[i]
end

return NumberFormat

-- Toy pets: shared geometry for followers, inventory and hatch previews. Front is -Z.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local M = {}
local V, C = Vector3.new, Color3.fromRGB
local WHITE, INK = C(255,255,255), C(24,29,48)
local SMOOTH, NEON = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Neon
local function part(m,n,size,cf,col,shape,mat)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=n; p.Size=size; p.CFrame=cf; p.Color=col; p.Shape=shape == Enum.PartType.Ball and Enum.PartType.Block or (shape or Enum.PartType.Block)
 if shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;mesh.Parent=p end
 p.Material=mat or SMOOTH; p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.CanQuery=false
 p.CastShadow=false; p.Massless=true; p.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 p.Parent=m; return p
end
local function ell(m,n,size,pos,col,rot,mat)
 return part(m,n,size,CFrame.new(pos)*(rot or CFrame.new()),col,Enum.PartType.Ball,mat)
end
local function box(m,n,size,pos,col,rot,mat)
 return part(m,n,size,CFrame.new(pos)*(rot or CFrame.new()),col,nil,mat)
end
local function rod(m,n,a,b,r,col,mat)
 return part(m,n,V((b-a).Magnitude,r*2,r*2),CFrame.lookAt((a+b)/2,b)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0),col,Enum.PartType.Cylinder,mat)
end
-- Rounded solid box: no asset downloads and no runtime CSG operations.
local function soft(m,n,size,pos,r,col)
 local q=size/2-V(r,r,r)
 local root=box(m,n,V(size.X,size.Y-2*r,size.Z-2*r),pos,col)
 box(m,n,V(size.X-2*r,size.Y,size.Z-2*r),pos,col)
 box(m,n,V(size.X-2*r,size.Y-2*r,size.Z),pos,col)
 for a=-1,1,2 do for b=-1,1,2 do
  rod(m,n,pos+V(-q.X,a*q.Y,b*q.Z),pos+V(q.X,a*q.Y,b*q.Z),r,col)
  rod(m,n,pos+V(a*q.X,-q.Y,b*q.Z),pos+V(a*q.X,q.Y,b*q.Z),r,col)
  rod(m,n,pos+V(a*q.X,b*q.Y,-q.Z),pos+V(a*q.X,b*q.Y,q.Z),r,col)
  for c=-1,1,2 do ell(m,n,V(r*2,r*2,r*2),pos+V(a*q.X,b*q.Y,c*q.Z),col) end
 end end
 return root
end
local function diamond(m,n,pos,size,col)
 return box(m,n,V(size*.7,size,size*.7),pos,col,CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/4,math.pi/4))
end
local function ear(m,s,height,width,body,inside,spread)
 local rot=CFrame.Angles(0,0,-s*spread)
 local pos=V(s*.65,.93+height*.33,0)
 ell(m,"Ear",V(width,height,.44),pos,body,rot)
 ell(m,"InnerEar",V(width*.53,height*.7,.12),pos+V(0,0,-.22),inside,rot)
end
local function wing(m,s,col,bat)
 if bat then
  for i=0,2 do
   local pos=V(s*(1.16+i*.37),.35-i*.13,.25)
   box(m,"WingMembrane",V(.64,.72-i*.13,.18),pos,col,CFrame.Angles(0,-s*.2,s*(.55-i*.13)))
  end
  rod(m,"WingEdge",V(s*.8,.25,.2),V(s*2.15,.88,.35),.09,col:Lerp(INK,.3))
 else
  for i=0,2 do ell(m,"WingFeather",V(.46,1.24-i*.14,.26),V(s*(1.03+i*.3),.05+i*.08,.26),col:Lerp(WHITE,i*.13),CFrame.Angles(0,-s*.25,-s*(.5+i*.17))) end
 end
end
function M.create(name)
 local overrides=RS:FindFirstChild("PetModelOverrides")
 local custom=overrides and overrides:FindFirstChild(name)
 if custom then
  local copy=custom:Clone()
  for _,p in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false end end
  return copy
 end
 local pet=Config.PetByName[name]
 local l=pet and pet.Look or {Body=WHITE}
 local body,belly=l.Body,l.Belly or l.Body:Lerp(WHITE,.35)
 local accent=l.Accent or l.Body:Lerp(INK,.25)
 local m=Instance.new("Model"); m.Name=name
 local ghost=name=="Ghost"; local slime=name=="Gem Slime"; local scarab=name=="Scarab"
 local root
 if ghost or slime then
  root=ell(m,"Body",V(2.15,ghost and 2.2 or 1.7,1.85),V(0,0,0),body)
  for i=-1,1 do ell(m,"SoftLobe",V(.85,.7,1.1),V(i*.64,-.65,.05),body) end
 else
  root=soft(m,"Body",V(scarab and 2.12 or 1.95,scarab and 1.5 or 1.85,1.7),V(0,0,0),.3,body)
 end
 m.PrimaryPart=root
 local bird=name=="Penguin" or name=="Prism Bird"
 local faceZ=-.88
 if bird then
  ell(m,"FaceBib",V(1.55,1.53,.13),V(0,-.1,faceZ),belly)
 elseif not ghost and not slime and not scarab then
  ell(m,"Muzzle",V(1.04,.62,.19),V(0,-.29,faceZ),belly)
 end
 for s=-1,1,2 do
  ell(m,"Eye",V(.31,.43,.13),V(s*.45,.2,-.99),l.Eyes or INK)
  ell(m,"EyeShine",V(.105,.13,.045),V(s*.45-.055,.3,-1.064),WHITE)
  ell(m,"Blush",V(.28,.12,.045),V(s*.7,-.11,-.9),body:Lerp(C(255,153,175),.7))
 end
 if bird then
  ell(m,"Beak",V(.4,.24,.42),V(0,-.11,-1.02),accent)
 elseif ghost or slime then
  ell(m,"Smile",V(.23,.2,.05),V(0,-.24,-.98),INK)
 else
  ell(m,"Nose",V(.24,.16,.12),V(0,-.2,-1.025),INK)
  rod(m,"Smile",V(0,-.26,-1.03),V(0,-.36,-1.03),.026,INK)
  for s=-1,1,2 do rod(m,"Smile",V(0,-.36,-1.03),V(s*.13,-.32,-1.03),.026,INK) end
 end
 if not l.NoFeet then
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   ell(m,"Paw",V(.64,.4,.85),V(s*.6,-.93,-.32),bird and accent or belly)
  end
 end
 local ears=l.Ears or "none"
 for s=-1,1,2 do
  if ears=="long" then ear(m,s,1.58,.5,body,C(255,179,201),.13)
  elseif ears=="huge" then ear(m,s,1.5,.85,body,C(250,219,193),.38)
  elseif ears=="round" then ear(m,s,.68,.72,body,belly,.07)
  elseif ears=="pointy" then
   box(m,"PointedEar",V(.58,.7,.45),V(s*.64,.95,0),body,CFrame.Angles(0,0,-s*.5))
   box(m,"InnerEar",V(.29,.37,.055),V(s*.65,1,-.25),belly:Lerp(C(225,154,182),.4),CFrame.Angles(0,0,-s*.5))
  end
 end
 local extras={}; for _,e in ipairs(l.Extras or {}) do extras[e]=true end
 if extras.tail then ell(m,"PuffTail",V(.8,.8,.8),V(0,-.35,1.02),WHITE) end
 if extras.bigtail then
  ell(m,"PlumeTail",V(.95,.88,1.7),V(.38,-.25,1.05),body,CFrame.Angles(-.35,-.3,0))
  ell(m,"TailTip",V(.71,.68,.76),V(.62,.03,1.75),belly)
 end
 if extras.longtail then
  rod(m,"Tail",V(0,-.42,.6),V(.35,-.3,1.6),.23,body)
  rod(m,"TailTip",V(.35,-.3,1.6),V(.7,.2,1.95),.13,accent)
 end
 if extras.flippers then for s=-1,1,2 do ell(m,"Flipper",V(.32,1.15,.6),V(s*.98,-.1,.04),body,CFrame.Angles(0,0,s*.35)) end end
 if extras.hump then
  ell(m,"Hump",V(1.1,1.25,1.1),V(0,.78,.43),body)
  ell(m,"Muzzle",V(.85,.52,.45),V(0,-.2,-1),belly)
 end
 if extras.horns then
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   rod(m,"HornBase",V(s*.62,.73,0),V(s*.85,1.25,.03),.16,l.Accent or C(255,236,197))
   rod(m,"HornTip",V(s*.85,1.25,.03),V(s*.62,1.53,.08),.085,l.Accent or C(255,236,197))
  end
 end
 if extras.wings then for s=-1,1,2 do wing(m,s,accent,name=="Shadow Bat" or name=="Void Demon" or name=="Diamond Dragon") end end
 if extras.spikes then
  for i=0,2 do diamond(m,"CrystalSpine",V(0,.93-i*.12,.05+i*.38),.55-i*.07,l.SpikeColor or accent) end
 end
 if extras.gem then diamond(m,"CrownGem",V(0,.98,0),.64,C(236,135,246)) end
 if extras.crown then
  box(m,"GoldHeadband",V(1.25,.19,.95),V(0,.99,0),C(255,209,85))
  for i=-1,1 do diamond(m,"CrownPoint",V(i*.42,1.26,-.18),.38,C(255,209,85)) end
  diamond(m,"RoyalGem",V(0,1.08,-.53),.22,accent)
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   box(m,"Headdress",V(.34,1.15,.47),V(s*.94,.03,0),accent,CFrame.Angles(0,0,s*.08))
   for i=0,2 do box(m,"GoldStripe",V(.36,.1,.5),V(s*.94,.34-i*.27,0),C(255,209,85)) end
  end
 end
 if extras.halo then
  for i=1,12 do
   local a,b=(i-1)*math.pi/6,i*math.pi/6
   rod(m,"VoidRing",V(math.cos(a)*.85,1.82,math.sin(a)*.65),V(math.cos(b)*.85,1.82,math.sin(b)*.65),.05,l.Glow,NEON)
  end
 end
 if scarab then
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   ell(m,"JewelShell",V(.94,1.42,.55),V(s*.49,.08,.64),body:Lerp(C(74,242,202),.2))
   for i=0,2 do rod(m,"GoldLeg",V(s*.7,-.4,.45-i*.43),V(s*1.2,-.7,.62-i*.53),.09,C(255,208,94)) end
  end
  box(m,"GoldSeam",V(.09,1.35,.1),V(0,.06,.92),C(255,208,94))
  diamond(m,"ForeheadGem",V(0,.65,-.87),.3,C(255,208,94))
 end
 if name=="Yeti" or name=="Crystal Golem" then
  for s=-1,1,2 do
   ell(m,"StrongArm",V(.65,1.12,.78),V(s*1.05,-.25,0),body)
   ell(m,"Hand",V(.62,.55,.68),V(s*1.07,-.64,-.12),belly)
  end
  if name=="Crystal Golem" then diamond(m,"HeartCrystal",V(0,-.43,-1),.48,l.Glow) end
 end
 if name=="Diamond Dragon" then
  for i=0,2 do diamond(m,"DragonCrest",V(0,.96,.2+i*.3),.4,accent) end
 end
 if name=="Prism Bird" then
  for i=-1,1 do ell(m,"Crest",V(.22,.7,.28),V(i*.23,.98,0),i==0 and C(255,220,125) or accent,CFrame.Angles(0,0,-i*.35)) end
 end
 if l.Glow then
  local jewel=diamond(m,"GlowCharm",V(0,.64,-.91),.22,l.Glow); jewel.Material=NEON
 end
 -- Center every silhouette so the existing preview cameras and ground-following stay aligned.
 m.PrimaryPart=nil
 local bounds=m:GetBoundingBox()
 for _,p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CFrame=bounds:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame) end end
 m.WorldPivot=CFrame.new()
 if l.Size then m:ScaleTo(math.min(l.Size,1.18)) end
 return m
end
return M

-- MUTATIONS (2026-10-01): every rolled shovel can come out mutated (independent rolls, see RNGHandler).
--   Giant: 2x size and reach, 5x rarer.  Shiny: 3x power, 10x rarer.  Both: "Shiny Giant", 50x rarer.
-- Variants live in Config.ByName and Config.VariantsOf[base] but NOT in Config.Items, so the roll table and Index stay 35 shovels.
local Balance = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Balance"))
Config.Mutations = {
	{Id = "Shiny", Chance = 10, PowerMult = 3, SizeMult = 1},
	{Id = "Giant", Chance = 5,  PowerMult = 1, SizeMult = 2},
}
Config.MutationById = {}
for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do Config.MutationById[m.Id] = m end
function Config.VariantName(baseName, ids)
	local has, prefix = {}, ""
	for _, id in ipairs(ids or {}) do has[id] = true end
	for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do if has[m.Id] then prefix ..= m.Id .. " " end end
	return prefix .. baseName
end
local function rarityFor(chance, fallback)
	local best, bestMin = fallback, -1
	for name, minC in pairs(Config.RarityMinChance or {}) do
		if chance >= minC and minC > bestMin and Config.Rarities and Config.Rarities[name] then best, bestMin = name, minC end
	end
	return best
end
Config.VariantsOf = {}
for _, base in ipairs(Config.Items) do
	local basePower = base.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(base.Chance)
	local list = {}
	for _, combo in ipairs({{"Giant"}, {"Shiny"}, {"Shiny", "Giant"}}) do
		local v = table.clone(base)
		local chance, power, size = 1, 1, 1
		for _, id in ipairs(combo) do
			local m = Config.MutationById[id]
			chance *= m.Chance; power *= m.PowerMult; size *= m.SizeMult
		end
		v.Name = Config.VariantName(base.Name, combo)
		v.Base = base.Name
		v.Mutations = combo
		v.Mutation = table.concat(combo, " ")
		v.Chance = base.Chance * chance
		v.Rarity = rarityFor(v.Chance, base.Rarity)
		v.Power = math.max(1, math.floor(basePower * power))
		v.Size = size
		Config.ByName[v.Name] = v
		table.insert(list, v)
	end
	Config.VariantsOf[base.Name] = list
end

return Config

-- 2026-10-02 balance pass v2 (Claude): fast start, slower late game. With events/quests/daily/achievements World 1 takes ~4 h for an efficient engaged player, ~5 h casual (model). Older copies: ServerStorage.BalanceBackups
-- Permanent, additive bonuses keep repeat runs faster without exponential runaway.
local R = {}
R.MaxRebirths = 50
R.SnowPerRebirth = 0.50
R.LuckPerRebirth = 0.25
R.Milestones = {
 {Stage = "Cursed", Cost = 62000},
 {Stage = "Crystal", Cost = 18000000},
 {Stage = "Retro", Cost = 1300000000},
 {Stage = "Jungle", Cost = 45000000000},
 {Stage = "AbsoluteZero", Cost = 880000000000},
 {Stage = "Portal", Cost = 50000000000000},
}
function R.Count(value)
 if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then return 0 end
 return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, R.MaxRebirths)
end
function R.Multipliers(count)
 count = R.Count(count)
 return 1 + count * R.SnowPerRebirth, 1 + count * R.LuckPerRebirth
end
function R.Requirement(count)
 count = R.Count(count)
 if count >= R.MaxRebirths then return nil end
 local level = count + 1
 local tier = R.Milestones[math.min(level, #R.Milestones)]
 local repeats = math.max(1, level - #R.Milestones + 1)
 return {Level = level, Stage = tier.Stage, Cost = tier.Cost * repeats * repeats}
end
return R

-- SNOW FIELDS
-- Fields are placed in Studio as boxes inside Workspace > SnowFieldZones.
--   * Move / resize the box: the bottom of the box is the ground level of the field.
--   * Size is snapped to whole tiles (TileSize studs). Turning a box by 90 degrees works; other angles are snapped to the grid.
--   * Attribute "Stage" on the box = a folder in ReplicatedStorage > SnowStages (look + values).
--   * Optional overrides on the box: DisplayName, SnowPerPhase, RegrowSeconds, TileHP.
-- When the game starts the server reads the boxes, removes them, and shares the field data with clients.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SnowFields = {}

SnowFields.TileSize = 3
SnowFields.MaxPhase = 3
-- tile look & heights come from ReplicatedStorage > SnowFieldStyles
SnowFields.Spinner = {Speed = 7, Inner = 1.0, Outer = 5.3} -- Speed MUST match the visual spin
SnowFields.Defaults = {SnowPerPhase = 1, RegrowSeconds = 8, TileHP = 1}

function SnowFields.Origin(f)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return f.Center - Vector3.new(f.Width * ts / 2, 0, f.Depth * ts / 2)
end

function SnowFields.TileCenter(f, x, z)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return SnowFields.Origin(f) + Vector3.new((x + 0.5) * ts, 0, (z + 0.5) * ts)
end

local function readZones()
	local list, used = {}, {}
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if not zones then return list end
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	for i, z in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if z:IsA("BasePart") then
			local stageName = z:GetAttribute("Stage") or z:GetAttribute("Style") or "Starter"
			local stages = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SnowStages")
			local stage = stages and stages:FindFirstChild(stageName)
			if not stage then
				warn("[SnowFields] Field '" .. z.Name .. "' uses unknown Stage '" .. stageName .. "', using Starter")
				stageName = "Starter"
				stage = stages and stages:FindFirstChild("Starter")
			end
			-- box attribute wins, then the stage folder, then the default
			local function pick(attr)
				local v = z:GetAttribute(attr)
				if v == nil and stage then v = stage:GetAttribute(attr) end
				return v
			end
			local id = z.Name
			if used[id] then id = id .. "_" .. i end
			used[id] = true
			table.insert(list, {
				Id = id,
				Name = pick("DisplayName") or z.Name,
				Center = Vector3.new(z.Position.X, z.Position.Y - z.Size.Y / 2, z.Position.Z),
				-- boxes turned 90/270 degrees: swap width and depth so the field matches what you see
				Width = math.max(1, math.floor(((math.abs(math.floor(z.Orientation.Y + 0.5)) % 180 == 90) and z.Size.Z or z.Size.X) / ts + 0.5)),
				Depth = math.max(1, math.floor(((math.abs(math.floor(z.Orientation.Y + 0.5)) % 180 == 90) and z.Size.X or z.Size.Z) / ts + 0.5)),
				SnowPerPhase = pick("SnowPerPhase") or SnowFields.Defaults.SnowPerPhase,
				RegrowSeconds = pick("RegrowSeconds") or SnowFields.Defaults.RegrowSeconds,
				TileHP = pick("TileHP") or SnowFields.Defaults.TileHP,
				Style = stageName,
			})
		end
	end
	return list
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	SnowFields.Fields = readZones()
	if RunService:IsRunning() and #SnowFields.Fields == 0 then
		warn("[SnowFields] No snow fields found. Put boxes in Workspace > SnowFieldZones (and keep their Archivable property ON).")
	end
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "SnowFieldData"
		for _, f in ipairs(SnowFields.Fields) do
			local c = Instance.new("Configuration")
			c.Name = f.Id
			for k, v in pairs(f) do c:SetAttribute(k, v) end
			c.Parent = folder
		end
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
		if zones then zones:Destroy() end
	end
else
	SnowFields.Fields = {}
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldData")
	for _, c in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(SnowFields.Fields, c:GetAttributes())
	end
end

return SnowFields

-- Smooth (Catmull-Rom) interpolation through {time,value} keys.
local function curve(k,t)
 local n=#k
 if t<=k[1][1]then return k[1][2]end
 if t>=k[n][1]then return k[n][2]end
 local i=1
 while k[i+1][1]<t do i+=1 end
 local a,b=k[i],k[i+1]
 local p,q=k[i-1] or a,k[i+2] or b
 local dt=b[1]-a[1]
 local u=(t-a[1])/dt
 local m0=(b[2]-p[2])/(b[1]-p[1])*dt
 local m1=(q[2]-a[2])/(q[1]-a[1])*dt
 local u2,u3=u*u,u*u*u
 return (2*u3-3*u2+1)*a[2]+(u3-2*u2+u)*m0+(-2*u3+3*u2)*b[2]+(u3-u2)*m1
end

local MOUND_PUFFS={{5.02,.5,V(-1,.4,.5)},{5.08,.5,V(1.1,.4,.7)},{T_POP,.7,V(-.6,.6,.8)},{T_POP+.03,.7,V(.9,.6,.5)}}

local function newScene(c)
 local G,H,lift,rig,folder,ready=c.G,c.H,c.lift,c.rig,c.folder,c.ready
 local rs=math.clamp(rig.armReach/1.767,.6,1.4)
 local isR6=rig.kind=="R6"
 local function W(p)return G:PointToWorldSpace(p)end
 local function WV(v)return G:VectorToWorldSpace(v)end
 local stats={errR=0,errL=0,tilt=0}

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- body pose
 local function pose(t)
  local p={x=curve(K.x,t),z=curve(K.z,t),yaw=curve(K.yaw,t),pitch=curve(K.pitch,t),roll=curve(K.roll,t)}
  local dy
  if t<T_IMPACT then local u=t/T_IMPACT;dy=-2.5+43.5*(1-u*u) else dy=curve(K.dy,t) end
  local runE=smooth(t,4.24,4.34)*(1-smooth(t,4.6,4.78))
  dy+=math.abs(math.sin((t-4.2)*23))*.26*runE
  dy+=lift*smooth(t,7.45,DURATION)
  p.dy=dy
  p.roll+=math.sin(t*52)*2.2*smooth(t,4.95,5.02)*(1-smooth(t,5.16,5.22))   -- trembling under the strain
  return p
 end
 local function yawFrame(P)return CFrame.new(P.x,H+P.dy,P.z)*CFrame.Angles(0,rad(P.yaw),0)end
 local function joints(t)
  local rr,rsp,re=curve(K.Rr,t),curve(K.Rs,t),curve(K.Re,t)
  local lr,ls,le=curve(K.Lr,t),curve(K.Ls,t),curve(K.Le,t)
  local nx,ny,nz=curve(K.Nx,t),curve(K.Ny,t),curve(K.Nz,t)
  local base=-12*(1-smooth(t,3.9,4.3))
  local hr,hl,kr,kl,zr=base,base-3,0,0,7
  if t<T_IMPACT then   -- funny flailing fall that settles into a dive
   local f=1-smooth(t,1,1.45)
   local s=math.sin(t*12)
   rr+=math.sin(t*14)*24*f;lr+=math.sin(t*14+2.4)*24*f
   rsp+=math.sin(t*11+1)*13*f;ls+=math.sin(t*11+3)*13*f
   hr=(-8+s*36)*f+base*(1-f);hl=(14-s*36)*f+(base-3)*(1-f)
   kr=-(18+math.max(0,s)*40)*f;kl=-(18+math.max(0,-s)*40)*f
   zr=mix(7,15,f)
   ny+=math.sin(t*7)*22*f;nx+=math.sin(t*9)*10*f
  end
  local shake=smooth(t,2.2,2.35)*(1-smooth(t,2.7,3))   -- confused head shake
  ny+=math.sin((t-2.25)*15)*40*shake;nz+=math.sin((t-2.25)*7.5)*10*shake
  local tuck=bump(t,3.98,4.28)                        -- excited hop out of the snow
  hr+=45*tuck;hl+=45*tuck;kr-=70*tuck;kl-=70*tuck
  local runE=smooth(t,4.24,4.34)*(1-smooth(t,4.6,4.78))
  if runE>0 then
   local ph=(t-4.2)*23;local s=math.sin(ph)
   rr+=s*50*runE;lr-=s*50*runE
   hr+=55*s*runE;hl-=55*s*runE
   kr-=(30+30*math.sin(ph+1))*runE;kl-=(30-30*math.sin(ph+1))*runE
  end
  local cr=smooth(t,4.78,4.95)*(1-smooth(t,5.2,5.3))  -- crouch before the pull
  local lk=isR6 and .3 or 1
  hr+=28*cr*lk;hl+=24*cr*lk;kr-=55*cr;kl-=48*cr;zr+=6*cr
  local J={RightShoulder=V(rr,0,rsp),LeftShoulder=V(lr,0,-ls),RightElbow=V(re,0,0),LeftElbow=V(le,0,0),
   RightHip=V(hr,0,zr),LeftHip=V(hl,0,-zr),RightKnee=V(kr,0,0),LeftKnee=V(kl,0,0),
   Neck=V(nx,ny,nz),Waist=V(curve(K.Wx,t),0,0)}
  local hold=smooth(t,5.55,5.95)*(1-smooth(t,7.05,7.3))  -- shoulders rise, head tucks in under the raised shovel
  return J,{Neck=V(0,-.2*hold,0)}
 end

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- shovel + hands
 local shovel=Art.shovel(folder,c.shovelName,SCALE)
 local PIV_Y=2.54*SCALE-BURY
 local planted=CFrame.new(SHOVEL_AT.X,PIV_Y,SHOVEL_AT.Z)
 -- After the pop the hands carry the shovel: hand-centre offset in the avatar's yaw frame, keyed for continuity.
 -- After the pop the hands carry the shovel: hand-centre offsets relative to the shoulders, keyed for continuity.
 -- Skeleton at time t (stage space): pose, yaw frame, solved FK, and the midpoint between the two shoulder joints.
 -- Hand targets are authored relative to the real shoulders, so they are always within reach of the arms.
 local function skeleton(t)
  local P=pose(t);local J,OFF=joints(t)
  local Fr=yawFrame(P)
  local S=rig:solve(G*(Fr*CFrame.Angles(rad(P.pitch),0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,rad(P.roll))),J,OFF)
  local mid=G:PointToObjectSpace((rig:shoulder(S,"Right")+rig:shoulder(S,"Left"))/2)
  return P,Fr,S,mid
 end
 local _,Fp,_,mid0=skeleton(T_POP)
 local plantedMid=planted*CFrame.Angles(0,0,rad(-4))*V(0,(YT0+YB0)/2*SCALE,0)
 local off0=Fp:VectorToObjectSpace(plantedMid-mid0)
 local ox,oy,oz={{T_POP,off0.X},{5.34,0},{5.5,0},{7.5,0}},{{T_POP,off0.Y}},{{T_POP,off0.Z}}
 for _,k in ipairs({{5.29,.75,-.9},{5.36,.7,-.95},{5.6,1.05,-.85},{5.85,1.5,-.7},{7.5,1.5,-.7}})do
  oy[#oy+1]={k[1],k[2]*rs};oz[#oz+1]={k[1],k[3]*rs}
 end
 local function shovelState(t,Fr,mid)
  if t<T_POP then
   local tilt=-4
   if t>=4.95 then tilt+=math.sin(t*50)*1.4*smooth(t,4.95,5.05)*(1-smooth(t,5.15,5.22))end
   local cf=planted*CFrame.Angles(0,0,rad(tilt))
   return cf,cf*V(0,YT0*SCALE,0),cf*V(0,YB0*SCALE,0),SCALE
  end
  local th=rad(curve(K.th,t))
  local yT,yB=curve(K.yT,t),curve(K.yB,t)
  local sc=math.max(SCALE*(1-smooth(t,T_OUT+.08,T_OUT+.4)),.03)
  local ctr=mid+Fr:VectorToWorldSpace(V(curve(ox,t),curve(oy,t),curve(oz,t)))
  local a=V(-math.sin(th),math.cos(th),0)
  local piv=ctr-a*((yT+yB)/2*sc)
  local cf=CFrame.fromMatrix(piv,a:Cross(V(0,0,1)),a,V(0,0,1))
  local half=(yT-yB)*sc/2
  return cf,ctr+a*half,ctr-a*half,sc
 end
 -- snow that falls off the blade as the shovel comes out
 local spray={}
 for i=1,12 do
  local ts=T_POP+.02+i*.03
  local cf=shovelState(ts,select(2,skeleton(ts)),select(4,skeleton(ts)))
  local a=i*2.399
  spray[i]={ts=ts,p=cf*V(math.cos(a)*.5,-1.55*SCALE,math.sin(a)*.2),vx=math.cos(a)*(.7+.5*((i*7)%5)/4),vy=.9+((i*3)%4)*.4,vz=math.sin(a)*.6,size=.35+((i*11)%5)*.07}
 end

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- props + sprites
 local props=mk("Folder",{Name="Props"},folder)
 local function blob(name,pos,size,color)return Art.part(props,name,size,CFrame.new(W(pos))*G.Rotation,color or WHITE,"ball")end
 local mound={}
 for _,m in ipairs({{V(SHOVEL_AT.X,0,SHOVEL_AT.Z),V(4.2,.9,3.6)},{V(SHOVEL_AT.X-1.35,.05,SHOVEL_AT.Z+.7),V(1.7,.8,1.5)},
  {V(SHOVEL_AT.X+1.25,.03,SHOVEL_AT.Z+.8),V(1.5,.7,1.4)},{V(SHOVEL_AT.X+.2,.08,SHOVEL_AT.Z-1.15),V(1.6,.85,1.3)},{V(SHOVEL_AT.X,.2,SHOVEL_AT.Z),V(2.3,.7,2.1)}})do
  mound[#mound+1]={p=blob("Mound",m[1],m[2]),pos=m[1],size=m[2]}
 end
 local nest={}
 for i=1,8 do
  local a=(i-1)*math.pi/4+.3;local r=1.55+((i*5)%3)*.18
  local pos=LAND+V(math.cos(a)*r*1.25,.1,math.sin(a)*r*.85)
  local size=V(1.7+((i*3)%3)*.25,.95,1.5+((i*7)%3)*.2)
  nest[i]={p=blob("Nest",pos,size,i%2==0 and WHITE or C(228,242,253)),pos=pos,size=size}
 end
 local streaks={}
 for i=1,26 do
  local x=LAND.X+((i*7.3)%15)-7.5;local z=((i*5.1)%17)-4
  if math.abs(x-LAND.X)<2.2 and z<3 then z+=6 end
  local base=V(x,6+((i*3.7)%38),z)
  local p=Art.part(props,"Streak",V(.07,3.4+((i*2)%3),.07),CFrame.new(W(base))*G.Rotation,WHITE)
  p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;p.Transparency=.35
  streaks[i]=p
 end
 local clouds={}
 for _,cc in ipairs({{-9,34,-8},{7,25.5,3},{-2,15.5,-12},{10,41,-2}})do
  for j=1,4 do
   local o=V((j-2.5)*3.1,(j%2)*1.1,((j*1.7)%2-1)*1.3)
   clouds[#clouds+1]=blob("Cloud",V(cc[1],cc[2],cc[3])+o,V(6.4-j*.5,3-(j%2)*.5,4.6))
  end
 end
 local skyGone=false
 local tex=Art.Textures
 local function pool(n,name,key,size)local l={};for i=1,n do l[i]=Art.sprite(folder,name,ready[key] and tex[key] or nil,size)end;return l end
 local puffs=pool(10,"LandingPowder","SnowPuff",3)
 local flakes=pool(14,"SoftSnow","Snowflake",.3)
 local glints=pool(5,"ShovelGlint","Glint",1.6)
 local spray1=pool(6,"BladeSpray","Snowflake",.4)
 local spray2=pool(6,"BladePuff","SnowPuff",.8)
 local moundPuffs=pool(4,"MoundPuff","SnowPuff",2)
 local function show(s,pos,size,opacity,rot)
  s.anchor.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)
  s.gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale(size,size)
  s.image.ImageTransparency=1-math.clamp(opacity,0,1)
  if rot then s.image.Rotation=rot end
 end
 local function hide(s)s.image.ImageTransparency=1 end

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- camera
 local gameFocus=V(3,H+lift+c.focusOff.Y,0)
 local gp=rad(c.gpitch)
 local gamePos=gameFocus+V(0,c.zoom*math.sin(gp),c.zoom*math.cos(gp))
 local function closeUp(t)
  local u=ease(span(t,6.2,6.62));local d=span(t,6.62,T_OUT)
  local p0=V(3+math.sin(rad(20))*8,1.6,math.cos(rad(20))*8)
  local p1=V(3,3.7,5.4):Lerp(V(3.05,3.8,5.1),d)
  return p0:Lerp(p1,u),V(3,4.1,0):Lerp(V(3,5,.2),u),mix(54,52,u)
 end
 local function shot(t)
  if t<T_IMPACT then                                   -- 1 FALLING: wide sky shot that drops with the avatar
   local u=t/T_IMPACT;local e=ease(u);local ay=H+pose(t).dy
   return V(mix(1,-2.6,e),ay+mix(5.5,2.2,e),mix(19,9.5,e)),V(-3.3,ay+mix(-7,-.8,e),0),mix(70,60,e),rad(3)*math.sin(u*math.pi)
  elseif t<3 then                                      -- 2 SNOW LANDING: low ground-level shot
   local e=ease(span(t,T_IMPACT,3))
   return V(mix(-1.6,-2.4,e),mix(.6,1,e),mix(5.8,5,e)),V(-3.1,mix(.4,1.6,smooth(t,2,2.7)),0),mix(50,46,e)
  elseif t<3.75 then                                   -- 3a SHOVEL DISCOVERY: push toward the planted shovel
   local u=ease(span(t,3,3.75))
   return V(mix(6.2,6,u),mix(1.4,2,u),mix(11.5,8.6,u)),V(mix(5,5.1,u),mix(2.6,3.2,u),SHOVEL_AT.Z),mix(46,40,u)
  elseif t<4.2 then                                    -- 3b the avatar notices it
   local u=ease(span(t,3.75,4.2))
   return V(mix(-.4,-1.2,u),mix(2.3,2.6,u),mix(8.6,7.8,u)),V(-3.3,mix(2,3.4,smooth(t,4,4.2)),0),mix(44,42,u)
  elseif t<5.35 then                                   -- 4 GRAB: follow the run, frame hands and shovel
   local g=ease(span(t,4.5,4.9))
   return V(mix(3,6.4,g),mix(2.2,2.6,g),mix(9.5,8.2,g)),V(mix(1,4.6,g),mix(2.4,3.1,g),mix(0,-.3,g)),mix(46,42,g)
  elseif t<6.2 then                                    -- 5 VICTORY: low hero angle, short arc
   local u=ease(span(t,5.35,6.2));local a=rad(mix(-24,20,u));local R=mix(8.6,8,u)
   return V(3+math.sin(a)*R,mix(.9,1.6,u),math.cos(a)*R),V(3,mix(2.6,4.1,u),0),mix(56,54,u)
  elseif t<T_OUT then                                  -- 6 SHOVEL CLOSE-UP
   return closeUp(t)
  end
  local u=ease(span(t,T_OUT,DURATION))                 -- smooth return to the gameplay camera
  local p,tg,f=closeUp(T_OUT)
  return p:Lerp(gamePos,u),tg:Lerp(gameFocus,u),mix(f,c.oldFov,u)
 end
 local function shake(t)
  local a=0
  if t>=T_IMPACT and t<T_IMPACT+.24 then a+=(1-(t-T_IMPACT)/.24)*.13 end
  if t>=T_POP and t<T_POP+.16 then a+=(1-(t-T_POP)/.16)*.06 end
  return a>0 and V(math.sin(t*75),math.cos(t*67),0)*a or V()
 end

 ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame
 local lastScale,lastMound,lastNest=SCALE,-1,-1
 local function render(t)
  local P,Fr,S,mid=skeleton(t)
  -- shovel, then both hands reach the two grip points on it
  local scf,Ht,Hb,sc=shovelState(t,Fr,mid)
  local w=smooth(t,4.55,4.78)*(1-smooth(t,T_OUT,T_OUT+.3))
  if w>.001 then
   local fwd=WV(Fr.LookVector)
   local pr=rig:reach(S,"Right",W(Ht),{weight=w,pole=WV(Fr:VectorToWorldSpace(V(.7,-.6,.4))),forward=fwd})
   local pl=rig:reach(S,"Left",W(Hb),{weight=w,pole=WV(Fr:VectorToWorldSpace(V(-.7,-.6,.4))),forward=fwd})
   stats.errR=pr and (pr-W(Ht)).Magnitude or 0
   stats.errL=pl and (pl-W(Hb)).Magnitude or 0
  else stats.errR,stats.errL=0,0 end
  rig:commit(S)
  shovel:PivotTo(G*scf)
  if math.abs(sc-lastScale)>.004 then shovel:ScaleTo(sc);lastScale=sc end
  stats.tilt=math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(scf.UpVector.Y,-1,1)))
  -- fall props
  local fallVis=t<T_IMPACT+.05
  if fallVis then
   for _,s in ipairs(streaks)do s.Transparency=.35+.65*smooth(t,1.2,1.5)end
  elseif not skyGone then
   skyGone=true
   for _,s in ipairs(streaks)do s.Transparency=1 end
   for _,cl in ipairs(clouds)do cl.Transparency=1 end
  end
  -- landing nest pops up on impact, sinks away once the avatar hops out
  local grow=span(t,T_IMPACT,T_IMPACT+.26)
  local nk=(1+2.7*(grow-1)^3+1.7*(grow-1)^2)*(1-smooth(t,3.98,4.28))
  if t<T_IMPACT then nk=0 end
  if math.abs(nk-lastNest)>.004 then
   lastNest=nk
   for _,n in ipairs(nest)do
    local k=math.max(nk,.001)
    n.p.Size=n.size*k;n.p.CFrame=CFrame.new(W(n.pos-V(0,(1-k)*.3,0)))*G.Rotation
   end
  end
  -- mound slumps when the shovel comes out, then melts away before the handoff
  local mk_=(1-.42*smooth(t,T_POP,T_POP+.15))*(1-smooth(t,7,7.6))
  if math.abs(mk_-lastMound)>.004 then
   lastMound=mk_
   for _,m in ipairs(mound)do
    local k=math.max(mk_,.001)
    m.p.Size=V(m.size.X,m.size.Y*k,m.size.Z);m.p.CFrame=CFrame.new(W(m.pos-V(0,(1-k)*m.size.Y*.5,0)))*G.Rotation
   end
  end
  -- landing powder: a short soft puff that covers the avatar for a moment
  for i,s in ipairs(puffs)do
   local age=(t-T_IMPACT-(i%3)*.035)/.95
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    local a=(i-1)*math.pi*2/#puffs+.4;local front=i<=3
    local dir=front and V(math.cos(a)*.55,0,math.abs(math.sin(a))*.9+.6) or V(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)*.7)
    local pos=LAND+V(0,.5,.3)+dir*((front and .6 or .8)+3*age^.6)+V(0,.3+1.7*age-.8*age*age,0)
    show(s,W(pos),(front and 4.4 or 3.2)+age*(front and 4.4 or 3),.85*math.sin(math.pi*age)^.6,i*43+age*30)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  for i,s in ipairs(flakes)do   -- a few soft flakes drifting through the whole scene
   show(s,W(V(((i*13.37)%26)-12+math.sin(t+i)*.2,11-((t*.7+i*2.93)%13),((i*7.13)%20)-6)),.3,.55,t*12+i*37)
  end
  for k,ev in ipairs(GLINTS)do
   local s=glints[(k-1)%#glints+1];local age=(t-ev[1])/ev[2]
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    local sn=math.sin(math.pi*age)
    show(s,W(scf*(ev[3]*sc)),ev[4]*4.5*(.5+.5*sn),sn^1.5,30*age)
   elseif t<ev[1] or t>ev[1]+ev[2] then hide(s)end
  end
  for i,sp in ipairs(spray)do
   local s=i<=6 and spray1[i] or spray2[i-6]
   local age=t-sp.ts
   if age>=0 and age<.85 then
    show(s,W(sp.p+V(sp.vx*age,sp.vy*age-3.6*age*age,sp.vz*age)),sp.size*(1+.4*age),.8*(1-age/.85)^.8,i*57+age*90)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  for i,ev in ipairs(MOUND_PUFFS)do
   local s=moundPuffs[i];local age=(t-ev[1])/ev[2]
   if age>=0 and age<1 then
    show(s,W(SHOVEL_AT+ev[3]*(1+age*.6)+V(0,age*.9,0)),1.6+age*2.4,.6*math.sin(math.pi*age),i*70+age*20)
   else hide(s)end
  end
  -- camera
  local pos,tg,fov,roll=shot(t)
  pos+=shake(t)
  pos=V(pos.X,math.max(pos.Y,.5),pos.Z)
  return G*CFrame.lookAt(pos,tg)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,roll or 0),fov,W(tg),stats
 end
 return {render=render}
end

function M.Play(options)
 options=options or {}
 if player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") or M.busy then return false end
 local char=player.Character;local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false end
 M.busy=true
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local controls
 pcall(function()local pm=player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule");if pm then controls=require(pm):GetControls()end end)
 local old={cameraType=camera.CameraType,subject=camera.CameraSubject,fov=camera.FieldOfView,cf=camera.CFrame,focus=camera.Focus}
 -- What the normal gameplay camera looks like, so the cinematic can end exactly on it.
 local rootBefore=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local focusOff=rootBefore and (old.focus.Position-rootBefore.Position) or V(0,1.5,0)
 if focusOff.Magnitude>5 or focusOff.Magnitude<.3 then focusOff=V(0,1.5,0)end
 local zoom=(old.cf.Position-old.focus.Position).Magnitude
 if zoom<6 or zoom>40 then zoom=12.5 end
 local gpitch=-math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(old.cf.LookVector.Y,-1,1)))
 if gpitch<6 or gpitch>40 then gpitch=17 end
 local controlsWereEnabled=controls and controls.controlsEnabled~=false
 local savedGui,hidden,savedEffects={},{},{}
 local connections={}
 local folder,gui,grade
 local cancelled,cleaned,engaged=false,false,false
 local function restore()
  if cleaned then return end;cleaned=true
  M.busy=false
  if not engaged then return end
  RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SnowArrivalIntro")
  CAS:UnbindAction("SnowArrivalLock")
  for _,cn in ipairs(connections)do cn:Disconnect()end
  for part,value in pairs(hidden)do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=value end end
  for sg,value in pairs(savedGui)do if sg.Parent then sg.Enabled=value end end
  for effect,value in pairs(savedEffects)do if effect.Parent then effect.Enabled=value end end
  if folder then folder:Destroy()end;if gui then gui:Destroy()end;if grade then grade:Destroy()end
  camera.FieldOfView=old.fov
  local live=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  camera.CameraSubject=live or old.subject;camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom
  if controls and controlsWereEnabled then controls:Enable()end
  player:SetAttribute("IntroPlaying",false)
  task.spawn(function()pcall(function()Request:InvokeServer(cancelled and "Skip" or "Finish")end)end)
 end
 local ok,err=xpcall(function()
  local ready=Art.preload(2.5)
  if player.Character~=char or hum.Health<=0 then return end
  local data=Request:InvokeServer(options.Preview and "Preview" or "Begin")
  if not data then return end
  engaged=true
  player:SetAttribute("IntroPlaying",true)
  if controls then controls:Disable()end
  CAS:BindActionAtPriority("SnowArrivalLock",function()return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end,false,3000,unpack(Enum.PlayerActions:GetEnumItems()))
  folder=mk("Folder",{Name="SnowArrivalCinematic"},workspace)
  folder:SetAttribute("Duration",DURATION)
  gui=mk("ScreenGui",{Name="SnowArrivalGui",DisplayOrder=1000,IgnoreGuiInset=true,ResetOnSpawn=false,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling},player.PlayerGui)
  local skip=mk("TextButton",{Name="Skip",Text="SKIP  ›",Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize=16,TextColor3=WHITE,BackgroundColor3=C(22,53,76),BackgroundTransparency=.3,BorderSizePixel=0,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),Position=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(118,44),ZIndex=3},gui)
  mk("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16)},skip)
  connections[#connections+1]=skip.Activated:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  connections[#connections+1]=Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)if not processed and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then cancelled=true end end)
  connections[#connections+1]=hum.Died:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  connections[#connections+1]=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()cancelled=true end)
  local function hideGui(sg)if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and sg~=gui and not sg:GetAttribute("KeepDuringIntro") then savedGui[sg]=sg.Enabled;sg.Enabled=false end end
  for _,sg in ipairs(player.PlayerGui:GetChildren())do hideGui(sg)end
  connections[#connections+1]=player.PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(hideGui)
  for _,p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart")then hidden[p]=p.LocalTransparencyModifier end end
  for _,container in ipairs({Lighting,camera})do for _,effect in ipairs(container:GetChildren())do
   if effect:IsA("BlurEffect") or effect:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")then savedEffects[effect]=effect.Enabled;effect.Enabled=false end
  end end
  grade=mk("ColorCorrectionEffect",{Name="ArrivalColor",Brightness=.025,Contrast=.04,Saturation=.09,TintColor=C(241,250,255)},Lighting)
  -- Real ground under the intro marker (the marker floats slightly above the snow).
  local rp=RaycastParams.new();rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={char,folder}
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(data.Origin.Position+V(0,12,0),V(0,-40,0),rp)
  local groundY=hit and hit.Position.Y or data.Origin.Position.Y-.22
  local G=CFrame.new(data.Origin.Position.X,groundY,data.Origin.Position.Z)*data.Origin.Rotation
  local rig=Rig.new(char,folder)
  local scene=newScene({G=G,H=data.Height,lift=data.Origin.Position.Y-groundY,rig=rig,folder=folder,ready=ready,shovelName=data.StarterShovel,
   oldFov=old.fov,zoom=zoom,gpitch=gpitch,focusOff=focusOff})
  local start=os.clock()
  local frameCount=0
  local hold=RunService:IsStudio() and options.HoldAt~=nil
  local function render()
   local t=hold and (player:GetAttribute("IntroHoldAt") or options.HoldAt) or math.min(os.clock()-start,DURATION)
   t=math.clamp(t,0,DURATION)
   local cf,fov,focus,stats=scene.render(t)
   camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
   camera.CFrame=cf;camera.FieldOfView=fov;camera.Focus=CFrame.new(focus)
   for part in pairs(hidden)do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end end
   -- Match the real character before restoring the normal camera; no flash, no pop.
   local dissolve=ease((t-7.55)/.35)
   for part,value in pairs(hidden)do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=mix(1,value,dissolve) end end
   rig:fade(dissolve)
   folder:SetAttribute("Time",t)
   folder:SetAttribute("HandErrR",stats.errR);folder:SetAttribute("HandErrL",stats.errL);folder:SetAttribute("ShaftTilt",stats.tilt)
   frameCount+=1
  end
  camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
  render()
  local renderError
  RunService:BindToRenderStep("SnowArrivalIntro",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+3,function()
   if renderError then return end
   local rendered,message=pcall(render)
   if not rendered then renderError=message;cancelled=true end
  end)
  repeat RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
  until cancelled or not char.Parent or player.Character~=char
   or (hold and (player:GetAttribute("IntroHoldEnd") or os.clock()-start>1800))
   or (not hold and (os.clock()-start>=DURATION or (os.clock()-start>1 and player:GetAttribute("IntroActive")~=true)))
  player:SetAttribute("IntroLastFrames",frameCount)
  player:SetAttribute("IntroLastSeconds",os.clock()-start)
  if renderError then error(renderError)end
 end,debug.traceback)
 restore()
 if not ok then warn("[SnowIntro] "..tostring(err))end
 return ok
end

-- SnowIntroRig: an anchored, joint-solved copy of the player's avatar for the arrival cinematic.
-- Supports R6 and R15 (Motor6D or AnimationConstraint). Poses are pure math (no physics, no animation
-- playback), so the cinematic can be scrubbed to any time and always restores cleanly.
local Rig={}
Rig.__index=Rig
local V,ZERO=Vector3.new,Vector3.zero
local rad=math.rad

local function eul(v)return CFrame.Angles(rad(v.X),rad(v.Y),rad(v.Z))end

-- CFrame that puts local point lp at world point wp, local axis la along world axis wa and
-- turns local direction lh as close as possible to world direction wh (fixes the roll).
local function place(lp,la,lh,wp,wa,wh)
 la=la.Unit
 local h=lh-la*lh:Dot(la)
 if h.Magnitude<1e-4 then h=la:Cross(V(1,0,0));if h.Magnitude<1e-4 then h=la:Cross(V(0,0,1))end end
 h=h.Unit
 wa=wa.Unit
 local g=wh-wa*wh:Dot(wa)
 if g.Magnitude<1e-4 then g=wa:Cross(V(1,0,0));if g.Magnitude<1e-4 then g=wa:Cross(V(0,0,1))end end
 g=g.Unit
 local L=CFrame.fromMatrix(ZERO,la,h,la:Cross(h))
 local W=CFrame.fromMatrix(ZERO,wa,g,wa:Cross(g))
 local R=W*L:Inverse()
 return CFrame.new(wp-R:VectorToWorldSpace(lp))*R
end
Rig.place=place

function Rig.new(char,parent)
 local was=char.Archivable;char.Archivable=true
 local ok,actor=pcall(function()return char:Clone()end)
 char.Archivable=was
 assert(ok and actor,"Avatar could not be cloned")
 actor.Name="IntroActor"
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or o:IsA("Animator") or o:IsA("Tool") or o:IsA("ForceField") or o:IsA("Sound")then o:Destroy()
  elseif o:IsA("BasePart")then o.Anchored=true;o.CanCollide=false;o.CanTouch=false;o.CanQuery=false;o.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end
 end
 local root=actor:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");assert(root,"Avatar root missing")
 local hum=actor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");assert(hum,"Avatar humanoid missing")
 root.Anchored=true;root.Transparency=1;actor.PrimaryPart=root
 hum.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
 hum.AutoRotate=false;hum.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;hum.RequiresNeck=false
 local rest,parts={},{}
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA("BasePart")then rest[o]=root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(o.CFrame);parts[#parts+1]=o end
 end
 -- Collect every joint, then remove them: the clone is solved directly, never simulated.
 local links={}
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  local a,b,c0,c1
  if o:IsA("JointInstance")then a,b,c0,c1=o.Part0,o.Part1,o.C0,o.C1
  elseif o:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or o:IsA("RigidConstraint")then
   local at0,at1=o.Attachment0,o.Attachment1
   if at0 and at1 then a,b,c0,c1=at0.Parent,at1.Parent,at0.CFrame,at1.CFrame end
  elseif o:IsA("WeldConstraint")then
   if o.Part0 and o.Part1 and rest[o.Part0] and rest[o.Part1]then a,b,c0,c1=o.Part0,o.Part1,rest[o.Part0]:ToObjectSpace(rest[o.Part1]),CFrame.new()end
  end
  if a and b and a:IsA("BasePart") and b:IsA("BasePart")then links[#links+1]={name=(o.Name:gsub(" ","")),a=a,b=b,c0=c0,c1=c1}end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(actor:GetDescendants())do
  if o:IsA("JointInstance") or o:IsA("Constraint") or o:IsA("WeldConstraint")then o:Destroy()end
 end
 -- Breadth-first order from the root so one pass solves the whole skeleton.
 local adj={}
 for _,l in ipairs(links)do
  adj[l.a]=adj[l.a] or {};adj[l.b]=adj[l.b] or {}
  table.insert(adj[l.a],{l=l,to=l.b,fwd=true});table.insert(adj[l.b],{l=l,to=l.a,fwd=false})
 end
 local order,seen,queue,qi={}, {[root]=true},{root},1
 while qi<=#queue do
  local p=queue[qi];qi+=1
  for _,e in ipairs(adj[p] or {})do
   if not seen[e.to]then seen[e.to]=true;order[#order+1]={l=e.l,from=p,to=e.to,fwd=e.fwd};queue[#queue+1]=e.to end
  end
 end
 local byName={}
 for _,l in ipairs(links)do if not byName[l.name]then byName[l.name]=l end end
 -- Arm chains: R15 shoulder/elbow/wrist (two-bone), R6 shoulder only (single bone).
 local arms={}
 for _,side in ipairs({"Right","Left"})do
  local sh=byName[side.."Shoulder"]
  if sh then
   local A={sh=sh}
   local el,wr=byName[side.."Elbow"],byName[side.."Wrist"]
   if el and wr then
    A.el,A.wr=el,wr
    A.uVec=el.c0.Position-sh.c1.Position;A.uLen=A.uVec.Magnitude
    A.lVec=wr.c0.Position-el.c1.Position;A.lLen=A.lVec.Magnitude
    A.hVec=ZERO-wr.c1.Position;A.hLen=A.hVec.Magnitude
    if A.hLen<.03 then A.hVec=V(0,-.1,0);A.hLen=.1 end
    A.reach=A.uLen+A.lLen+A.hLen
   else
    local palm=V(0,-sh.b.Size.Y*.35,0)
    A.pVec=palm-sh.c1.Position;A.pLen=A.pVec.Magnitude;A.reach=A.pLen
   end
   arms[side]=A
  end
 end
 local self=setmetatable({actor=actor,root=root,hum=hum,rest=rest,parts=parts,links=links,order=order,byName=byName,arms=arms,
  kind=hum.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15"},Rig)
 local S=self:solve(CFrame.new(),nil)
 self.shoulderRest={}
 for side,A in pairs(arms)do self.shoulderRest[side]=(S[A.sh.a]*A.sh.c0).Position end
 local r=arms.Right and arms.Right.reach or 1.5
 local l=arms.Left and arms.Left.reach or 1.5
 self.armReach=math.min(r,l)
 actor.Parent=parent
 return self
end

-- Forward kinematics. rot[jointName]=Vector3 degrees applied about the parent part's axes;
-- off[jointName]=Vector3 studs added to the joint's parent-side offset (used for the neck shrug).
function Rig:solve(world,rot,off)
 local S={[self.root]=world}
 for _,e in ipairs(self.order)do
  local l=e.l
  local v=rot and rot[l.name] or ZERO
  local o=off and off[l.name]
  local T=CFrame.new(o and (l.c0.Position+o) or l.c0.Position)*eul(v)*l.c0.Rotation*l.c1:Inverse()
  if e.fwd then S[e.to]=S[e.from]*T else S[e.to]=S[e.from]*T:Inverse() end
 end
 return S
end

function Rig:shoulder(S,side)
 local A=self.arms[side]
 return A and (S[A.sh.a]*A.sh.c0).Position
end

-- Moves the arm so its palm reaches `target` (world). opts: weight (0..1 blend with FK), pole (world
-- direction the elbow points), forward (world torso forward, roll hint for R6). Returns the palm position.
function Rig:reach(S,side,target,opts)
 local A=self.arms[side];if not A then return nil end
 opts=opts or {}
 local w=opts.weight or 1
 if w<=.001 then return nil end
 local sh=A.sh
 local sp=(S[sh.a]*sh.c0).Position
 local fwd=opts.forward or V(0,0,-1)
 local to=target-sp
 if to.Magnitude<1e-3 then return nil end
 if A.el then
  local wristT=target-to.Unit*A.hLen
  local delta=wristT-sp
  local dir=delta.Magnitude>1e-3 and delta.Unit or to.Unit
  local d=math.clamp(delta.Magnitude,.05,A.uLen+A.lLen-.01)
  local along=(A.uLen^2-A.lLen^2+d^2)/(2*d)
  local rise=math.sqrt(math.max(0,A.uLen^2-along^2))
  local pole=opts.pole or V(0,-1,0)
  pole=pole-dir*pole:Dot(dir)
  if pole.Magnitude<1e-3 then pole=fwd-dir*fwd:Dot(dir)end
  if pole.Magnitude<1e-3 then pole=dir:Cross(V(1,0,0))end
  pole=pole.Unit
  local elbow=sp+dir*along+pole*rise
  local wrist=sp+dir*d
  local front=-pole
  local up=place(sh.c1.Position,A.uVec,V(0,0,-1),sp,elbow-sp,front)
  local lo=place(A.el.c1.Position,A.lVec,V(0,0,-1),elbow,wrist-elbow,front)
  local hdir=(wrist-elbow).Unit
  local ha=place(A.wr.c1.Position,A.hVec,V(0,0,-1),wrist,hdir,front)
  S[sh.b]=S[sh.b]:Lerp(up,w);S[A.el.b]=S[A.el.b]:Lerp(lo,w);S[A.wr.b]=S[A.wr.b]:Lerp(ha,w)
  return wrist+hdir*A.hLen
 end
 local dir=to.Unit
 S[sh.b]=S[sh.b]:Lerp(place(sh.c1.Position,A.pVec,V(0,0,-1),sp,dir,fwd),w)
 return sp+dir*A.pLen
end

function Rig:commit(S)
 local cfs={}
 local rootCF=S[self.root]
 for i,p in ipairs(self.parts)do cfs[i]=S[p] or (rootCF*self.rest[p])end
 workspace:BulkMoveTo(self.parts,cfs,Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

function Rig:fade(x)
 for _,p in ipairs(self.parts)do if p~=self.root then p.LocalTransparencyModifier=x end end
end

function Rig:destroy()
 if self.actor then self.actor:Destroy()end
end

return Rig

-- TreasureIcon (2026-10-01, Claude): draws a treasure's picture for every GUI and the in-world reveal.
-- Uses the item's PNG (TreasureConfig.Images) when set; otherwise an emoji placeholder on a soft bubble.
-- Create(item, {Silhouette = bool, ZIndex = n}) -> Frame filling its parent (put it in a sized, square holder).
-- Silhouette: PNGs are tinted dark (true silhouette); placeholders become a dark "?" bubble.
local M = {}
local SIL = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 60)

function M.Create(item, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local z = opts.ZIndex or 1
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "TreasureIcon"
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	f.ZIndex = z
	if item.Image and item.Image ~= "" then
		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Image"
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.Image = item.Image
		img.ZIndex = z
		if opts.Silhouette then img.ImageColor3 = SIL end
		img.Parent = f
	else
		local bubble = Instance.new("Frame")
		bubble.Name = "Placeholder"
		bubble.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		bubble.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		bubble.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.86)
		bubble.BackgroundColor3 = opts.Silhouette and SIL or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		bubble.BackgroundTransparency = opts.Silhouette and 0.15 or 0.35
		bubble.ZIndex = z
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); corner.Parent = bubble
		Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint").Parent = bubble
		bubble.Parent = f
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		t.Name = "Emoji"
		t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		t.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		t.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.52)
		t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
		t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		t.TextScaled = true
		t.Text = opts.Silhouette and "?" or (item.Emoji or "✨")
		t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		t.ZIndex = z + 1
		t.Parent = bubble
	end
	return f
end

return M

-- TreasureModels (2026-10-01, Claude): chunky procedural 3D treasures for TreasureConfig items (+ the menu chest).
-- Build(item) returns an anchored, non-colliding Model about 2 studs across; PrimaryPart "Root" sits at its centre.
local M = {}
local SMOOTH, NEON = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Neon
local CF, ANG, R = CFrame.new, CFrame.Angles, math.rad
local FACE = ANG(0, R(90), 0)  -- cylinder axis (X) turned to face forward (Z)
local UP = ANG(0, 0, R(90))    -- cylinder axis (X) turned upright (Y)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 60)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function part(m, name, shape, size, color, cf, mat, tr)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or SMOOTH
	p.Transparency = tr or 0
	p.CFrame = cf or CF()
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = m
	return p
end
local function ball(m, n, d, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(d, d, d), c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function block(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Block, s, c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function cyl(m, n, len, d, c, cf, mat, tr) return part(m, n, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(len, d, d), c, cf, mat, tr) end
local function ell(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr)
	local p = block(m, n, s, c, cf, mat, tr)
	local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	sm.Parent = p
	return p
end
local function beads(m, n, radius, count, d, c, cf, mat)
	for i = 1, count do
		local a = i / count * math.pi * 2
		ball(m, n .. i, d, c, cf * CF(math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius, 0), mat)
	end
end
local function shade(c, k) return c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), k) end

function B.cube(m, it)
	local rot = ANG(R(18), R(35), 0)
	block(m, "Cube", Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), it.A, rot)
	local h = 0.65
	for axis = 1, 3 do
		for _, s1 in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
			for _, s2 in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
				local size, off
				if axis == 1 then size, off = Vector3.new(1.4, 0.1, 0.1), Vector3.new(0, s1 * h, s2 * h)
				elseif axis == 2 then size, off = Vector3.new(0.1, 1.4, 0.1), Vector3.new(s1 * h, 0, s2 * h)
				else size, off = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 1.4), Vector3.new(s1 * h, s2 * h, 0) end
				block(m, "Edge", size, it.B, rot * CF(off), NEON)
			end
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do block(m, "Glitch" .. i, Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.22), (i % 2 == 0) and it.B or Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200), CF(math.cos(i * 1.7) * 1.05, math.sin(i * 2.3) * 0.8, 0.5), NEON) end
end

	ell(m, "Body", Vector3.new(1.15, 1.2, 0.95), it.A, CF(0, -0.45, 0))

	ell(m, "ArmR", Vector3.new(0.35, 0.6, 0.35), it.A, CF(0.6, -0.35, 0) * ANG(0, 0, R(20)))
	cyl(m, "Headband", 0.18, 1.0, it.B, CF(0, 0.75, 0) * UP)
end
function B.totem(m, it)
	for i = 0, 2 do
		local y = -0.72 + i * 0.66
		cyl(m, "Seg" .. i, 0.64, 1.05, (i % 2 == 0) and it.A or shade(it.A, 0.18), CF(0, y, 0) * UP)
		ball(m, "EyeL" .. i, 0.18, DARK, CF(-0.2, y + 0.08, 0.48))
		ball(m, "EyeR" .. i, 0.18, DARK, CF(0.2, y + 0.08, 0.48))
		block(m, "Mouth" .. i, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.1, 0.1), it.B, CF(0, y - 0.15, 0.5))
	end
	ell(m, "WingL", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.3, 0.4), it.B, CF(-0.7, 0.75, 0) * ANG(0, 0, R(15)))
	ell(m, "WingR", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.3, 0.4), it.B, CF(0.7, 0.75, 0) * ANG(0, 0, R(-15)))
	ball(m, "Gem", 0.3, it.B, CF(0, 1.05, 0), NEON)
end
function B.medallion(m, it)
	cyl(m, "Disc", 0.36, 1.5, it.A, FACE)
	cyl(m, "Center", 0.42, 0.85, it.B, FACE)
	for i = 0, 7 do
		local a = i / 8 * math.pi * 2
		ell(m, "Ray" .. i, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.5, 0.26), it.A, CF(math.cos(a) * 0.98, math.sin(a) * 0.98, 0) * ANG(0, 0, a - math.pi / 2))

end
function B.shard(m, it)
	block(m, "Shard", Vector3.new(0.7, 1.7, 0.7), it.A, ANG(R(15), R(45), R(25)), SMOOTH, 0.1)
	ball(m, "Glow", 0.5, it.B, CF(), NEON, 0.2)
	for i = 1, 4 do ball(m, "Trail" .. i, 0.38 - i * 0.06, it.A, CF(-0.45 - i * 0.28, -0.35 - i * 0.22, 0), NEON, 0.15 + i * 0.15) end
end
function B.star(m, it)
	ball(m, "Center", 0.85, it.A)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local a = i / 5 * math.pi * 2 + math.pi / 2
		ell(m, "Point" .. i, Vector3.new(0.48, 1.1, 0.42), it.A, CF(math.cos(a) * 0.62, math.sin(a) * 0.62, 0) * ANG(0, 0, a - math.pi / 2))

function B.core(m, it)
	ball(m, "Heart", 1.0, it.A, CF(), NEON, 0.05)
	ball(m, "Shell", 1.45, it.B, CF(), SMOOTH, 0.62)
	beads(m, "RingA", 1.05, 14, 0.17, it.A, ANG(R(90), 0, 0), NEON)

local function newModel(name)
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	local root = block(m, "Root", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), WHITE, CF())
	root.Transparency = 1
	m.PrimaryPart = root
	return m
end
function M.Build(item)
	local m = newModel(item.Id)
	;(B[item.Shape] or B.gem)(m, item)
	return m
end
function M.Chest()
	local m = newModel("TreasureChest")
	local wood, gold = Color3.fromRGB(175, 108, 58), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 70)
	block(m, "Box", Vector3.new(2.0, 1.1, 1.3), wood, CF(0, -0.35, 0))

	block(m, "Lock", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.48, 0.22), gold, CF(0, -0.08, 0.68))
	ball(m, "Gem", 0.3, Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255), CF(0, 0.5, 0.55), NEON)
	return m
end

U.Base = {SizeMult = 1, SpinMult = 1, WalkSpeed = 16, ShovelSlots = 2, PetSlots = 3, PowerBonus = 0, EggDiscount = 0, LuckMult = 1, FriendBoost = 0, RollAnimScale = 1, ReachMult = 1, DoubleRollChance = 0, SnowMult = 1, PowerMult = 1, PetBoostMult = 1, GoldenEvery = 0, RainbowEvery = 0, GoldenLuck = 3, RainbowLuck = 10}
U.Limits = {EggDiscount = {0, 0.5}, DoubleRollChance = {0, 0.5}, RollAnimScale = {0.6, 1}, ReachMult = {1, 1.5}, SpinMult = {1, 1.6}, WalkSpeed = {16, 40}, PetBoostMult = {1, 2}, FriendBoost = {0, 0.2}, GoldenEvery = {0, 10}, RainbowEvery = {0, 100}}
-- lookups
U.ById, U.TreeById = {}, {}
for _, tree in ipairs(U.Trees) do
	U.TreeById[tree.Id] = tree
	tree.ByPos = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
		n.Tree = tree.Id
		U.ById[n.Id] = n
		tree.ByPos[n.Q .. "," .. n.R] = n
	end
end

local DIRS = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}}
function U.Neighbours(n)
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	local out = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
		local nb = tree.ByPos[(n.Q + d[1]) .. "," .. (n.R + d[2])]
		if nb then table.insert(out, nb) end
	end
	return out
end
function U.Distance(n) return math.max(math.abs(n.Q), math.abs(n.R), math.abs(n.Q + n.R)) end
function U.CostOf(n)
	if n.Cost then return n.Cost end
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	return math.floor(tree.BaseCost * tree.Growth ^ U.Distance(n) * (n.CostMult or 1) + 0.5)
end
-- A client and the server use the same stage and adjacency rules.
function U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
 if owned[n.Id] then return "Owned" end
 local stage = n.RequiredStage or "Starter"
 if stage ~= "Starter" and not (stages and stages[stage]) then
  return "Unlock " .. (({Cursed = "Cursed Biome", Crystal = "Crystal Caves", Retro = "Retro World", AbsoluteZero = "Absolute Zero", Portal = "Absolute Zero Portal"})[stage] or stage) .. " first"
 end
 if n.Center then return nil end
 for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then return nil end end
 return "Buy a connected tile first"
end
function U.Available(n, owned, stages) return U.LockReason(n, owned, stages) == nil end
function U.Calculate(owned, friends)
 local stats, mults = table.clone(U.Base), {}
 for id, has in pairs(owned) do
  local n = has and U.ById[id]
  if n and n.Effect then
   local e = n.Effect
   if e[3] == "Mul" then mults[e[1]] = (mults[e[1]] or 1) * (1 + e[2])
   else stats[e[1]] = (stats[e[1]] or 0) + e[2] end
  end
 end
 for k, m in pairs(mults) do stats[k] *= m end
 for k, lim in pairs(U.Limits) do stats[k] = math.clamp(stats[k], lim[1], lim[2]) end
 local friendMult = 1 + stats.FriendBoost * math.clamp(friends or 0, 0, 3)
 stats.SnowMult *= friendMult
 stats.LuckMult *= friendMult
 return stats
end
return U

-- ActivityService (2026-10-02, Claude): server-wide events, daily rewards, quests, achievements and promo codes.
-- Rewards are personal timed boosts (BoostService) or Snow worth N minutes of the player's recent digging,
-- so they stay useful at every stage. Every check happens here; the client only asks (ActivityRemote).
-- Profile: d.Activity (see BoostService.Sanitize). Lifetime snow: d.SnowEarned (counted in DataService.AddSnow).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- PROMO CODES (server only, players can't read this). Add codes here: CODE = reward, same format as ActivityConfig.Daily.
-- Each player can use each code once. Players may type them in any letter case.
local CODES = {
	FROSTFALL = {Boost = "Snow2", Seconds = 900},
	LUCKY = {Boost = "Luck2", Seconds = 900},
	SNOWDAY = {SnowMinutes = 5},
}

local function remote(class, name)
	local r = RS:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = RS end
	return r
end
local fn = remote("RemoteFunction", "ActivityRemote")
local push = remote("RemoteEvent", "ActivityPush")

local rng = Random.new()
local track = {}    -- [player] = {earned = last SnowEarned seen, reward = reward snow to leave out of the speed}
local lastCall = {}

local function nice(x)
	x = math.max(1, x)
	if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
	local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
	return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
end

-- every stat quests/achievements use, straight from the saved profile (none of them reset on rebirth)
local function stats(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local hatches = 0
	for _, n in pairs(d.Pets or {}) do hatches += tonumber(n) or 0 end
	local bases, shovels = {}, 0
	for name, n in pairs(d.Counts or {}) do
		if (tonumber(n) or 0) > 0 then
			local it = Shovels.ByName[name]
			local base = (it and it.Base) or name
			if not bases[base] then bases[base] = true; shovels += 1 end
		end
	end
	local pets = 0
	for _, v in pairs(d.PetIndex or {}) do if v then pets += 1 end end
	return {
		Rolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0,
		SnowEarned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0,
		Hatches = hatches,
		Treasures = tonumber(d.TreasureFound) or 0,
		ShovelsFound = shovels,
		PetsFound = pets,
		Rebirths = tonumber(d.Rebirths) or 0,
		World2 = a.World2 and 1 or 0,
		QuestsDone = a.QuestsDone,
	}
end

local function snowFor(a, minutes) return nice(math.max(100, (a.Rate or 0) * 60 * minutes)) end

local function rewardText(a, r)
	if r.SnowMinutes then return "❄️ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(snowFor(a, r.SnowMinutes)) .. " Snow" end
	return A.RewardText(r)
end

local function grant(player, d, r)
	if r.Boost then
		Boosts.Add(player, r.Boost, r.Seconds)
		return A.RewardText(r)
	elseif r.SnowMinutes then
		local amount = snowFor(d.Activity, r.SnowMinutes)
		local t = track[player]
		if t then t.reward += amount end
		DataService.AddSnow(player, amount)
		return "❄️ +" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(amount) .. " Snow"
	end
	return ""
end

-- returns canClaim, nextDay, nextClaimTime, claimedThrough (for the 7 tiles)
local function daily(a)
	local now = os.time()
	local last = a.Daily.Last
	local lost = last > 0 and now - last > A.DailyStreakReset
	local can = last == 0 or now - last >= A.DailyCooldown
	local nextDay = (lost or a.Daily.Day >= #A.Daily) and 1 or a.Daily.Day + 1
	local through = (lost or (can and nextDay == 1)) and 0 or a.Daily.Day
	return can, nextDay, last + A.DailyCooldown, through
end

-- QUESTS
--------------------------------------------------
local function shuffled(list)
	local t = table.clone(list)
	for i = #t, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
	end
	return t
end

local function newQuests(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local st = stats(d)
	local defs = shuffled(A.Quests)
	local order = {}
	for i = 1, #A.QuestRewards do order[i] = i end
	order = shuffled(order)
	local list = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(A.QuestSlots, #defs) do
		local q = defs[i]
		local goal
		if q.Minutes then
			goal = nice(math.max(150, a.Rate * 60 * q.Minutes[rng:NextInteger(1, #q.Minutes)]))
		else
			goal = q.Amounts[rng:NextInteger(1, #q.Amounts)]
		end
		table.insert(list, {Id = q.Id, Goal = goal, Start = st[q.Stat] or 0, Reward = order[((i - 1) % #order) + 1], Claimed = false, Done = false})
	end
	a.Quests = list
	a.NextQuests = 0
end

local function questProgress(q, st)
	local def = A.QuestById[q.Id]
	if not def then return 0, def end
	return math.clamp((st[def.Stat] or 0) - (tonumber(q.Start) or 0), 0, q.Goal), def
end

-- STATE FOR THE CLIENT
--------------------------------------------------
local function snapshot(d)
	local a = d.Activity
	local st = stats(d)
	local can, nextDay, nextAt, through = daily(a)
	local dailyList = {}
	for i, r in ipairs(A.Daily) do dailyList[i] = rewardText(a, r) end
	local quests = {}
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do
		local prog, def = questProgress(q, st)
		if def then
			table.insert(quests, {Text = string.format(def.Text, NumberFormat.Abbreviate(q.Goal)), Progress = prog, Goal = q.Goal,
				Claimed = q.Claimed == true, Reward = rewardText(a, A.QuestRewards[q.Reward] or A.QuestRewards[1])})
		end
	end
	local ach = {}
	for i, x in ipairs(A.Achievements) do
		ach[i] = {Id = x.Id, Have = a.Achievements[x.Id] == true, Progress = math.min(st[x.Stat] or 0, x.Goal)}
	end
	return {Now = os.time(), Daily = {CanClaim = can, NextDay = nextDay, NextAt = nextAt, Through = through, Rewards = dailyList},
		Quests = quests, NextQuests = a.NextQuests, Achievements = ach}
end

-- TICK: speed, quests, achievements, red dot
--------------------------------------------------
local function tick(player, dt)
	local d, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	if not a then return end
	local t = track[player]
	if not t then t = {earned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0, reward = 0}; track[player] = t end
	if player:GetAttribute("World") == 2 or (type(d.Stages) == "table" and d.Stages.Portal == true) then a.World2 = true end
	local st = stats(d)

	-- recent digging speed (snow per second, ~5 minute average), without reward snow
	local gained = math.max(0, st.SnowEarned - t.earned - t.reward)
	t.earned, t.reward = st.SnowEarned, 0
	a.Rate += (gained / dt - a.Rate) * math.min(1, dt / 300)

	-- quests: first set at once, later sets after the refresh wait
	local allClaimed = #a.Quests > 0
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do if not q.Claimed then allClaimed = false end end
	if #a.Quests == 0 then
		newQuests(d)
	elseif allClaimed and os.time() >= a.NextQuests then
		newQuests(d)
		push:FireClient(player, {Type = "NewQuests"})
	end
	local claimable = false
	for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do
		local prog, def = questProgress(q, st)
		if def and not q.Claimed and prog >= q.Goal then
			claimable = true
			if not q.Done then
				q.Done = true
				push:FireClient(player, {Type = "QuestDone", Text = string.format(def.Text, NumberFormat.Abbreviate(q.Goal))})
			end
		end
	end

	-- achievements (permanent bonuses)
	local unlocked = false
	for _, x in ipairs(A.Achievements) do
		if not a.Achievements[x.Id] and (st[x.Stat] or 0) >= x.Goal then
			a.Achievements[x.Id] = true
			unlocked = true
			push:FireClient(player, {Type = "Achievement", Id = x.Id})
		end
	end
	if unlocked then Boosts.Refresh(player) end

	if daily(a) then claimable = true end
	if player:GetAttribute("ActivityClaimable") ~= claimable then player:SetAttribute("ActivityClaimable", claimable) end
end

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	Boosts.Sanitize(d)
	track[player] = {earned = tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0, reward = 0}
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) track[p] = nil; lastCall[p] = nil end)

task.spawn(function()
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = math.max(0.5, now - last)
		last = now
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if DataService.Get(p) then
				local ok, err = pcall(tick, p, dt)
				if not ok then warn("[ActivityService] " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, arg)
	local d, a = Boosts.Profile(player)
	if not d or not a then return nil end
	if action == "Get" then return snapshot(d) end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCall[player] and now - lastCall[player] < 0.4 then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Slow down!"} end
	lastCall[player] = now

	if action == "ClaimDaily" then
		local can, day = daily(a)
		if not can then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Come back later for your next reward!"} end
		a.Daily.Day = day
		a.Daily.Last = os.time()
		local text = grant(player, d, A.Daily[day])
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Day " .. day .. ": " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}

	elseif action == "ClaimQuest" then
		local q = a.Quests[tonumber(arg) or 0]
		if not q or q.Claimed then return {Ok = false, Msg = "That quest is not available."} end
		local prog = questProgress(q, stats(d))
		if prog < q.Goal then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Finish the quest first!"} end
		q.Claimed = true
		a.QuestsDone += 1
		local text = grant(player, d, A.QuestRewards[q.Reward] or A.QuestRewards[1])
		local all = true
		for _, x in ipairs(a.Quests) do if not x.Claimed then all = false end end
		if all then a.NextQuests = os.time() + A.QuestRefresh end
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Quest reward: " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}

	elseif action == "Redeem" then
		local code = type(arg) == "string" and arg or ""
		code = string.upper(string.gsub(code, "%s", "")):sub(1, 30)
		local r = CODES[code]
		if not r then return {Ok = false, Msg = "That code doesn't exist."} end
		if a.Codes[code] then return {Ok = false, Msg = "You already used this code."} end
		a.Codes[code] = true
		local text = grant(player, d, r)
		return {Ok = true, Msg = "Code redeemed! " .. text, State = snapshot(d)}
	end
	return nil
end
