--------------------------------------------------
local current, token = nil, 0
local function endEvent()
	current = nil
	RS:SetAttribute("EventId", nil)
	RS:SetAttribute("EventEnds", nil)
	Boosts.SetEvent(1, 1)
	push:FireAllClients({Type = "EventEnd"})
end
local function runEvent(e, duration)
	token += 1
	local mine = token
	duration = duration or e.Duration
	current = e
	RS:SetAttribute("EventId", e.Id)
	RS:SetAttribute("EventEnds", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration)
	Boosts.SetEvent(e.Snow, e.Luck)
	push:FireAllClients({Type = "EventStart", Id = e.Id})
	task.delay(duration, function() if token == mine then endEvent() end end)
end
local function pickEvent()
	local total = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(A.Events) do total += e.Weight end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for _, e in ipairs(A.Events) do
		r -= e.Weight
		if r <= 0 then return e end
	end
	return A.Events[1]
end
task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(rng:NextNumber(A.FirstEventDelay[1], A.FirstEventDelay[2]))
	while true do
		if not current then
			local e = pickEvent()
			runEvent(e)
			task.wait(e.Duration)
		end
		task.wait(rng:NextNumber(A.EventGap[1], A.EventGap[2]))
	end
end)

if RunService:IsStudio() and SS:GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true then
	local hook = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	hook.Name = "ActivityTestHook"
	hook.OnInvoke = function(action, player, x, y)
		if action == "Event" then
			local e = A.EventById[x]
			if e then runEvent(e, y or 20); return true end
		elseif action == "EndEvent" then
			token += 1; endEvent(); return true
		end
		local d, a
		if player then d, a = Boosts.Profile(player) end
		if not a then return nil end
		if action == "Snapshot" then
			return snapshot(d)
		elseif action == "FinishQuests" then
			local st = stats(d)
			for _, q in ipairs(a.Quests) do
				local def = A.QuestById[q.Id]
				if def then q.Start = (st[def.Stat] or 0) - q.Goal end
			end
			return true
		elseif action == "Raw" then
			return {Boosts = table.clone(a.Boosts), Achievements = table.clone(a.Achievements), QuestsDone = a.QuestsDone,
				Rate = a.Rate, NextQuests = a.NextQuests, SnowEarned = d.SnowEarned, Snow = d.Snow}
		end
		return nil
	end
	hook.Parent = SS
end

local SUFFIX = {k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12, qa = 1e15, qi = 1e18}
local function amount(s)
	if not s then return nil end
	s = s:lower():gsub(",", "")
	local num, suf = s:match("^(%-?[%d%.]+)(%a*)$")
	num = tonumber(num)
	if not num then return nil end
	if suf ~= "" then
		if not SUFFIX[suf] then return nil end
		num *= SUFFIX[suf]
	end
	return num
end

local function targets(caller, s)
	if not s or s == "" or s:lower() == "me" then return {caller} end
	if s:lower() == "all" then return Players:GetPlayers() end
	local q = s:lower()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return {p} end
	end
	return {}
end

-- finds by exact name, then "starts with", then "contains"; "void" finds "Void Shovel"
local function find(list, q)
	q = (q or ""):lower()
	if q == "" then return nil end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower() == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():sub(1, #q) == q then return it end end
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do if it.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return it end end
	return nil
end

local COMMANDS = {}
local ORDER = {}
local function command(name, usage, fn)
	COMMANDS[name] = {usage = usage, fn = fn}
	table.insert(ORDER, name)
end

command("help", "help", function(caller)
	local lines = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(ORDER) do table.insert(lines, PREFIX .. COMMANDS[n].usage) end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end)

command("snow", "snow <amount> [player]  (1k 2.5m 3b 1t) - give snow", function(caller, args)
	local n = amount(args[1]); if not n then return nil, "Usage: " .. PREFIX .. "snow 1m" end
	local out = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(targets(caller, args[2])) do
		DataService.AddSnow(p, n)
		table.insert(out, p.Name)
	end
	return "Gave " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(n) .. " snow to " .. table.concat(out, ", ")
end)

command("setsnow", "setsnow <amount> [player] - set snow exactly", function(caller, args)
	local n = amount(args[1]); if not n then return nil, "Usage: " .. PREFIX .. "setsnow 0" end
	for _, p in ipairs(targets(caller, args[2])) do
		local d = DataService.Get(p)
		if d then DataService.AddSnow(p, n - d.Snow) end
	end
	return "Snow set to " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(n)
end)

command("shovel", "shovel <name> [count] [player] - give a shovel", function(caller, args)
	local it = find(Config.Items, args[1]); if not it then return nil, "No shovel called '" .. tostring(args[1]) .. "'" end
	local count = math.max(1, math.floor(amount(args[2]) or 1))
	for _, p in ipairs(targets(caller, args[3])) do
		local d = DataService.Get(p)
		if d then d.Counts[it.Name] = (d.Counts[it.Name] or 0) + count; refresh(p) end
	end
	return "Gave " .. count .. "x " .. it.Name
end)

command("pet", "pet <name> [count] [player] - give a pet", function(caller, args)
	local pet = find(allPets, args[1]); if not pet then return nil, "No pet called '" .. tostring(args[1]) .. "'" end
	local count = math.max(1, math.floor(amount(args[2]) or 1))

		local d = DataService.Get(p)

			d.Pets[pet.Name] = (d.Pets[pet.Name] or 0) + count
			d.PetIndex[pet.Name] = true
			refresh(p)
		end
	end
	return "Gave " .. count .. "x " .. pet.Name
end)

command("luck", "luck <multiplier> [player] - set base luck (1 = normal)", function(caller, args)

local function run(player, msg)
	if type(msg) ~= "string" or msg:sub(1, #PREFIX) ~= PREFIX then return end
	if not isAdmin(player) then return end
	local args = {}
	for w in msg:sub(#PREFIX + 1):gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(args, w) end
	local name = table.remove(args, 1)
	local cmd = name and COMMANDS[name:lower()]
	if not cmd then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Unknown command. Type " .. PREFIX .. "help", false)
		return
	end
	local ok, result, err = pcall(cmd.fn, player, args)
	if not ok then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, "Error: " .. tostring(result), false)
	elseif result then
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, result, true)
	else
		cmdEvent:FireClient(player, err or "Failed", false)
	end
end

cmdEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(run)

local function onPlayer(p)
	p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) run(p, msg) end)
	if isAdmin(p) then
		local gui = consoleTemplate:Clone()
		gui.Parent = p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
end

-- BoostService (2026-10-02, Claude): extra Snow/Luck multipliers from server events, personal timed boosts
-- (daily rewards, quests, codes) and permanent achievement bonuses.
-- UpgradeService.apply() multiplies SnowMult/LuckMult by B.Multipliers(player), so everything that already reads
-- those attributes (digging, treasures, rolling, the luck HUD) picks the boosts up automatically.
-- Profile field: d.Activity (sanitized here). Timed boosts only count down while the player is in the game.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local A = require(RS:WaitForChild("ActivityConfig"))

local B = {}
local event = {Snow = 1, Luck = 1}

function B.Sanitize(d)
	if type(d) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local a = type(d.Activity) == "table" and d.Activity or {}
	a.Boosts = type(a.Boosts) == "table" and a.Boosts or {}
	for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
		if not A.Boosts[kind] or type(sec) ~= "number" or sec ~= sec or sec <= 0 then
			a.Boosts[kind] = nil
		else
			a.Boosts[kind] = math.min(sec, A.MaxBoostSeconds)
		end
	end
	a.Achievements = type(a.Achievements) == "table" and a.Achievements or {}
	a.Codes = type(a.Codes) == "table" and a.Codes or {}
	a.Quests = type(a.Quests) == "table" and a.Quests or {}
	a.Daily = type(a.Daily) == "table" and a.Daily or {}
	a.Daily.Day = tonumber(a.Daily.Day) or 0
	a.Daily.Last = tonumber(a.Daily.Last) or 0
	a.NextQuests = tonumber(a.NextQuests) or 0
	a.QuestsDone = tonumber(a.QuestsDone) or 0
	a.World2 = a.World2 == true
	a.Rate = tonumber(a.Rate) or 0
	if a.Rate ~= a.Rate or a.Rate < 0 or a.Rate == math.huge then a.Rate = 0 end
	d.Activity = a
	return a
end

-- always the live profile (OnLoaded hands later joiners a copy, so never keep that one)
function B.Profile(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d and type(d.Activity) ~= "table" then B.Sanitize(d) end
	return d, d and d.Activity
end

function B.Permanent(a)
	local s, l = 0, 0
	for id, have in pairs(a.Achievements) do
		local ach = have and A.AchievementById[id]
		if ach then s += ach.Snow or 0; l += ach.Luck or 0 end
	end
	return s, l
end

function B.Personal(a)
	local s, l = 1, 1
	for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
		local k = A.Boosts[kind]
		if k and sec > 0 then s = math.max(s, k.Snow); l = math.max(l, k.Luck) end
	end
	return s, l
end

function B.Multipliers(player)
	local snow, luck = event.Snow, event.Luck
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	if a then
		local ps, pl = B.Personal(a)
		local qs, ql = B.Permanent(a)
		snow *= ps * (1 + qs)
		luck *= pl * (1 + ql)
	end
	return snow, luck
end

local function publish(player, a)
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for kind in pairs(A.Boosts) do
		local sec = a and a.Boosts[kind]
		player:SetAttribute("BoostEnds_" .. kind, (sec and sec > 0) and (now + sec) or nil)
	end
	local s, l = 0, 0
	if a then s, l = B.Permanent(a) end
	player:SetAttribute("AchSnowBonus", s)
	player:SetAttribute("AchLuckBonus", l)
end

-- recompute this player's stats (UpgradeService listens to AdminHooks.ReapplyUpgrades)
function B.Refresh(player)
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	publish(player, a)
	local hooks = SS:FindFirstChild("AdminHooks")
	local ev = hooks and hooks:FindFirstChild("ReapplyUpgrades")
	if ev then ev:Fire(player) end
end

function B.Add(player, kind, seconds)
	local _, a = B.Profile(player)
	if not a or not A.Boosts[kind] or type(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds <= 0 then return false end
	a.Boosts[kind] = math.min(A.MaxBoostSeconds, (a.Boosts[kind] or 0) + seconds)
	B.Refresh(player)
	return true
end

function B.SetEvent(snow, luck)
	event.Snow, event.Luck = snow or 1, luck or 1
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if DataService.Get(p) then B.Refresh(p) end
	end
end

function B.EventMultipliers() return event.Snow, event.Luck end

-- countdown (only while in the game)
task.spawn(function()
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - last
		last = now
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local d = DataService.Get(p)
			local a = d and d.Activity
			if type(a) == "table" and type(a.Boosts) == "table" and next(a.Boosts) then
				local expired = false
				for kind, sec in pairs(a.Boosts) do
					sec -= dt
					if sec <= 0 then a.Boosts[kind] = nil; expired = true else a.Boosts[kind] = sec end
				end
				if expired then B.Refresh(p) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

DataService.OnLoaded(function(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d then B.Sanitize(d); B.Refresh(player) end
end)

return B

-- DataService: one place that loads/saves each player's data.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local RebirthConfig = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local StarterShovelRules = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("StarterShovelRules"))
local DataService = {}
local data = {}
local loaded = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

-- Studio-only clean balance sessions neither load nor save real progress.
-- Set ServerStorage's BalanceTestMode attribute before pressing Play to opt in.
local testMode = game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and game:GetService("ServerStorage"):GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true
local store
if not testMode then pcall(function() store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("RNGData_v1") end) end

local function defaults(d)
	d.Rebirths = RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths)
	d.Counts = type(d.Counts) == "table" and d.Counts or {}
	d.TotalRolls = tonumber(d.TotalRolls) or 0
	d.Snow = tonumber(d.Snow) or 0
	d.Stages = type(d.Stages) == "table" and d.Stages or {}
	d.Upgrades = type(d.Upgrades) == "table" and d.Upgrades or {}
	d.Settings = type(d.Settings) == "table" and d.Settings or {}
	d.Luck = tonumber(d.Luck) or 1 -- roll luck multiplier (luck upgrades raise this)
	if type(d.Equipped) == "string" then d.Equipped = {d.Equipped} end
	if type(d.Equipped) ~= "table" then d.Equipped = {} end
	StarterShovelRules.Apply(d)
	d.Pets = type(d.Pets) == "table" and d.Pets or {}
	d.EquippedPets = type(d.EquippedPets) == "table" and d.EquippedPets or {}
	d.PetIndex = type(d.PetIndex) == "table" and d.PetIndex or {}
	for name, n in pairs(d.Pets) do if n > 0 then d.PetIndex[name] = true end end
	return d
end

local function stat(ls, name, value)
	local v = Instance.new("IntValue")
	v.Name = name
	v.Value = value
	v.Parent = ls
end

local function load(player)
	if data[player] then return end
	local saved
	if store then
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId) end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then saved = res end
	end
	if not player.Parent then return end
	local d = defaults(saved or {})
	data[player] = d
	player:SetAttribute("BalanceTestSession", testMode)
	player:SetAttribute("StarterShovelName", StarterShovelRules.Name)

	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	stat(ls, "Snow", d.Snow)
	stat(ls, "Rolls", d.TotalRolls)
	stat(ls, "Rebirths", d.Rebirths)
	ls.Parent = player

	loaded:Fire(player, d)
end

-- Serialize autosave, rebirth, and leave saves so an older write cannot finish last.
local saving, saveAgain = {}, {}
local function save(player)
 if not store or not data[player] then return end
 if saving[player] then
  saveAgain[player] = true
  repeat task.wait() until not saving[player]
  return
 end
 saving[player] = true
 repeat
  saveAgain[player] = nil
  local snapshot = game.HttpService:JSONDecode(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(data[player]))
  local ok, err
  for attempt = 1, 3 do
   ok, err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, snapshot) end)
   if ok then break end
   if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt) end
  end
  if not ok then warn("[DataService] Save failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
 until not saveAgain[player]
 saving[player] = nil
end
function DataService.Save(player) save(player) end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return data[player]
end

-- run callback for every player whose data is loaded (now and in the future)
function DataService.OnLoaded(callback)
	for p, d in pairs(data) do task.spawn(callback, p, d) end
	return loaded.Event:Connect(callback)
end

function DataService.SetStat(player, name, value)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local v = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v then v.Value = value end
end

function DataService.AddSnow(player, amount)
	local d = data[player]
	if not d then return end
	d.Snow += amount
	if amount > 0 then d.SnowEarned = (tonumber(d.SnowEarned) or 0) + amount end -- lifetime snow for quests/achievements (2026-10-02)
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(load)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(load, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	data[player] = nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do save(p) end
end)
task.spawn(function() -- autosave
	while true do
		task.wait(120)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save, p) end

end)

local function rollPet(egg)
	local total = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do total += p.Chance end
	local r = math.random() * total
	for _, p in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		r -= p.Chance
		if r <= 0 then return p end
	end
	return egg.Pets[1]
end

local function hatch(player, egg, eggPart)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	if egg.RequiredStage and egg.RequiredStage ~= "Starter" and d.Stages[egg.RequiredStage] ~= true then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp or (hrp.Position - eggPart.Position).Magnitude > 20 then return end
	local cost = math.floor(egg.Cost * (1 - (player:GetAttribute("EggDiscount") or 0)) + 0.5)
	if d.Snow < cost then
		hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "NotEnough", egg.Id, cost)
		return
	end
	lastHatch[player] = now
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -cost)
	local pet = rollPet(egg)
	local isNew = not d.PetIndex[pet.Name]
	d.PetIndex[pet.Name] = true
	d.Pets[pet.Name] = (d.Pets[pet.Name] or 0) + 1
	if #d.EquippedPets < slotsFor(player) then
		table.insert(d.EquippedPets, pet.Name)
		task.delay(2.5, function() if DataService.Get(player) == d then publish(player, d) end end)
	end
	hatchedEvent:FireClient(player, "Hatched", egg.Id, pet.Name, isNew, d.Pets, d.EquippedPets, d.PetIndex)
end

-- rarest first, each at its own "1 in N"
local sorted = table.clone(Config.Items)
table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.Chance > b.Chance end)
local function roll(luck)
	luck = luck or 1
	for _, item in ipairs(sorted) do
		if item.Chance > 1 and math.random() < luck / item.Chance then return item.Name end
	end
	return sorted[#sorted].Name
end

-- Mutations (2026-10-01): each rolled shovel independently can be Shiny (1 in 10) and/or Giant (1 in 5).
local function mutate(name)
	local ids = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations or {}) do
		if math.random() < 1 / m.Chance then table.insert(ids, m.Id) end
	end
	return #ids > 0 and Config.VariantName(name, ids) or name
end

local function copies(list, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

	lastRoll[player] = now

	-- luck = base (admin/events) x LuckMult (upgrade %s, rebirths, friends). Shovels give power, not luck (2026-10-01).
	local luck = (d.Luck or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("TotalLuck", luck)
	-- Golden / Rainbow dice (2026-10-01): every Nth lifetime roll gets a luck boost; Rainbow wins when both land.
	local rollNumber = (d.TotalRolls or 0) + 1
	local special
	local rainbowEvery = math.floor(player:GetAttribute("RainbowEvery") or 0)
	local goldenEvery = math.floor(player:GetAttribute("GoldenEvery") or 0)

	local result = mutate(roll(luck))
	d.Counts[result] = (d.Counts[result] or 0) + 1
	d.TotalRolls += 1

-- Pure server-side transaction rules; no yields occur between validation and reset.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Shovels = require(RS:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Pets = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local Stages = require(RS:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local Upgrades = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local Rules = {}

function Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not d then return false, "Your progress is still loading." end
 if type(expected) ~= "number" or expected ~= R.Count(d.Rebirths) then
  return false, "Your rebirth changed. Check the rewards and try again."
 end
 local req = R.Requirement(d.Rebirths)
 if not req then return false, "You reached the maximum rebirth level!" end
 if not d.Stages or d.Stages[req.Stage] ~= true then
  return false, "Unlock " .. Stages.ById[req.Stage].Name .. " first."
 end
 if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow == math.huge or d.Snow < req.Cost then
  return false, "You need more Snow to rebirth."
 end
 return true, req
end

local function equippedAfterReset(list, owned, byName, slots, score)
 local clean, used = {}, {}
 for _, name in ipairs(list or {}) do
  if byName[name] and (used[name] or 0) < (owned[name] or 0) then
   used[name] = (used[name] or 0) + 1
   table.insert(clean, name)
  end
 end
 table.sort(clean, function(a, b) return score(byName[a]) > score(byName[b]) end)
 while #clean > slots do table.remove(clean) end
 return clean
end

function Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 local ok, req = Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, req end
 -- Compute the new equipped sets before changing the profile.
 local equipped = equippedAfterReset(d.Equipped, d.Counts, Shovels.ByName, Upgrades.Base.ShovelSlots, function(x) return x.Chance end)
 local pets = equippedAfterReset(d.EquippedPets, d.Pets, Pets.PetByName, Upgrades.Base.PetSlots, function(x) return x.Boost end)
 d.Rebirths = req.Level
 d.Snow = 0
 d.Stages = {}
 d.Upgrades = {}
 d.Equipped = equipped
 d.EquippedPets = pets
 -- Counts, Pets, PetIndex, Settings, TotalRolls and base luck are preserved.
 return true, req
end
return Rules

-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- Every shovel arm that sweeps over a tile deals its Power as damage; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local treasureModule = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("TreasureService")
local okTreasures, Treasures = false, nil
if treasureModule then okTreasures, Treasures = pcall(require, treasureModule) end
if not okTreasures then warn("[SnowFieldService] TreasureService unavailable: " .. tostring(Treasures)); Treasures = nil end
local treasureWarned = false
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local SPEED = SF.Spinner.Speed
local R_IN, R_OUT = SF.Spinner.Inner, SF.Spinner.Outer
local HUB = 1.6 -- grip ring radius (ShovelOrbit INNER); a Giant shovel doubles the reach beyond it
local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

local lastTime = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
	lastTime[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- damage and size per arm, from each equipped shovel (Giant mutation = Size 2)
local function armPowers(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels")
	local list, sizes = {}, {}
	if not attr or attr == "" then return list, sizes end
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		table.insert(list, item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1)
		table.insert(sizes, item and item.Size or 1)
	end
	return list, sizes
end

local function collect(player, st, now)
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then lastTime[player]=now; return end
	local prev = lastTime[player]
	lastTime[player] = now
	if not prev then return end
	local powers, sizes = armPowers(player)
	local spd = SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1)
	local rOut = R_OUT * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)
	local maxSize = 1
	for _, sz in ipairs(sizes) do maxSize = math.max(maxSize, sz) end
	local rFar = HUB + (rOut - HUB) * maxSize -- furthest arm (Giant shovels reach further)
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	local n = #powers
	if n == 0 then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local sweep = math.min((now - prev) * spd, TWO_PI)
	local pos = root.Position
	local gained = 0

	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Z - origin.Z
		if lx > -rFar and lz > -rFar and lx < f.Width * TS + rFar and lz < f.Depth * TS + rFar
			and math.abs(pos.Y - origin.Y) < 9 then
			local s = st[id]
			local x0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lx - rFar) / TS))
			local x1 = math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((lx + rFar) / TS))
			local z0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lz - rFar) / TS))
			local z1 = math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((lz + rFar) / TS))
			for k = 0, n - 1 do
				local dmg = (powers[k + 1] + bonus) * pmult
				local a0 = prev * spd + k * (TWO_PI / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				local rArm = HUB + (rOut - HUB) * (sizes[k + 1] or 1)
				for x = x0, x1 do
					for z = z0, z1 do
						local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
						if s.phases[i] > 0 then
							local dx = origin.X + (x + 0.5) * TS - pos.X
							local dz = origin.Z + (z + 0.5) * TS - pos.Z
							local d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
							if d2 >= R_IN * R_IN and d2 <= rArm * rArm
								and (math.atan2(dz, dx) - a0) % TWO_PI <= sweep then
								local hp = s.hp[i] - dmg
								local p = s.phases[i]
								-- strong shovels can break several layers in one hit
								while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do
									p -= 1
									gained += f.SnowPerPhase
									hp += maxHP
								end
								if p == 0 then
									hp = maxHP
									-- Buried Treasures (2026-10-01): a fully dug tile may hide a treasure (TreasureService decides)
									if Treasures then
										local okT, errT = pcall(Treasures.TileCleared, player, f, SF.TileCenter(f, x, z))
										if not okT and not treasureWarned then treasureWarned = true; warn("[Treasures] " .. tostring(errT)) end
									end
								end
								s.phases[i] = p
								s.hp[i] = hp
								s.pending[i] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if gained > 0 then
		-- equipped pets boost the snow you earn
		local pets = {}
		for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
		gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
		DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
		collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained)
	end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local acc, regrowAcc = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	regrowAcc += dt
	if acc < TICK then return end
	acc = 0
	local doRegrow = regrowAcc >= 1
	if doRegrow then regrowAcc = 0 end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local st = getStates(player)
		collect(player, st, now)
		if doRegrow then regrow(st) end
		flush(player, st)
	end
end)

local function isOpen(d, id)
	if id == "Starter" or d.Stages[id] == true then return true end
	-- Cost 0 stages (World 2's first stage) open together with the stage before them (2026-10-02)
	local s = S.ById[id]
	local prev = (s and s.Cost == 0) and S.Previous(id) or nil
	return prev ~= nil and isOpen(d, prev.Id)
end

	for _, s in ipairs(S.Order) do player:SetAttribute("Stage_" .. s.Id, isOpen(d, s.Id)) end
end

	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	local s = type(id) == "string" and S.ById[id]
	if not d or not s then return false, "Unknown stage" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if last[player] and now - last[player] < 0.3 then return false, "Slow down" end
	last[player] = now

	local prev = S.Previous(id)
	if prev and not isOpen(d, prev.Id) then return false, "Unlock " .. prev.Name .. " first" end
	if d.Snow < s.Cost then return false, "Not enough snow" end
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -s.Cost)
	d.Stages[id] = true
	publish(player)
	return true
end

-- TreasureService (2026-10-01, Claude): Buried Treasures, fully server-side (RNG, ownership, Snow rewards).
-- SnowFieldService calls TileCleared(player, field, tilePos) whenever one of the player's tiles is dug down to 0 layers.
-- Each call: first-find guarantee, else TreasureConfig.TileChance -> rarity by weight -> that biome's item for the rarity.
-- Award: Snow bonus = rarity Bonus x one full tile's Snow x the player's Snow multipliers; the item enters d.Treasures.
-- Profile fields (saved with the rest of the profile; rebirth keeps them): Treasures, TreasureNew, TreasureFound, TreasureDug.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SS = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local function remote(class, name)

	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = RS end
	return r
end
local foundEvent = remote("RemoteEvent", "TreasureFound")
local treasureRemote = remote("RemoteFunction", "TreasureRemote")

local T = {}
local recent = {}
local rng = Random.new()

local function sanitize(d)
	d.Treasures = type(d.Treasures) == "table" and d.Treasures or {}
	d.TreasureNew = type(d.TreasureNew) == "table" and d.TreasureNew or {}
	d.TreasureFound = tonumber(d.TreasureFound) or 0
	d.TreasureDug = tonumber(d.TreasureDug) or 0
	d.Settings = type(d.Settings) == "table" and d.Settings or {}
end
-- OnLoaded hands later joiners a COPY of the profile (BindableEvent), so always work on DataService.Get(player).
local function profile(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if d and type(d.Treasures) ~= "table" then sanitize(d) end
	return d
end

	local d = profile(player)

end)

-- same multipliers SnowFieldService applies to dug Snow (pets x pet boosts x SnowMult incl. upgrades, rebirths, friends)
local function snowMultiplier(player)
	local pets = {}
	for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
	return (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1)
end

local function pickRarity()
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * TC.TotalWeight
	for _, rar in ipairs(TC.Rarities) do
		r -= rar.Weight
		if r <= 0 then return rar end
	end
	return TC.Rarities[1]
end

local function award(player, d, item, field, pos, guaranteed)
	local rar = TC.RarityById[item.Rarity]
	local tileSnow = ((field and field.SnowPerPhase) or 1) * SF.MaxPhase
	local bonus = math.max(1, math.floor(tileSnow * rar.Bonus * snowMultiplier(player) + 0.5))
	local count = (tonumber(d.Treasures[item.Id]) or 0) + 1
	local isNew = count == 1
	d.Treasures[item.Id] = count
	if isNew then d.TreasureNew[item.Id] = true end
	d.TreasureFound += 1
	DataService.AddSnow(player, bonus)
	player:SetAttribute("TreasuresFound", d.TreasureFound)
	foundEvent:FireClient(player, {Id = item.Id, New = isNew, Count = count, Snow = bonus, Pos = pos, First = guaranteed == true})
	if rar.Announce then
		for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = other ~= player and other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude <= TC.AnnounceRadius then
				foundEvent:FireClient(other, {Id = item.Id, Announce = true, Finder = player.DisplayName, Pos = pos})
			end
		end
	end
	return bonus
end

function T.TileCleared(player, field, pos)
	local d = profile(player)
	if not d then return end
	local biome = TC.BiomeFor(field and field.Style)
	if d.TreasureFound == 0 then
		d.TreasureDug += 1
		if d.TreasureDug >= TC.GuaranteeAfterTiles then
			award(player, d, biome.ByRarity.Common, field, pos, true)
			return
		end
	end
	if rng:NextNumber() >= TC.TileChance then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local r = recent[player]
	if not r or now - r.t > 1 then r = {t = now, n = 0}; recent[player] = r end
	if r.n >= TC.MaxPerSecond then return end
	r.n += 1
	award(player, d, biome.ByRarity[pickRarity().Id], field, pos, false)
end

	local d = profile(player)
	if not d then return nil end
	if action == "Get" then
		return {Treasures = d.Treasures, New = d.TreasureNew, Found = d.TreasureFound,
			Sound = d.Settings.TreasureSound ~= false, Reduced = d.Settings.TreasureReduced == true}
	elseif action == "Seen" and type(arg) == "table" then
		for _, id in ipairs(arg) do if type(id) == "string" then d.TreasureNew[id] = nil end end
		return true
	elseif action == "Settings" and type(arg) == "table" then
		if type(arg.Sound) == "boolean" then d.Settings.TreasureSound = arg.Sound end
		if type(arg.Reduced) == "boolean" then d.Settings.TreasureReduced = arg.Reduced end
		return true
	end
	return nil
end

local function owned(d)

local function apply(player)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return end
	local set = owned(d)
	local stats = U.Calculate(set, friendCount[player] or 0)
 local snow, luck = RebirthConfig.Multipliers(d.Rebirths)
 stats.SnowMult *= snow
 stats.LuckMult *= luck
 if Boosts then
  local okB, bs, bl = pcall(Boosts.Multipliers, player)
  if okB then
   stats.SnowMult *= bs
   stats.LuckMult *= bl
   player:SetAttribute("BoostSnowMult", bs)
   player:SetAttribute("BoostLuckMult", bl)
  end
 end
 player:SetAttribute("Rebirths", RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths))
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthSnowMult", snow)
 player:SetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult", luck)
 DataService.SetStat(player, "Rebirths", RebirthConfig.Count(d.Rebirths))
	for k, v in pairs(stats) do player:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	player:SetAttribute("FriendsHere", friendCount[player] or 0)
	for id in pairs(U.ById) do player:SetAttribute("Up_" .. id, set[id] == true) end

	local list = Players:GetPlayers()
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		task.spawn(function()
			local n = 0
			for _, other in ipairs(list) do
				if other ~= p then
					local ok, isFriend = pcall(function() return p:IsFriendsWith(other.UserId) end)
					if ok and isFriend then n += 1 end
				end
			end
			friendCount[p] = n
			apply(p)
		end)
	end
end

	local now = os.clock()

local function musicOn() return player:GetAttribute("MusicOn") ~= false end
local function targetVolume()
	if not musicOn() then return 0 end
	return player:GetAttribute("MusicDuck") and cfg.DuckVolume or cfg.Volume
end
local function applyVolume(t)
	TweenService:Create(group, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.6), {Volume = targetVolume()}):Play()

-- playlist
local order = {}
local function reshuffle()
	order = table.clone(cfg.Tracks)
	if cfg.Shuffle then
		for i = #order, 2, -1 do
			local j = math.random(i)
			order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
		end
	end
end
local index = 0
local function nextId()
	index += 1
	if index > #order then
		local last = order[#order]
		reshuffle()
		if #order > 1 and order[1] == last then order[1], order[2] = order[2], order[1] end
		index = 1
	end
	return order[index]
end

local function newSound(id)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = 0
	s.SoundGroup = group
	s.Parent = SoundService
	return s
end

task.spawn(function()
	if #cfg.Tracks == 0 then return end
	reshuffle()
	applyVolume(0)
	local current
	local holdForIntro = cfg.StartAfterIntro ~= false
	while true do
		local s = newSound(nextId())
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while not s.IsLoaded and os.clock() - t0 < 10 do task.wait(0.2) end
		if not s.IsLoaded or s.TimeLength <= 0 then
			s:Destroy() -- broken / moderated track: skip it
			task.wait(1)
		else
			if holdForIntro then
				-- loaded and ready: keep the very first track silent until the arrival cinematic is over.
				-- SnowIntro sets IntroReady when it finishes, is skipped or fails; 90 s cap so music can never be lost.
				holdForIntro = false
				local waitStart = os.clock()
				while player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") ~= true and os.clock() - waitStart < 90 do task.wait(0.1) end
			end
			s:Play()
			TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(cfg.Crossfade), {Volume = 1}):Play()
			if current then
				local old = current
				TweenService:Create(old, TweenInfo.new(cfg.Crossfade), {Volume = 0}):Play()
				task.delay(cfg.Crossfade + 0.1, function() old:Destroy() end)
			end
			current = s
			-- wait until it's time to start the next track (overlapping by the crossfade)
			task.wait(math.max(1, s.TimeLength - cfg.Crossfade))
		end
	end
end)

-- SnowFieldClient: builds the snow tiles locally and animates changes sent by the server.
-- Fields are STREAMED: only fields near you are built (a few hundred tiles per frame), far ones are removed.
-- The LOOK of the tiles comes from ReplicatedStorage > SnowStages > <Stage>:
--   Phase3 / Phase2 / Phase1 : Material, MaterialVariant, Color, Transparency, Reflectance, and HEIGHT (Size.Y)
--   Floor                    : the field floor (Size.Y = thickness)
--   Puff                     : particle emitters burst on every scrape (attribute EmitCount per emitter)
--   folder attributes        : Gap, HeightJitter
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")
local stylesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowStages")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))

local TS = SF.TileSize
local BUILD_DISTANCE = 170     -- build a field when you're this close to its edge
local UNLOAD_DISTANCE = 240    -- remove it when you're this far
local TILES_PER_FRAME = 250    -- spread building over frames (no stutter)

local root = Instance.new("Folder")
root.Name = "SnowFieldsVisual"
root.Parent = workspace

local function lockDown(p)
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- STYLES
--------------------------------------------------
local styleCache = {}
local function getStyle(name)
	if styleCache[name] then return styleCache[name] end
	local s = stylesFolder:FindFirstChild(name or "Starter") or stylesFolder:WaitForChild("Starter")
	local st = {
		phases = {},
		floor = s:FindFirstChild("Floor"),
		puff = s:FindFirstChild("Puff"),
		gap = s:GetAttribute("Gap") or 0.15,
		jitter = s:GetAttribute("HeightJitter") or 0.18,
	}
	for p = 1, SF.MaxPhase do st.phases[p] = s:WaitForChild("Phase" .. p) end
	styleCache[name] = st
	return st
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- FIELD DATA (always kept) + VISUALS (only when near)
--------------------------------------------------
local fields = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	local n = f.Width * f.Depth
	local fd = {def = f, style = getStyle(f.Style or "Starter"), phases = table.create(n, SF.MaxPhase), hp = table.create(n, 100),
		jitter = {}, built = false, building = false}
	for i = 1, n do fd.jitter[i] = (math.random() - 0.5) * fd.style.jitter end
	local o = SF.Origin(f)
	fd.minX, fd.minZ = o.X, o.Z
	fd.maxX, fd.maxZ = o.X + f.Width * TS, o.Z + f.Depth * TS
	fields[f.Id] = fd
end

local function heightOf(style, p, jitter)
	if p <= 0 then return 0.1 end
	return style.phases[p].Size.Y + jitter
end

local function tileCenter(fd, i)
	local f = fd.def
	local x = (i - 1) % f.Width
	local z = (i - 1) // f.Width
	return SF.TileCenter(f, x, z)
end

local function apply(fd, i, p, animate, growing)
	local part = fd.parts[i]
	if not part then return end
	local style = fd.style
	local h = heightOf(style, p, fd.jitter[i])
	if p > 0 then
		-- damaged layers sink toward the layer below (100% HP = full height)
		local lower = p > 1 and heightOf(style, p - 1, fd.jitter[i]) or 0.1
		local frac = (fd.hp[i] or 100) / 100
		h = lower + (h - lower) * (0.3 + 0.7 * frac)
	end
	local tp = style.phases[math.max(p, 1)]
	part.Material = tp.Material
	part.MaterialVariant = tp.MaterialVariant
	part.Reflectance = tp.Reflectance
	local g = {
		Size = Vector3.new(TS - style.gap, h, TS - style.gap),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(fd.centers[i] + Vector3.new(0, fd.floorTop + h / 2, 0)),
		Color = tp.Color,
		Transparency = p <= 0 and 1 or tp.Transparency,
	}
	if animate then
		local info = growing and TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			or TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		TweenService:Create(part, info, g):Play()
	else
		for k, v in pairs(g) do part[k] = v end
	end
end

local function puff(fd, pos, big)
	if not fd.puff then return end
	fd.puff.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	for _, e in ipairs(fd.puff:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local n = e:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 2
			e:Emit(big and n + 1 or n)
		end
	end
end

local function hitPuff(fd, pos)
	if not fd.puff then return end
	fd.puff.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	for _, e in ipairs(fd.puff:GetChildren()) do
		if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then e:Emit(1) end
	end
end

local function buildVisual(fd)
	if fd.built or fd.building then return end
	fd.building = true
	local f, style = fd.def, fd.style
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = f.Id
	fd.folder = folder
	fd.floorTop = 0
	if style.floor then
		local floor = style.floor:Clone()
		floor.Name = "FieldFloor"
		lockDown(floor)
		floor.Size = Vector3.new(f.Width * TS + 0.8, style.floor.Size.Y, f.Depth * TS + 0.8)
		floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(f.Center + Vector3.new(0, style.floor.Size.Y / 2, 0))
		floor.Parent = folder
		fd.floorTop = style.floor.Size.Y
	end
	if style.puff then
		fd.puff = style.puff:Clone()
		lockDown(fd.puff)
		fd.puff.Transparency = 1
		fd.puff.Parent = folder
	end
	fd.parts, fd.centers = {}, {}
	folder.Parent = root
	local base = style.phases[SF.MaxPhase]
	local n = f.Width * f.Depth
	for i = 1, n do
		if not fd.building then return end -- unloaded while building
		local part = base:Clone()
		part.Name = "Snow"
		lockDown(part)
		part.CastShadow = false
		fd.centers[i] = tileCenter(fd, i)
		fd.parts[i] = part
		apply(fd, i, fd.phases[i], false)
		part.Parent = folder
		if i % TILES_PER_FRAME == 0 then task.wait() end
	end
	fd.building = false
	fd.built = true
end

local function destroyVisual(fd)
	fd.building = false
	fd.built = false
	if fd.folder then fd.folder:Destroy() end
	fd.folder, fd.parts, fd.centers, fd.puff = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- server updates: always update the data, animate only if the field is built
updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id, flat)
	local fd = fields[id]
	if not fd then return end
	for j = 1, #flat, 3 do
		local i, p, hp = flat[j], flat[j + 1], flat[j + 2]
		local old, oldHp = fd.phases[i], fd.hp[i]
		if old and (p ~= old or hp ~= oldHp) then
			fd.phases[i] = p
			fd.hp[i] = hp
			if fd.built then
				apply(fd, i, p, true, p > old)
				local top = fd.centers[i] + Vector3.new(0, fd.floorTop + heightOf(fd.style, math.max(old, 1), 0), 0)
				if p < old then
					puff(fd, top, old == SF.MaxPhase)      -- layer broke
				elseif p == old and hp < oldHp then
					hitPuff(fd, top)                       -- just damaged
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

 local view=camera.CFrame.Position
 for i=#entries,1,-1 do

   elseif e.kind=="Sway"then cf=e.base*CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t)*e.amount,0,math.sin(t*.73+1.3)*e.amount*.6)

   elseif e.kind=="Roll"then
    local x=math.sin(t)*e.radius
    cf=e.base*CFrame.new(x,math.abs(math.sin(t*5))*e.amount,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-x/1.3)
   else cf=CFrame.new(0,math.sin(t)*e.amount,0)*e.base end
   if o:IsA("Model")then o:PivotTo(cf)else o.CFrame=cf end
  end
 end
 if particleTick>.4 then

  for e in particles do

local function makeArrow(parent, len, thick)
	local a = mk("Frame", {Name = "Arrow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len * 2, len * 2), ZIndex = 7}, parent)
	local function bar(x, y, w, rot, color, z, tr)
		local b = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, thick),
			Rotation = rot, BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z}, a)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, b)
	end
	local head = len * 0.45
	local ang = math.rad(40)
	for _, layer in ipairs({{3, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 7, 0.6}, {0, WHITE, 8, 0}}) do -- soft shadow, then white
		local o, col, z, tr = layer[1], layer[2], layer[3], layer[4]
		bar(len - len * 0.45 + o, len + o, len * 0.9, 0, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len - head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, 40, col, z, tr)
		bar(len - head / 2 * math.cos(ang) + o, len + head / 2 * math.sin(ang) + o, head, -40, col, z, tr)
	end
	return a
end

	-- Wait for startup too: IntroPlaying is still nil while the avatar loads.
	local intro = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("SnowIntro")
	if intro and intro.Enabled then
		if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroReady") == true end) then return end
	end
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	task.wait(1)
	if not waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") ~= true end) then return end
	sg.Enabled = true

	local bottom = rngGui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
	local rollB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton")
	local upB = bottom:WaitForChild("UpgradesButton")

	-- 1) roll
	say("Your "..(player:GetAttribute("StarterShovelName") or "Tin Shovel").." is ready!\nTap the dice to roll another shovel!")
	pointAt(rollB)
	local rolled = false
	local conn = rngGui:WaitForChild("RollFinished").Event:Connect(function() rolled = true end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return rolled end) then conn:Disconnect() return end
	conn:Disconnect()

	-- 2) the spinner
	pointAt(nil)
	say("Nice! Your shovel spins around you ❄")
	task.wait(2.8)
	if cancelled then return end

	-- 3) dig in the snow field
	local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
	local field
	for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "FrostfallSnowYard" then field = f break end end
	if not field then
		for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do if f.Id == "Starter" or f.Style == "Starter" then field = f break end end
	end
	local snow = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Snow")
	local start = snow.Value
	local GOAL = 10
	if field then pointWorld(field.Center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end
	local function progress() return math.clamp(snow.Value - start, 0, GOAL) end
	say("Walk into the snow to dig!  0/" .. GOAL .. " ❄")
	local c2 = snow.Changed:Connect(function()
		label.Text = "Walk into the snow to dig!  " .. progress() .. "/" .. GOAL .. " ❄"
	end)
	if not waitUntil(function() return progress() >= GOAL end) then c2:Disconnect() return end
	c2:Disconnect()
	pointWorld(nil)

	-- 4) upgrades
	say("Great! Spend snow on upgrades!")
	pointAt(upB)
	local tree = pg:WaitForChild("UpgradeTreeGui", 30)
	if not waitUntil(function() return tree and tree.Enabled end) then return end
	pointAt(nil)

	-- 5) done
	say("Roll rarer shovels and unlock new areas.\nHave fun!")
	task.wait(3.2)
	finish()
end

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function round(o, r) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.2, 0)}, o) end
local function outline(o, th, color, mode)
	return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = th or 2, Color = color or DARK, ApplyStrokeMode = mode or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function text(parent, str, props, max, dark)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextColor3 = dark and TEXT_DARK or WHITE,
		TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	if not dark then outline(l, 2, DARK, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual) end
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = max or 32}, l)
	return l
end
local function tween(o, t, goal, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function clock(s)
	s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
	local h, m = math.floor(s / 3600), math.floor(s % 3600 / 60)
	if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) end
	return string.format("%d:%02d", m, s % 60)
end

	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.055), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, Text = "",
	TextColor3 = GOLD, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 40}, gui)
local toastStroke = outline(toast, 3, DARK, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual)
toastStroke.Transparency = 1
local queue, showing = {}, false
local function showToast(msg, color)
	if #queue >= 4 then return end
	table.insert(queue, {msg, color or GOLD})
	if showing then return end
	showing = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while #queue > 0 do
			local m = table.remove(queue, 1)
			toast.Text, toast.TextColor3 = m[1], m[2]
			tween(toast, 0.2, {TextTransparency = 0})
			tween(toastStroke, 0.2, {Transparency = 0})
			task.wait(2.6)
			tween(toast, 0.35, {TextTransparency = 1})
			tween(toastStroke, 0.35, {Transparency = 1})
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		showing = false
	end)
end

local buttons = {}
local function setup(btn, hoverScale)
	local st = {
		btn = btn,
		scale = btn:WaitForChild("UIScale"),
		aura = btn:WaitForChild("Aura"),
		sparks = btn:WaitForChild("Sparks"),
		hover = value(1),   -- 1 -> hoverScale
		press = value(1),   -- 1 -> 0.92
		glow = value(0),    -- 0 idle, 1 hovered
		hovering = false,
	}
	st.auraScale = st.aura:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		st.hovering = true
		tween(st.hover, 0.18, {Value = hoverScale}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		tween(st.glow, 0.2, {Value = 1})
	end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		st.hovering = false
		tween(st.hover, 0.2, {Value = 1})
		tween(st.glow, 0.25, {Value = 0})
		tween(st.press, 0.2, {Value = 1})
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		tween(st.press, 0.07, {Value = 0.92})
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		tween(st.press, 0.35, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- touch screens may skip Up; make sure it always bounces back
		task.delay(0.08, function() tween(st.press, 0.35, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	end)
	buttons[btn] = st
	return st
end

local function updateAura(st, t, phase, extra)
	local pulse = (math.sin(t * 2.2 + phase) + 1) / 2 -- 0..1
	local g = st.glow.Value
	st.auraScale.Scale = 1 + pulse * 0.04 + g * 0.08 + (extra or 0)
	for _, ring in ipairs(st.aura:GetChildren()) do
		if ring:IsA("Frame") then
			local base = ring:GetAttribute("BaseT") or 0.85
			ring.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(base - pulse * 0.05 - g * 0.12, 0, 1)
		end
	end
end

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt

	-- dice
	local float = math.sin(t * 1.6) * 4                 -- a few pixels up/down
	local tilt = math.sin(t * 1.1) * 4                  -- gentle left/right tilt
	local depth = 1 + math.sin(t * 1.1 + math.pi / 2) * 0.03 -- fake 3D: slight horizontal squash as it tilts
	dice.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, float)
	dice.Rotation = tilt + flourishRot.Value
	dice.Size = UDim2.fromScale(depth * flourishScale.Value, flourishScale.Value)
	R.scale.Scale = R.hover.Value * R.press.Value
	updateAura(R, t, 0, math.max(0, -float) * 0.004)

	-- auto
	local on = auto:GetAttribute("On") == true
	if on then
		autoSpin = (autoSpin + dt * 120) % 360
		autoIcon.Rotation = autoSpin
		A.scale.Scale = A.hover.Value * A.press.Value
	else
		if autoSpin ~= 0 then
			-- settle forward to the nearest upright position instead of spinning back
			local target = autoSpin > 0 and 360 or 0
			autoSpin = 0
			tween(autoIcon, 0.4, {Rotation = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function()
				if auto:GetAttribute("On") ~= true then autoIcon.Rotation = 0 end
			end)
		end
		local breath = 1 + (math.sin(t * 2.5) + 1) / 2 * 0.04 -- 100% -> 104% -> 100%
		A.scale.Scale = breath * A.hover.Value * A.press.Value
	end
	updateAura(A, t, 1.3, on and 0.05 or 0)

	-- hide
	H.scale.Scale = H.hover.Value * H.press.Value
	updateAura(H, t, 2.6)
	UP.scale.Scale = UP.hover.Value * UP.press.Value
	updateAura(UP, t, 3.9)
end)

local function fmt(v)
	local t
	if v >= 1000 then t = NumberFormat.Abbreviate(v)
	elseif v >= 100 then t = tostring(math.floor(v))
	elseif v >= 10 then t = (string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10):gsub("%.0$", ""))
	else t = (string.format("%.2f", math.floor(v * 100) / 100):gsub("%.?0+$", "")) end
	return t .. "x"
end

local function pop(f)
	local s = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	s.Scale = 1.2
	TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end

local showing = nil
local lastLuck, lastDmg
local function update()
	local total = player:GetAttribute("TotalLuck") or 1
	local power = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	luck.Value.Text = fmt(total)
	dmg.Value.Text = fmt(power)
	if lastLuck and total > lastLuck then pop(luck) end
	if lastDmg and power > lastDmg then pop(dmg) end
	lastLuck, lastDmg = total, power
	if showing == "Luck" then
		local friends = player:GetAttribute("FriendsHere") or 0
		local base = player:GetAttribute("LuckBase") or 1
		local rebirth = player:GetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult") or 1
		local friendMult = 1 + (player:GetAttribute("FriendBoost") or 0) * math.clamp(friends, 0, 3)
		local upgradePct = math.max(0, (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1) / (rebirth * friendMult) - 1)
		local lines = {'<font color="#8CFF96">LUCK ' .. fmt(total) .. '</font>', "Upgrades +" .. math.floor(upgradePct * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"}
		if rebirth > 1 then table.insert(lines, "Rebirths " .. fmt(rebirth)) end
		if friendMult > 1 then table.insert(lines, "Friends +" .. math.floor((friendMult - 1) * 100 + 0.5) .. "%") end
		if base ~= 1 then table.insert(lines, "Bonus " .. fmt(base)) end
		boxText.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	elseif showing == "Damage" then
		boxText.Text = '<font color="#FF8C8C">DAMAGE ' .. fmt(power) .. '</font>\nFrom upgrade tiles.\nBetter shovels hit\nharder too!'
	end
end

		if showing == f.Name and box.Visible then showing = nil; box.Visible = false
		else showing = f.Name; box.Visible = true; update() end
	end)

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

local function copies(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	return b
end

local function card(order, pet, count)
	local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)
	local main = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)
	viewport(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.02), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.44)})
	label(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14)}, 2.5)
	label(main, "+" .. math.floor(pet.Boost * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.11),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)}, 2.5)

	local on = copies(pet.Name)
	local canAdd = on < count
	local eb = smallButton(main, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.17)},
		canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90), canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
	eb.Activated:Connect(function() if canAdd then send("equip", pet.Name) end end)
	if on > 0 then
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
		stroke.Thickness = 6
		local x = smallButton(holder, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)},
			Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
		mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
		x.Activated:Connect(function() send("unequip", pet.Name) end)
	end
	local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
	round(badge, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
	label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	holder.Parent = petContent
end

refresh = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(petContent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local order, any = 0, false
	for _, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do
		for _, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
			order += 1
			local n = pets[pet.Name] or 0
			if n > 0 then any = true; card(order, pet, n) end
		end
	end
	if not any then
		label(petContent, "Open an egg to get your first pet! 🥚", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	if tab == "Pets" then
		title.Text = ("PETS %d/%d"):format(#equipped, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or MAX)
	end
end

-- New 2026 egg art: clone the Shell mesh from the lobby EggDisplay; old procedural eggs are the fallback.
local function eggArt(eggId)
	local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("EggDisplay", true)
	local src = display and display:FindFirstChild(eggId)
	local shell = src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shell and shell:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = eggId
		local c = shell:Clone()
		c.Anchored = true
		c.PivotOffset = CFrame.new() -- imported meshes carry a 90-degree pivot; keep the egg upright
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		c.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = c
		return m
	end
	return EggModels.create(eggId)
end

local playing = false
local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)
	playing = true
	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	overlay.Visible = true
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tween(overlay, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})

	-- the egg: a clone of the real egg model if possible
	local eggVp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21,
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, stage)
	local eggModel = eggArt(eggId)
	eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	eggModel.Parent = eggVp
	local _, size = eggModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	-- pop!
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]
	local color = pet and PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local vp, model = viewport(stage, petName, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21})
	local popScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.3}, stage)
	tween(popScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	topText.Text = isNew and "NEW PET!" or "You hatched"
	topText.TextColor3 = isNew and Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90) or WHITE
	nameText.Text = petName
	nameText.TextColor3 = color
	subText.Text = (pet and pet.Rarity or "") .. "  •  +" .. math.floor((pet and pet.Boost or 0) * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄"
	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

		toast.TextTransparency = 0

local signs = {} -- [eggId] = {slots = {[petName] = {vp, scale}}}

-- black silhouette until discovered; `justFound` lights up with a pop
updateSigns = function(justFound)
	for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
		for name, slot in pairs(entry.slots) do
			local known = discovered[name] == true
			if known and name == justFound then
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				tween(slot.vp, 0.6, {ImageColor3 = WHITE})
				slot.scale.Scale = 1.35
				tween(slot.scale, 0.5, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			else
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = known and WHITE or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function makeSign(prompt)
	local part = prompt.Parent
	if not part then return end
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model and not PetConfig.EggById[model.Name] do model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
	if not model then return end
	local egg = PetConfig.EggById[model.Name]
	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if pg:FindFirstChild("PetSign_" .. egg.Id) then return end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()

	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "PetSign_" .. egg.Id
	bb.Adornee = part
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 205)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 4.8, 0)
	-- lobby row eggs (Shell on a pedestal): sit the panel just above the egg itself
	local shellPart = model:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shellPart and shellPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local eggTop = shellPart.Position.Y + shellPart.Size.Y / 2 - part.Position.Y
		bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, eggTop + 1.3, 0)
		bb.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	end
	bb.MaxDistance = 1000
	bb.Enabled = false -- shown by the proximity loop below
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	bb.ResetOnSpawn = false

	local frame = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 30, 55), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)}, frame)
	-- Transparent outer panel; preserve pet tiles, text, odds and layout.
	label(frame, egg.Name:upper() .. "  •  " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(egg.Cost) .. " ❄", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)}, 2)

	local grid = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -44)}, frame)
	mk("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 78), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)

	local entry = {slots = {}, bb = bb, part = part, shown = false, scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, frame)}
	for i, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
		local cell = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i}, grid)
		local tile = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)}, cell)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, tile)
		mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), color), Rotation = 90}, tile)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, tile)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, tile)
		local vp = viewport(tile, pet.Name, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
		label(cell, pet.Chance .. "%", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 58), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)}, 2)
		entry.slots[pet.Name] = {vp = vp, scale = scale}
	end
	signs[egg.Id] = entry
	bb.Parent = pg
	updateSigns()
end

-- egg signs only show when you're close; they pop in and shrink away
local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		-- eggs stand close together in the lobby row: only the nearest egg's sign may show
		local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent and hrp then
				local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = entry, d end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if entry ~= nearest then dist = math.huge end
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

	tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 0.5}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
		if openPanel ~= p then p.Visible = false end
	end)
end
local function setBlur(on) tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = on and 16 or 0}) end

local function togglePanel(name)
	local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not target then return end
	if openPanel then hidePanel(openPanel) end
	if openPanel == target then
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
		return
	end
	openPanel = target
	showPanel(target)
	setBlur(true)
end
local function closeAll()
	if openPanel then
		hidePanel(openPanel)
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
	end
end

local function copiesEquipped(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function sendEquip(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		equipped = res
		refresh()
	end
end

	label(main, locked and "???" or item.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.19)}, 2.5)

		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, rib)

			canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
		eb.Activated:Connect(function()

		if on > 0 then

refresh = function()
	local idx = panels.Index.Inner.Content
	local inv = panels.Inventory.Inner.Content
	clear(idx); clear(inv)
	local owned, invCards, catOwned = 0, 0, 0
	for i, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		local n = counts[item.Name] or 0
		if n > 0 then
			owned += 1
			invCards += 1
			card(inv, i * 10, item, n, false, "inventory")
		end
		-- the Index shows this shovel in the selected version (Normal / Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant)
		local shown = item
		if indexCat.Slot and Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] then shown = Config.VariantsOf[item.Name][indexCat.Slot] or item end
		local sn = counts[shown.Name] or 0
		if sn > 0 then catOwned += 1 end
		card(idx, i * 10, shown, sn, sn == 0, "index")
		-- mutated versions you own (Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant) sit right after their shovel in the Inventory
		for k, v in ipairs(Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] or {}) do
			local vn = counts[v.Name] or 0
			if vn > 0 then
				invCards += 1
				card(inv, i * 10 + k, v, vn, false, "inventory")
			end
		end
	end
	if invCards == 0 then
		label(inv, "Roll to find your first shovel! ❄", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	panels.Index.Banner.Title.Text = ("%s %d/%d"):format(indexCat.Title, catOwned, #Config.Items)
	if panels.Inventory:GetAttribute("Tab") ~= "Pets" then panels.Inventory.Banner.Title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(#equipped, game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or MAX_EQUIPPED) end
end

local function tierForChance(c)
	local best = 1
	for i, n in ipairs(ORDER) do
		if c >= (Config.RarityMinChance[n] or 0) then best = i end
	end
	return best
end

function Cutscene.ShouldPlay(item, luck)
	return item ~= nil and item.Chance / math.max(luck or 1, 1) >= Config.RareDrop.Threshold
end

	return tw
end

-- cached Sound per id (so we know each file's real length for timing)
local cache = {}
local function soundFor(def)
	if not def or not def.Id or def.Id == "" then return nil end
	local s = cache[def.Id]
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId = def.Id
		s.Parent = sg
		cache[def.Id] = s
	end
	return s
end
local function lengthOf(def, fallback)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if s and s.IsLoaded and s.TimeLength > 0 then return s.TimeLength / (def.Speed or 1) end
	return fallback or 0.8
end
local function playDef(def, volMul)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if not s then return end
	s.PlaybackSpeed = def.Speed or 1
	s.Volume = (def.Volume or 1) * (volMul or 1)
	s.TimePosition = 0
	s:Play()
end
local function play(key, volMul) playDef(Config.RareDrop.Sounds[key], volMul) end
local function stepDef(tierName)
	local steps = Config.RareDrop.Sounds.Steps or {}
	return steps[tierName] or steps.Rare
end

local shakeConn
local function shake(power, duration)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	if shakeConn then shakeConn:Disconnect() end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	shakeConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
		if k <= 0 then
			hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
			shakeConn:Disconnect()
			shakeConn = nil
			return
		end
		hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * power * k
	end)
end

local function shockwave(color, size)
	ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1)
	ringStroke.Color = color
	ringStroke.Transparency = 0
	ringStroke.Thickness = 12
	tween(ring, 0.6, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(size, size)})
	tween(ringStroke, 0.6, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 2})
end

local playing = false
function Cutscene.IsPlaying() return playing end

function Cutscene.Play(item, luck)
	if playing or not item then return end
	playing = true
	luck = math.max(luck or 1, 1)
	local S = Config.RareDrop.Sounds
	local itemTier = TIER[item.Rarity] or tierForChance(item.Chance)
	-- start the climb at the tier that is "rare for you" (higher luck = starts higher)
	local startTier = math.min(itemTier, tierForChance(Config.RareDrop.Threshold * luck))
	local steps = itemTier - startTier + 1
	local finalColor = Config.Rarities[ORDER[itemTier]] or WHITE

	player:SetAttribute("MusicDuck", true)
	sg.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	sg.Enabled = true
	blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK

	-- 1) black + start sound; the first step lands when the start sound ends
	play("Start")
	tween(bg, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 30})
	task.wait(lengthOf(S.Start, 1.1))

	-- 2) the climb: each step lasts exactly as long as its own sound
	tierLabel.TextTransparency = 0
	tierStroke.Transparency = 0
	for k = 0, steps - 1 do
		local name = ORDER[startTier + k]
		local color = Config.Rarities[name] or WHITE
		local power = (k + 1) / steps
		local def = stepDef(name)
		local last = (k == steps - 1)
		playDef(def, 0.85 + power * 0.3)
		tierLabel.Text = name:upper()
		tierLabel.TextColor3 = color
		tierScale.Scale = 2.6 + power
		tween(tierScale, 0.35, {Scale = 1 + power * 0.35}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(color, 0.1 + 0.12 * power)
		tween(bg, 0.5, {BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(color, 0.05 + 0.06 * power)})
		shake(0.2 + power * 0.9, 0.4 + power * 0.2)
		shockwave(color, 0.6 + power * 0.9)
		local len = lengthOf(def, 0.85)
		if last then
			-- odds tease appears during the last step; the flash hits when its sound ends
			local tease = math.min(0.35, len * 0.4)
			task.wait(tease)
			oddsLabel.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
			tween(oddsLabel, 0.25, {TextTransparency = 0})
			tween(oddsStroke, 0.25, {Transparency = 0})
			task.wait(len - tease)
		else
			task.wait(len)
		end
	end

	-- 3) white flash + reveal sound + shovel
	play("Reveal")
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tierLabel.TextTransparency = 1; tierStroke.Transparency = 1
	oddsLabel.TextTransparency = 1; oddsStroke.Transparency = 1
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(finalColor, 0.18)
	for _, c in ipairs(iconHolder:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconHolder
	iconHolder.Visible = true
	iconScale.Scale = 0.2
	raysTint.Color = ColorSequence.new(finalColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3))
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0.15
	nameLabel.Text = item.Name:upper()
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE
	subLabel.Text = ORDER[itemTier]:upper() .. "  •  1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	subLabel.TextColor3 = finalColor
	tween(flash, 0.9, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(iconScale, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel}) do tween(o, 0.4, {TextTransparency = 0}) end
	for _, o in ipairs({nameStroke, subStroke}) do tween(o, 0.4, {Transparency = 0}) end
	shake(1.4, 0.6)
	shockwave(finalColor, 2)

	-- hold: at least the whole reveal sound, longer for rarer tiers
	local hold = math.max(lengthOf(S.Reveal, 1.5) + 0.4, 2.2 + itemTier * 0.35)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < hold do
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		rays.Rotation = t * 25
		iconHolder.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2) * 4
		task.wait()
	end

	-- 4) out: the fade lasts as long as the end sound
	play("End")
	local out = math.max(lengthOf(S.End, 0.9), 0.35)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel}) do tween(o, out * 0.6, {TextTransparency = 1}) end
	for _, o in ipairs({nameStroke, subStroke}) do tween(o, out * 0.6, {Transparency = 1}) end
	tween(rays, out * 0.6, {GroupTransparency = 1})
	tween(iconScale, out * 0.6, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	tween(bg, out, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, out, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(out)
	iconHolder.Visible = false
	sg.Enabled = false
	player:SetAttribute("MusicDuck", false)
	playing = false
end

return Cutscene

-- visual filler items: common ones appear more often, like the real odds
local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder
end

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

-- ROLL
