local rolling, rollId, lastFire = false, 0, 0
local waiting
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result, counts, equipped, luck)
	if waiting then waiting(result, counts, equipped, luck) end
end)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local punching = false
local function fovPunch()
	if punching then return end
	punching = true
	local base = camera.FieldOfView
	tween(camera, 0.08, {FieldOfView = base - 6}).Completed:Wait()
	tween(camera, 0.35, {FieldOfView = base}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	punching = false
end

local function showStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", true)
	if not stage.Visible then
		stage.Visible = true
		render()
		updateBackdrop()
	end
end
local function hideStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", false)
	stage.Visible = false
	updateBackdrop()
end

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") or game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	local hadRareCutscene = Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck)
	if hadRareCutscene then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck)
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	if not hadRareCutscene then playLandingTick() end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

local STYLE = {
	Common    = {Rise = 0.3,  Hover = 0.3,  Fly = 0.32, Sparks = 6,  Ring = 4,   Beads = 14, Light = 0,   Hold = 1.5},
	Rare      = {Rise = 0.36, Hover = 0.55, Fly = 0.36, Sparks = 12, Ring = 5.5, Beads = 18, Light = 1.2, Hold = 1.8},

	Mythic    = {Rise = 0.5,  Hover = 1.9,  Fly = 0.5,  Sparks = 34, Ring = 11,  Beads = 28, Light = 3,   Hold = 3.0, Rays = true, Stars = true, Rainbow = true},

local MAX_REVEALS, MAX_TOASTS, MAX_DISTANCE = 4, 3, 90

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function reduced() return player:GetAttribute("TreasureReduced") == true end
local function hue(t, k) return Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.45 + (k or 0)) % 1, 0.6, 1) end

-- load the saved settings once (the book keeps them in sync afterwards)
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return treasureRemote:InvokeServer("Get") end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			if player:GetAttribute("TreasureSoundOff") == nil then player:SetAttribute("TreasureSoundOff", res.Sound == false) end
			if player:GetAttribute("TreasureReduced") == nil then player:SetAttribute("TreasureReduced", res.Reduced == true) end
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

local fxFolder = mk("Folder", {Name = "TreasureFX"}, workspace)

local function playSound(rarity, volumeScale)
	if player:GetAttribute("TreasureSoundOff") then return end
	local s = SOUNDS[rarity]
	local snd = mk("Sound", {SoundId = s.Id, Volume = s.Volume * (volumeScale or 1), PlaybackSpeed = s.Speed}, SoundService)
	snd:Play()
	task.delay(s.Len, function()
		TweenService:Create(snd, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {Volume = 0}):Play()
		task.wait(0.4)
		snd:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function fxPart(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	p.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
	p.Parent = fxFolder
	return p
end

local function burst(pos, texture, colorSeq, count, size, speed, life, gravity)
	local a = fxPart({Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
	local e = mk("ParticleEmitter", {Enabled = false, Rate = 0, Texture = texture, Color = colorSeq, LightEmission = (texture == SPARKLE) and 1 or 0,
		Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)}),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)}),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life * 0.6, life), Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -gravity, 0), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}, a)
	e:Emit(count)
	task.delay(life + 0.3, function() a:Destroy() end)
end

-- glowing ring of beads that expands across the ground under the treasure
local function ringBurst(pos, color, diameter, count, delay)
	task.delay(delay or 0, function()
		local beads = {}
		for i = 1, count do beads[i] = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28), Color = color or hue(0, i / count)}) end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while true do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / 0.65, 0, 1)
			local r = 0.6 + (diameter / 2 - 0.6) * (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3)
			for i, b in ipairs(beads) do
				local ang = i / count * math.pi * 2
				b.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * r, 0.3, math.sin(ang) * r))
				b.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * a
			end
			if a >= 1 then break end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(beads) do b:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function revealModel(entry)
	local info, item, rar = entry.info, entry.item, entry.rar
	local st = STYLE[item.Rarity]
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pos = typeof(info.Pos) == "Vector3" and info.Pos or nil
	if not root or not pos or (root.Position - pos).Magnitude > MAX_DISTANCE then return end
	local red = reduced()
	local colorSeq = st.Rainbow and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color, WHITE)
	-- 1) a short puff of snow + rarity sparkles
	burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), SMOKE, ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)), red and 5 or 10, 1.0, 9, 0.6, 18)
	if not red then burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, st.Sparks, 0.45, 9, 0.9, 6) end
	if st.Burst and not red then burst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), SPARKLE, ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 255)), 18, 0.6, 12, 0.7, 2) end
	-- 2) the treasure picture pops out, flips and hovers on a rarity glow (billboard, always faces the camera)
	local holder = fxPart({Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
	local bb = mk("BillboardGui", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1), LightInfluence = 0, MaxDistance = 220, ResetOnSpawn = false}, holder)
	local glow = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1),
		BackgroundColor3 = st.Rainbow and WHITE or rar.Color, BackgroundTransparency = red and 0.75 or 0.45, ZIndex = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, glow)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.3}, glow)
	local glowGrad = st.Rainbow and mk("UIGradient", {Color = RAINBOW}, glow) or nil
	local iconBox = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, bb)
	TreasureIcon.Create(item, {ZIndex = 2}).Parent = iconBox
	if st.Light > 0 then mk("PointLight", {Brightness = red and st.Light * 0.6 or st.Light, Range = 9, Color = rar.Color}, holder) end
	-- 3) a glowing ring expands beneath it
	ringBurst(pos, (not st.Rainbow) and rar.Color or nil, st.Ring * (red and 0.7 or 1), red and 12 or st.Beads, 0)
	if (st.Rays or st.Stars) and not red then ringBurst(pos, (not st.Rainbow) and rar.Color or nil, st.Ring * 1.35, st.Beads, 0.28) end
	local extras = {}
	if st.Rays and not red then
		for i = 1, 6 do extras[#extras + 1] = {ray = true, i = i, p = fxPart({Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 2.8, 0.16), Transparency = 0.4,
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 6) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90)})} end
	end
	if st.Stars and not red then
		for i = 1, 4 do extras[#extras + 1] = {i = i, p = fxPart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
			Color = st.Rainbow and hue(0, i / 4) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200)})} end
	end
	playSound(item.Rarity)
	local BASE = 3.4 -- studs
	local start, top = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), pos + Vector3.new(0, 5.2, 0) -- hovers above head height so the player never hides it
	local hover = red and math.min(st.Hover, 0.35) or st.Hover
	local t0, finished = os.clock(), false
	local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		local center, size, flip, tilt = top, BASE, 1, 0
		if t < st.Rise then
			local a = t / st.Rise
			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			center = start:Lerp(top, e)
			size = BASE * math.clamp(e, 0.05, 1.15)
			flip = math.abs(math.cos(a * math.pi * 2)) -- two quick flips while it pops out
		elseif t < st.Rise + hover then
			local h = t - st.Rise
			center = top + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(h * 4) * 0.16, 0)
			tilt = math.sin(h * 3) * 6
		else
			-- 4) it flies to the player and shrinks into the reward toast
			local a = math.clamp((t - st.Rise - hover) / st.Fly, 0, 1)
			local e = TweenService:GetValue(a, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			local target = (root.Parent and root.Position or top) + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			center = top:Lerp(target, e)
			size = BASE * (1 - 0.85 * e)
			if a >= 1 then finished = true end
		end
		holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
		bb.Size = UDim2.new(size, 0, size, 0)
		iconBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(flip, 0.06), 1)
		iconBox.Rotation = tilt
		if glowGrad then glowGrad.Rotation = (t * 90) % 360 end
		local leaving = t > st.Rise + hover
		for _, x in ipairs(extras) do
			if leaving then
				x.p.Transparency = 1
			elseif x.ray then
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, x.i / 6 * math.pi * 2 + t * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(62), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 1.9, 0)
				x.p.Transparency = 0.4 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 3 + x.i)
			else
				local b = t * 2.4 + x.i / 4 * math.pi * 2
				x.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(b) * 2.1, 0.25 + math.sin(t * 3 + x.i) * 0.3, math.sin(b) * 2.1))
			end
		end
	end)
	local deadline = os.clock() + st.Rise + hover + st.Fly + 2
	while not finished and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
	conn:Disconnect()
	for _, x in ipairs(extras) do x.p:Destroy() end
	holder:Destroy()
	if root.Parent then burst(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), SPARKLE, colorSeq, red and 3 or 8, 0.3, 4, 0.5, 0) end
end

		nameL.Text = item.Name
		rarL.Text = string.upper(item.Rarity)
		rarGrad.Color = item.Rarity == "Mythic" and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color)
		toastGrad.Color = item.Rarity == "Mythic" and RAINBOW or ColorSequence.new(rar.Color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6), rar.Color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.1))
		snowL.Text = "+" .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(info.Snow or 0) .. " ❄"
		countL.Text = "x" .. tostring(info.Count or 1)
		newBadge.Visible = info.New == true
		hintL.Visible = info.First == true
	end
	toast.Visible = true
	toast.Position = HIDDEN
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Position = SHOWN}):Play()
	local hold = entry.hold or 1.8
	if #toastQueue > 0 then hold = math.min(hold, 1.1) end
	task.wait(0.35 + hold)
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = HIDDEN}):Play()
	task.wait(0.28)
	toast.Visible = false
end
local function lowPriority(e) return not e.info.New and e.rar.Order <= 2 end
local function pushToast(entry)
	entry.hold = STYLE[entry.item.Rarity].Hold
	if #toastQueue >= MAX_TOASTS then
		for i, e in ipairs(toastQueue) do
			if lowPriority(e) then table.remove(toastQueue, i); mergedN += 1; mergedSnow += e.info.Snow or 0; break end
		end
		if #toastQueue >= MAX_TOASTS and lowPriority(entry) then mergedN += 1; mergedSnow += entry.info.Snow or 0; return end
	end
	table.insert(toastQueue, entry)
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local e = table.remove(toastQueue, 1)
		if e then
			local ok, err = pcall(showToast, e)
			if not ok then warn("[TreasureReveal] toast: " .. tostring(err)) end
		elseif mergedN > 0 then
			local n, s = mergedN, mergedSnow
			mergedN, mergedSnow = 0, 0
			pcall(showToast, {merged = n, snow = s, hold = 1.5})
		else
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end
end)

local function setLook(t, state, nameText, subText, subColor, showIcon)
	local st = STYLE[state]
	paint(t.fillRects, st.fill, 0)
	paint(t.borderRects, st.border, 0)
	paint(t.shineRects, st.fill:Lerp(WHITE, 1 - st.shine), 0)
	if st.glow then paint(t.glowRects, GLOWBASE:Lerp(st.glow, 0.5), 0); t.glow.Visible = true else t.glow.Visible = false end
	local mystery = state == "mystery"
	t.q.Visible = mystery
	t.name.Visible = not mystery
	t.icon.Visible = showIcon and not mystery
	t.name.Text = nameText or ""
	t.sub.Text = subText or ""
	t.sub.Visible = not mystery and (subText or "") ~= ""
	t.sub.TextColor3 = subColor or WHITE
	if t.nameStroke then t.nameStroke.Thickness = t.icon.Visible and 3 or 2.5 end
	if t.icon.Visible then
		t.name.Position = ICON_NAME_POS; t.name.Size = ICON_NAME_SIZE
		t.sub.Position = ICON_SUB_POS; t.sub.Size = ICON_SUB_SIZE
	else
		t.name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42); t.name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.27)

local function burst(t)
	local board = t.holder.Parent

	local n = t.node
	if t.isLink then
		tipName.Text = t.linkTitle
		tipName.TextColor3 = STYLE.link.fill

local busy = false
local lastFeedback = {}
local function onTileClick(t)
	local n = t.node
	local now = os.clock()
	if t.state ~= "buy" and lastFeedback[t] and now - lastFeedback[t] < 0.3 then return end
	lastFeedback[t] = now
	if t.state == "buy" then
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		local ok, res, reason = pcall(function() return buyRemote:InvokeServer(n.Id) end)
		busy = false
		if ok and res == true then
			buySound:Play()
			t.scale.Scale = 1.35
			tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			burst(t)
			float(t, n.Text or "Bought!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150))
			refresh(true)
		else
			denySound:Play()
			shake(t)
			float(t, tostring((ok and reason) or "Try again"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130))
			refresh(false)
		end
	elseif t.state == "cant" then
		denySound:Play()
		shake(t)
		local need = U.CostOf(n) - snow()
		float(t, t.lock or ("Need " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(math.max(need, 0)) .. " more snow"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130))
	elseif t.state == "mystery" then
		shake(t)
		float(t, "Buy one next to it first", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 225))
	end
end

local function visiblePoints(v)
	local pts = {}
	for _, t in pairs(tiles) do
		if t.view == v and t.state ~= "hidden" then table.insert(pts, t.pos) end
	end
	if v == "Main" and miscLink.holder.Visible then table.insert(pts, miscLink.pos) end
	if #pts == 0 then table.insert(pts, Vector2.zero) end
	return pts
end
local function fitTo(v, animated)
	local b = boards[v]
	local points = visiblePoints(v)
	local minX, maxX, minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(points) do
		minX = math.min(minX, p.X); maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X); minY = math.min(minY, p.Y); maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y)
	end
	local viewSize = bg.AbsoluteSize
	if viewSize.X < 10 then viewSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
	local w, h = (maxX - minX) + R * 2.6, (maxY - minY) + R * 2.8
	local s = math.clamp(math.min(viewSize.X * 0.84 / w, viewSize.Y * 0.62 / h), math.clamp(viewSize.X / 1450, 0.6, 0.95), 1.15)
	local cx, cy = (minX + maxX) / 2, (minY + maxY) / 2
	local target = UDim2.new(0.5, -cx * s, 0.56, -cy * s)
	if animated then
		tween(b.frame, 0.5, {Position = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		tween(b.scale, 0.5, {Scale = s}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
	else
		b.frame.Position = target
		b.scale.Scale = s
	end
end

refresh = function(animate)
	local owned, stages, money = ownedSet(), stageSet(), snow()
	local states, done = {}, 0
	local snowStart = owned["S_Center"] == true
	for id in pairs(owned) do states[id] = "owned"; done += 1 end
	local frontier = {}
	for id, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		if not owned[id] then
			local front
			if id == "R_Luck1" then front = snowStart          -- the branch: Lucky Start opens once Snow Start is owned
			elseif n.Center then front = true                  -- Snow Start, Misc Start
			else
				for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then front = true; break end end
			end
			if front then table.insert(frontier, n) end
		end
	end
	local lockText, miscGreen = {}, 0
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		local reason = U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
		if n.Id == "R_Luck1" and reason ~= nil and not n.RequiredStage then reason = nil end
		if reason == nil and money >= U.CostOf(n) then
			states[n.Id] = "buy"
			if n.Tree == "Misc" then miscGreen += 1 end
		else
			states[n.Id] = "cant"
			if reason then
				local st = StageConfig.ById and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				lockText[n.Id] = "Unlock " .. ((st and st.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "the next area") .. " first"
			end
		end
	end
	for _, n in ipairs(frontier) do
		for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if not states[nb.Id] then states[nb.Id] = "mystery" end end
	end

	progressLabel.Text = done .. " / " .. TOTAL .. " owned"
	table.clear(pulsing)
	for id, t in pairs(tiles) do
		local st = states[id] or "hidden"
		local prev = t.state
		t.state = st
		if st == "hidden" then
			t.holder.Visible = false
		else
			local n = t.node
			local hasIcon = (n.Icon or "") ~= ""
			t.lock = lockText[id]
			if st == "owned" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, n.Text, Color3.fromRGB(205, 230, 255), hasIcon)
			elseif st == "buy" then
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)), WHITE, hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			elseif st == "cant" then
				local stg = StageConfig.ById and n.RequiredStage and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]
				local sub = t.lock and ("🔒 " .. ((stg and stg.Name) or n.RequiredStage or "")) or ("❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n)))
				setLook(t, st, n.Name, sub, Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 120), hasIcon)
				table.insert(pulsing, t)
			else
				setLook(t, st, "", "", WHITE, false)
			end
			t.holder.Visible = true
			if animate and prev == "hidden" then
				t.scale.Scale = 0.15
				tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			end
		end
	end
	-- stone path + MISC link grow out of Snow Start (also shown if older saves already own Rolls/Misc tiles)
	local anyRolls, anyMisc, miscOwned = false, false, 0
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local n = U.ById[id]
		if n and n.Tree == "Rolls" then anyRolls = true end
		if n and n.Tree == "Misc" then anyMisc = true; miscOwned += 1 end
	end
	local showPath = snowStart or anyRolls
	for i, p in ipairs(pathTiles) do
		if showPath and not p.shown then
			p.shown = true
			p.holder.Visible = true
			if animate then
				p.scale.Scale = 0.1
				task.delay(i * 0.08, function() tween(p.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
			end
		elseif not showPath then
			p.shown = false
			p.holder.Visible = false
		end
	end
	local showMisc = snowStart or anyMisc
	local wasHidden = not miscLink.holder.Visible
	miscLink.holder.Visible = showMisc
	if showMisc and wasHidden and animate then
		miscLink.scale.Scale = 0.15
		tween(miscLink.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end
	miscLink.sub.Text = miscOwned .. "/" .. #U.TreeById.Misc.Nodes
	miscLink.sub.Visible = true
	miscLink.badge.Visible = miscGreen > 0
	miscLink.badgeLabel.Text = tostring(miscGreen)
	backLink.holder.Visible = view == "Misc"
	if hovered then showTip(hovered) end
end

switchView = function(v)
	view = v
	for name, b in pairs(boards) do b.frame.Visible = name == v end
	title.Text = v == "Misc" and "MISC UPGRADES" or "UPGRADES"
	tip.Visible = false
	hovered = nil
	refresh(false)
	local b = boards[v]
	fitTo(v, false)
	local s = b.scale.Scale
	b.scale.Scale = s * 0.8
	tween(b.scale, 0.35, {Scale = s}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

-- flashing: green/red tiles pulse their glow and brighten; yellow links breathe
local pulseConn
local function startPulse()
	if pulseConn then return end
	pulseConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, t in ipairs(pulsing) do
			local st = STYLE[t.state]
			if st and st.glow then
				local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * (t.state == "buy" and 5.5 or 4) + t.phase)
				local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(st.glow, 0.25 + 0.65 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
				local c = st.fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.22 * a)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.fillRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = c end
				local s2 = c:Lerp(WHITE, 1 - st.shine)
				for _, r in ipairs(t.shineRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = s2 end
			end
		end
		for _, l in pairs(links) do
			local a = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 2.2 + l.phase)
			local g = GLOWBASE:Lerp(STYLE.link.glow, 0.3 + 0.5 * a)
			for _, r in ipairs(l.glowRects) do r.BackgroundColor3 = g end
			if l.badge.Visible then l.badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34 + 4 * a, 34 + 4 * a) end
		end
	end)
end
local function stopPulse()
	if pulseConn then pulseConn:Disconnect(); pulseConn = nil end
end

-- BiomeLighting (client, ReplicatedFirst) - lighting pass 2026-10-01.
-- Gives every area its own lighting and blends smoothly when walking, teleporting or respawning.
-- Edit values and zones in the Profiles module under this script.
-- Cutscene-safe: holds the current area while IntroPlaying is set, and never touches camera effects
-- (RareDropBlur) or other ColorCorrections (the intro's ArrivalColor). Writes Lighting only while blending.
-- Pre-overhaul backup: ServerStorage.LightingBackup_20261001.
-- Studio-only test hooks (LocalPlayer or Workspace attributes): LightingSnap=true finishes blends instantly;
-- LightingProbe="camera" follows the camera instead of the character.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local Config = require(script:WaitForChild("Profiles"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local IS_STUDIO = RunService:IsStudio()
local function studioHook(name) -- Studio-only test hooks; never read in live servers
	return IS_STUDIO and (player:GetAttribute(name) or workspace:GetAttribute(name)) or nil
end

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local LIGHTING_KEYS = {
	"Brightness", "ExposureCompensation", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ColorShift_Top", "ColorShift_Bottom",
	"EnvironmentDiffuseScale", "EnvironmentSpecularScale", "ShadowSoftness",
}
local GROUP_KEYS = {
	Atmosphere = {"Density", "Offset", "Color", "Decay", "Glare", "Haze"},
	Bloom = {"Intensity", "Size", "Threshold"},
	SunRays = {"Intensity", "Spread"},
	Grade = {"Brightness", "Contrast", "Saturation", "TintColor"},
}

local fx = {L = Lighting}
local function pick(name, class)
	local named = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if named and named:IsA(class) then
		return named
	end
	return Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass(class)
end
local function resolve()
	fx.Atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	fx.Bloom = pick("Bloom", "BloomEffect")
	fx.SunRays = pick("SunRays", "SunRaysEffect")
	local grade = Lighting:FindFirstChild("BiomeGrade")
	if not (grade and grade:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")) then
		grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		grade.Name = "BiomeGrade"
		grade.Parent = Lighting
	end
	fx.Grade = grade
end
Lighting:WaitForChild("BiomeGrade", 5)
resolve()

local function flatten(profile)
	local flat = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(LIGHTING_KEYS) do
		if profile[key] ~= nil then
			flat["L." .. key] = profile[key]
		end
	end
	for group, keys in pairs(GROUP_KEYS) do
		local values = profile[group]
		if values then
			for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
				if values[key] ~= nil then
					flat[group .. "." .. key] = values[key]
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return flat
end

local profiles = {}
for name, profile in pairs(Config.Profiles) do
	profiles[name] = flatten(profile)
end

local splitCache = {}
local function split(key)
	local cached = splitCache[key]
	if not cached then
		local group, prop = string.match(key, "^(%w+)%.(.+)$")
		cached = {group, prop}
		splitCache[key] = cached
	end
	return cached[1], cached[2]
end

local function write(values)
	for key, value in pairs(values) do
		local group, prop = split(key)
		local inst = fx[group]
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			inst[prop] = value
		end
	end
end

local function lerp(a, b, t)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return a + (b - a) * t
	end
	return a:Lerp(b, t)
end

local function zoneAt(pos)
	local x, z = pos.X, pos.Z
	for _, zone in ipairs(Config.Zones) do
		if zone.Radius then
			local dx, dz = x - zone.Center.X, z - zone.Center.Y
			if dx * dx + dz * dz <= zone.Radius * zone.Radius then
				return zone.Name
			end
		elseif x >= zone.Min.X and x < zone.Max.X and z >= zone.Min.Y and z < zone.Max.Y then
			return zone.Name
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function probe()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera and (camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		or studioHook("LightingProbe") == "camera") then
		return camera.CFrame.Position
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
	if root then
		return root.Position
	end
	return camera and camera.Focus.Position
end

-- On join, snap straight to the area the player starts in (no blend from the defaults).
do
	local pos = probe()
	local zone = pos and zoneAt(pos)
	targetZone = (zone and profiles[zone]) and zone or Config.Default
	for key, value in pairs(profiles[targetZone]) do
		current[key] = value
	end
	write(current)
	player:SetAttribute("LightingZone", targetZone)
end

	forceJump = true
end)
Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("BloomEffect") or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
		task.defer(resolve)
	end
end)

RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
	local pos = probe()
	if pos and not player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then
		local jumped = forceJump or (lastProbe ~= nil and (pos - lastProbe).Magnitude > Config.JumpDistance)
		forceJump = false
		local zone = zoneAt(pos)
		if zone and profiles[zone] and zone ~= targetZone then
			if zone ~= candidate then
				candidate, candidateSince = zone, os.clock()
			end
			if jumped or os.clock() - candidateSince >= Config.Dwell then
				candidate = nil
				startBlend(zone, if jumped then Config.JumpBlend else Config.WalkBlend)
			end
		elseif zone == targetZone then
			candidate = nil
		end
	end
	if pos then
		lastProbe = pos
	end
	if settled then
		return
	end
	local k = 1
	if blendDuration > 0 and not studioHook("LightingSnap") then
		k = math.clamp((os.clock() - blendStart) / blendDuration, 0, 1)
	end
	local eased = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
	for key, value in pairs(profiles[targetZone]) do
		local start = from[key]
		current[key] = if start ~= nil then lerp(start, value, eased) else value
	end
	write(current)
	if k >= 1 then
		settled = true
	end
end)

local function load()

 mark("gameLoaded")
 step(.14,"Waking up the snow...")
 -- prime every texture and model the arrival cinematic and the HUD need
 local artOk,Art=pcall(function()return require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowIntroArt",10))end)
 if artOk and Art and Art.preload then pcall(Art.preload,6)end
 step(.30,"Sharpening the shovels...")
 local list={}

 local tin=models and models:FindFirstChild("Tin Shovel")
 if tin then list[#list+1]=tin end
 list[#list+1]=StarterGui
 local expected,done=0,0
 for _,root in ipairs(list)do
  for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
   if (d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) and d.Image~="" then expected+=1
   elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then expected+=1 end
  end
 end
 local finished=false
 task.spawn(function()
  pcall(function()
   ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list,function()done+=1;step(.30+.36*math.min(1,done/math.max(expected,1)))end)
  end)
  finished=true
 end)

 while not finished and os.clock()-t0<10 do task.wait(.1)end
 mark("assets")

local core = model:WaitForChild("PortalCore")
local center = core:WaitForChild("Center")
local outerGlow = core:WaitForChild("OuterGlow")
local lightPart = model:WaitForChild("Lights"):WaitForChild("CoreLight")
local coreLight = lightPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
local fx = model:WaitForChild("ParticleEffects")
local floating = model:WaitForChild("IceCrystals"):WaitForChild("Floating")

local R = model:GetAttribute("WispRadius") or 19.6
local WZ = model:GetAttribute("WispZ") or 4.3

local hubs, shards, wisps = {}, {}, {}
for _, h in ipairs(spiral:GetChildren()) do
	if h:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(hubs, {part = h, base = h.CFrame, speed = math.rad(h:GetAttribute("Speed") or -60)})
	end
end
for _, s in ipairs(floating:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(shards, {m = s, base = s:GetPivot(), phase = s:GetAttribute("Phase") or 0})
end
for _, w in ipairs(fx:GetChildren()) do
	if w.Name == "OrbitWisp" then table.insert(wisps, {p = w, phase = w:GetAttribute("Phase") or 0}) end
end

local centerCF = center.CFrame
local baseGlowT = outerGlow.Transparency
local baseBright = coreLight and coreLight.Brightness or 2
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local t = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	-- skip the work when the player is far away
	if (camera.CFrame.Position - centerCF.Position).Magnitude > 600 then return end

	-- spiral layers: negative speed spins clockwise, which makes the arms read as pulling inward
	for _, h in ipairs(hubs) do
		h.part.CFrame = h.base * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, h.speed * t)
	end

	for _, s in ipairs(shards) do
		s.m:PivotTo(s.base * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t * 1.3 + s.phase) * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 0.6 + s.phase, 0))
	end

	for _, w in ipairs(wisps) do
		local a = math.rad(90) + math.rad(118) * math.sin(t * 0.55 + w.phase)
		w.p.CFrame = centerCF * CFrame.new(R * math.cos(a), R * math.sin(a), WZ)
	end

	local pulse = (math.sin(t * 2.2) + 1) / 2
	outerGlow.Transparency = baseGlowT + 0.12 * pulse
	if coreLight then coreLight.Brightness = baseBright + 0.6 * (1 - pulse) end
end)

-- EggFloat (RunContext = Client): smooth idle float + sway, playful hop-wiggles with a sparkle burst,
-- the nearest egg lifts and turns toward the player, glow pulse, and "COMING SOON" labels that fade by distance.
-- Only the visual Shell moves; HatchAnchor (prompt / odds sign) stays still.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local display = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local rng = Random.new()
local centre = display:GetPivot().Position

local list, known = {}, {}
local function add(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") or known[model] then return end
	local shell, anchor = model:FindFirstChild("Shell"), model:FindFirstChild("HatchAnchor")
	if not (shell and anchor) then return end
	known[model] = true
	local label = anchor:FindFirstChild("ComingSoon")
	local text = label and label:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	local fx = model:FindFirstChild("FxVolume")
	local raysAtt = fx and fx:FindFirstChild("RaysAtt")
	table.insert(list, {
		shell = shell, anchor = anchor, base = shell.CFrame,
		phase = (model:GetAttribute("Order") or #list + 1) * 0.9,
		lift = 0, turn = 0, hop = -1, nextHop = os.clock() + rng:NextNumber(2.5, 8),
		light = anchor:FindFirstChild("EggGlow"), pad = model:FindFirstChild("GlowPad"),
		sparkle = (fx and fx:FindFirstChild("Sparkle")) or anchor:FindFirstChild("Sparkle"),
		rays = raysAtt and raysAtt:FindFirstChild("Rays"), raysOn = false,
		label = label, text = text, stroke = text and text:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"), labelAlpha = 0,
	})
end
for _, m in ipairs(display:GetChildren()) do add(m) end
display.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if d.Parent and (d.Name == "Shell" or d.Name == "HatchAnchor") then task.defer(add, d.Parent) end
end)

local function ease(cur, target, speed, dt) return cur + (target - cur) * (1 - math.exp(-speed * dt)) end
local HOP_TIME, NEAR, LABEL_NEAR, RANGE = 0.9, 13, 22, 220
local parts, cframes = {}, {}

RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam or (cam.CFrame.Position - centre).Magnitude > RANGE then return end
	local t = os.clock()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local nearest, nd = nil, NEAR
	if hrp then
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local d = (Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(e.anchor.Position.X, 0, e.anchor.Position.Z)).Magnitude
			if d < nd then nearest, nd = e, d end
		end
	end

	table.clear(parts); table.clear(cframes)
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		if e.shell.Parent then
			local p = t * 1.2 + e.phase
			local bob = (math.sin(p) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.38
			local lean = math.cos(p) * 0.035
			local sway = math.sin(t * 0.33 + e.phase) * 0.12

			local wantLift, wantTurn = 0, 0
			if e == nearest then
				wantLift = 0.55
				local rel = e.base:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
				wantTurn = math.clamp(math.atan2(-rel.X, -rel.Z), -0.6, 0.6)
			end
			e.lift = ease(e.lift, wantLift, 4, dt)
			e.turn = ease(e.turn, wantTurn, 3, dt)

			-- light beams rise behind the egg you are standing at
			local wantRays = e == nearest
			if e.rays and wantRays ~= e.raysOn then
				e.raysOn = wantRays
				e.rays.Rate = wantRays and 1.4 or 0
				if wantRays then e.rays:Emit(1) end
			end

			if e.hop < 0 and t >= e.nextHop then
				e.hop = 0
				e.nextHop = t + rng:NextNumber(6, 11)
				if e.sparkle then e.sparkle:Emit(8) end
			end
			local hopY, wig = 0, 0
			if e.hop >= 0 then
				e.hop += dt
				local k = e.hop / HOP_TIME
				if k >= 1 then
					e.hop = -1
				else
					hopY = math.sin(k * math.pi) ^ 1.5 * 0.6
					wig = math.sin(k * math.pi * 4) * 0.17 * (1 - k) ^ 2
				end
			end

			table.insert(parts, e.shell)
			table.insert(cframes, e.base * CFrame.new(0, bob + e.lift + hopY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(lean, sway + e.turn, wig))

			local glow = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(p * 0.8)
			if e.light then e.light.Brightness = 0.7 + glow * 0.5 + e.lift * 0.8 end
			if e.pad then e.pad.Transparency = 0.72 - glow * 0.14 - e.lift * 0.15 end

			if e.label and e.text then
				local close = hrp and (hrp.Position - e.anchor.Position).Magnitude < LABEL_NEAR
				e.labelAlpha = ease(e.labelAlpha, close and 1 or 0, 6, dt)
				e.label.Enabled = e.labelAlpha > 0.02
				e.text.TextTransparency = 1 - e.labelAlpha
				if e.stroke then e.stroke.Transparency = 1 - e.labelAlpha end
			end
		end
	end
	if #parts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, cframes, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
end)

local SP, METAL, WOOD, NEON, GLASS, ICE = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.Material.Glass, Enum.Material.Ice
local BASALT, SAND, MARBLE, FOIL = Enum.Material.Basalt, Enum.Material.Sand, Enum.Material.Marble, Enum.Material.Foil
local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function rgb(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local PI = math.pi
local TOP = -0.74 -- where the blade starts

local M -- model being built
local function part(name, size, cf, color, mat, props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	if props and props.Shape then p.Shape = props.Shape end
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or SP
	p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CanTouch = false
	p.Massless = true; p.CastShadow = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Shape" then p[k] = v end end end
	p.Parent = M
	return p
end
local function ball(name, d, pos, color, mat, props)
	props = props or {}
	props.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	return part(name, Vector3.new(d, d, d), CFrame.new(pos), color, mat, props)
end
local function wedge(name, size, cf, color, mat, props)
	local w = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	w.Name = name; w.Size = size; w.CFrame = cf; w.Color = color; w.Material = mat or SP
	w.Anchored = true; w.CanCollide = false; w.CanQuery = false; w.CanTouch = false; w.Massless = true; w.CastShadow = false
	if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do w[k] = v end end
	w.Parent = M
	return w
end
-- flat isosceles triangle in the blade plane; base centered at (bx,by), apex at distance h in direction ang
local function tri(name, bx, by, z, ang, hw, h, thick, color, mat, props)
	local base = CFrame.new(bx, by, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang - PI / 2)
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
		wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, h, hw), base * CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(s * hw / 2, h / 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, s), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), color, mat, props)
	end
end
-- 3D spike (two crossed blades); Y axis of cf = spike direction
local function spike(name, cf, h, hw, color, mat, props)
	for b = 0, 1 do
		local bcf = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, b * PI / 2, 0)
		for s = 0, 1 do
			local c = bcf * CFrame.new(0, h / 2, s == 0 and -hw / 2 or hw / 2)
			if s == 1 then c = c * CFrame.Angles(0, PI, 0) end
			wedge(name, Vector3.new(hw * 0.9, h, hw), c, color, mat, props)
		end
	end
end
local function emitter(p, kind, color)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Name = kind
	e.LightEmission = 1

	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)

		e.Rate = 7; e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9); e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.8); e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.28), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
	elseif kind == "Fire" then

		e.Rate = 14; e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6); e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6)
		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
		e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	elseif kind == "Smoke" then
		e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
		e.LightEmission = 0.3
		e.Rate = 5; e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3); e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7)
		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.1)})

local SHAPES = {

	square  = {W = 1.3,  RH = 1.12, TH = 0,    Tip = "flat"},

-- HIGH-POLY BLADE HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------
-- any 3D triangle from two wedges (thickness along the triangle's normal)
local function triangle(name, a, b, c, thick, color, mat)
	local ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
	local abd, acd, bcd = ab:Dot(ab), ac:Dot(ac), bc:Dot(bc)
	if abd > acd and abd > bcd then c, a = a, c
	elseif acd > bcd and acd > abd then a, b = b, a end
	ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
	local cr = ac:Cross(ab)
	if cr.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return end
	local right = cr.Unit
	local up = bc:Cross(right).Unit
	local back = bc.Unit
	local height = math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
	if height < 0.002 then return end
	local l1, l2 = math.abs(ab:Dot(back)), math.abs(ac:Dot(back))
	if l1 > 0.002 then wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, height, l1), CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, right, up, back), color, mat) end
	if l2 > 0.002 then wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, height, l2), CFrame.fromMatrix((a + c) / 2, -right, up, -back), color, mat) end
end

local function curve(p0, p1, p2, n)
	local pts = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		local t = i / n
		local u = 1 - t
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(u * u * p0.X + 2 * u * t * p1.X + t * t * p2.X, u * u * p0.Y + 2 * u * t * p1.Y + t * t * p2.Y))
	end
	return pts
end

-- right-half outline of a blade: from top-center, around the side, to the bottom tip
local function outline(sh, hw, top)
	local RH, TH = sh.RH, sh.TH
	local bottom = top - RH - TH
	local pts = {}
	if sh.Gem then
		local mid = top - 0.36
		pts = {Vector2.new(0, top), Vector2.new(hw * 0.3, top - 0.05), Vector2.new(hw * 0.75, top - 0.2), Vector2.new(hw, mid)}
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(Vector2.new(hw, mid), Vector2.new(hw * 0.62, mid - TH * 0.3), Vector2.new(0, bottom), 6)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
		return pts, bottom
	end
	local flare = sh.Flare or 1
	table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(0, top))
	table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(hw - 0.08, top))
	for _, p in ipairs(curve(Vector2.new(hw - 0.08, top), Vector2.new(hw, top), Vector2.new(hw, top - 0.08), 2)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
	local sideEnd = Vector2.new(hw * flare, top - RH)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local t = i / 3
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(hw + (hw * flare - hw) * t, top - 0.08 - (RH - 0.08) * t))
	end
	table.insert(pts, sideEnd)
	if TH <= 0.01 then
		bottom = top - RH - 0.16
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(sideEnd, Vector2.new(hw * flare, bottom), Vector2.new(hw * flare - 0.2, bottom), 4)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(0, bottom))
	else
		local tip = sh.Tip or "shield"
		local ctrl
		if tip == "point" then ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * 0.5, top - RH - TH * 0.45)
		elseif tip == "round" then ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * flare * 0.98, bottom + TH * 0.12)
		else ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * flare * 0.82, top - RH - TH * 0.55) end
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(sideEnd, ctrl, Vector2.new(0, bottom), 7)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
	end
	return pts, bottom
end

-- fills one half of the blade (s = 1 right, -1 left) with triangles, curved into a scoop (dish) or a gem bulge
local function fillHalf(pts, s, hw, dish, bulge, thick, color, mat, name, simple)
	local function P(x, y)
		local z = dish * (x / hw) ^ 2
		if bulge then z = -bulge * (1 - math.abs(x) / hw) end
		return Vector3.new(s * x, y, z)
	end
	for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
		local A, B = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		if simple then
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(B.X, B.Y), P(0, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(0, B.Y), P(0, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
		else
			local ax, bx = A.X / 2, B.X / 2
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(B.X, B.Y), P(bx, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(bx, B.Y), P(ax, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(ax, A.Y), P(bx, B.Y), P(0, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(ax, A.Y), P(0, B.Y), P(0, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
		end
	end
end

-- merges all parts of a temp model into one mesh (UnionOperation); keeps the wedges if CSG fails
local function mergeInto(target, tmp, name, mat, props)
	local parts = tmp:GetChildren()
	tmp.Parent = workspace
	local first = table.remove(parts, 1)
	local ok, u = pcall(function()
		return first:UnionAsync(parts, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise)
	end)
	if ok and u then
		u.Name = name
		u.UsePartColor = false
		u.Material = mat
		u.Anchored = true; u.CanCollide = false; u.CanQuery = false; u.CanTouch = false; u.CastShadow = false; u.Massless = true
		if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do u[k] = v end end
		u.Parent = target
		tmp:Destroy()
		return u
	end
	warn("[ShovelModelBuilder] union failed for " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(u))
	table.insert(parts, 1, first)
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end end
		p.Parent = target
	end
	tmp:Destroy()
	return first
end

local function build(d)
	M = Instance.new("Model")
	M.Name = d.Name
	local metal = d.Metal
	local trim = d.Trim or metal:Lerp(WHITE, 0.15)
	local accent = d.Accent or trim:Lerp(BLACK, 0.25)
	local metalMat = d.MetalMat or METAL
	local mp = d.Shiny and {Reflectance = d.Shiny} or nil
	local sh = SHAPES[d.Shape or "shield"]
	local W, RH, TH, T = sh.W, sh.RH, sh.TH, d.T or sh.T or 0.12
	local bladeColor, bladeMat = d.Blade or metal, d.BladeMat or metalMat
	local bp = {Reflectance = d.Shiny or 0, Transparency = d.BladeTransparency or 0}
	local edge = d.Edge or bladeColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
	local edgeMat = d.EdgeMat or bladeMat
	local ridge = d.Ridge or bladeColor:Lerp(BLACK, 0.22)
	local zf = {-(T / 2 + 0.025), T / 2 + 0.025}
	local bottomY = TOP - RH - TH

	---------------- GRIP ----------------
	local gripColor, gripMat = d.Grip or metal, d.GripMat or metalMat
	if d.GripType == "T" then
		part("GripTop", Vector3.new(1.15, 0.26, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, 0), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
		part("ShaftTop", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.45, 0.18), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), d.Shaft or rgb(140, 90, 55), d.ShaftMat or WOOD)
		for s = -1, 1, 2 do part("GripCap", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(s * 0.6, 1.62, 0), trim, metalMat, mp) end
		if d.Wrap then part("GripWrap", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, 0), d.Wrap, SP) end
	else
		part("GripTop", Vector3.new(1.0, 0.24, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, 2.05, 0), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
		for s = -1, 1, 2 do
			part("GripSide", Vector3.new(0.22, 0.86, 0.26), CFrame.new(s * 0.25, 1.75, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.695), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
			part("GripCap", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame.new(s * 0.5, 2.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), trim, metalMat, mp)
		end
		if d.Wrap then part("GripWrap", Vector3.new(0.62, 0.3, 0.32), CFrame.new(0, 2.05, 0), d.Wrap, SP) end
	end
	part("TopCollar", Vector3.new(0.34, 0.3, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, 1.36, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	part("TopRing", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.07, 0.38), CFrame.new(0, 1.19, 0), accent, metalMat, mp)

	---------------- SHAFT ----------------
	local handle = part("Handle", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.72, 0.2), CFrame.new(0, 0.36, 0), d.Shaft or rgb(140, 90, 55), d.ShaftMat or WOOD, d.ShaftProps)
	if d.ShaftWrap then
		for _, y in ipairs({0.95, 0.72}) do part("ShaftWrap", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.14, 0.24), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), d.ShaftWrap, SP) end
	end
	if d.ShaftRings then
		for _, y in ipairs({0.45, 0.05}) do part("ShaftRing", Vector3.new(0.26, 0.07, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), accent, metalMat, mp) end
	end
	part("BottomCollar", Vector3.new(0.34, 0.26, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, -0.55, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	part("BottomRing", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.07, 0.38), CFrame.new(0, -0.39, 0), accent, metalMat, mp)
	part("Socket", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.26, 0.24), CFrame.new(0, -0.74, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	for _, z in ipairs(zf) do tri("SocketTaper", 0, -0.86, z, -PI / 2, 0.18, 0.32, 0.05, trim, metalMat, mp) end

	---------------- BLADE (high-poly, merged into meshes) ----------------
	local hw = W / 2
	local pts, bottom = outline(sh, hw, TOP)
	bottomY = bottom
	local H = TOP - bottom
	local dish = sh.Gem and 0 or (d.Dish or 0.1)
	local bulge = sh.Gem and 0.12 or 0
	-- depth of a decoration so it never touches the curved blade:
	-- side -1 = front, 1 = back; layer 0,1,2... = stacking order; xmin/xmax = the |x| range it covers
	local function surf(x) return dish * (x / hw) ^ 2 - bulge * (1 - math.min(math.abs(x), hw) / hw) end
	local function Z(side, layer, thick, xmin, xmax)
		local base = side < 0 and (surf(xmin or 0) - T / 2) or (surf(math.min(xmax or 0, hw)) + T / 2)
		return base + side * (0.015 + layer * 0.035 + thick / 2)
	end
	local keep = M
	-- main plate
	local tmp = Instance.new("Model")
	M = tmp
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do fillHalf(pts, s, hw, dish, sh.Gem and bulge or nil, T, bladeColor, bladeMat, "Blade", false) end
	-- beveled rim (slightly bigger, thinner, behind the plate)
	local rimTmp = Instance.new("Model")
	M = rimTmp
	local e = 0.08
	local rimPts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pts) do table.insert(rimPts, Vector2.new(p.X * (hw + e) / hw, TOP - 0.03 - (TOP - p.Y) * (H + e - 0.03) / H)) end
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do fillHalf(rimPts, s, hw + e, dish, nil, T * 0.55, edge, edgeMat, "BladeRim", true) end
	M = keep
	local blade = mergeInto(M, tmp, "Blade", bladeMat, bp)
	mergeInto(M, rimTmp, "BladeRim", edgeMat, nil)

	if sh.Gem then
		for _, s in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
			part("GemShine", Vector3.new(0.05, H * 0.55, 0.03), CFrame.new(-hw * 0.3, TOP - H * 0.35, Z(s, 1, 0.03, hw * 0.1, hw * 0.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.35), WHITE, NEON, {Transparency = 0.4})
		end
	else
		-- center ridge on both faces
		for _, s in ipairs({-1, 1}) do tri("Ridge", 0, TOP - 0.05, Z(s, 2, 0.05, 0, 0.12), -PI / 2, 0.12, H * 0.8, 0.05, ridge, bladeMat, {Transparency = bp.Transparency}) end
		-- foot treads on the shoulders
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			local x = s * (hw - 0.26)
			part("Tread", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.08, T + 0.12), CFrame.new(x, TOP - 0.03, dish * ((hw - 0.26) / hw) ^ 2), edge, edgeMat)
		end
	end

	---------------- DETAILS (layered, never touching another surface) ----------------
	local SIDES = {-1, 1}
	local edgeZ = surf(hw)
	local function rectY(f) return TOP - RH * f end
	if d.Rivets then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			part("RivetPlate", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.42, 0.04), CFrame.new(0, TOP - 0.2, Z(s, 0, 0.04, 0, 0.18)), trim, metalMat, mp)
			for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.09, TOP - 0.31}) do ball("Rivet", 0.12, Vector3.new(0, y, Z(s, 3, 0.12, 0, 0.06)), accent, metalMat) end
		end
	end
	if d.Bolts and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
				local x = W / 2 - 0.15
				for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.14, rectY(1) + 0.12}) do
					ball("Bolt", 0.12, Vector3.new(sx * x, y, Z(s, 3, 0.12, x - 0.06, x + 0.06)), d.BoltColor or accent, metalMat)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Plate and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			part("ArmorPlate", Vector3.new(W * 0.7, RH * 0.55, 0.04), CFrame.new(0, rectY(0.42), Z(s, 0, 0.04, 0, W * 0.35)), d.Plate, metalMat, mp)
		end
	end
	if d.Teeth or d.Spikes then
		local big = d.Spikes
		local th, h = big and 0.12 or 0.08, big and 0.32 or 0.15
		local col = d.SpikeColor or bladeColor
		local sideN = big and 2 or 3
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			for k = 1, sideN do
				local y = TOP - 0.1 - (RH - 0.16) * (k - 0.5) / sideN
				tri("Tooth", s * (hw + 0.02), y, edgeZ, s == 1 and 0 or PI, th, h, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
			end
			if TH > 0 then
				local ang = math.atan2(-(W / 2), s * TH)
				for _, t in ipairs(big and {0.35, 0.72} or {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}) do
					local x = hw * (1 - t)
					tri("Tooth", s * x, TOP - RH - TH * t, surf(x), ang, th, h, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
				end
			end
		end
		if big then
			tri("Spike", 0, bottomY + 0.05, 0, -PI / 2, 0.1, 0.4, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
			for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do tri("Spike", s * (hw - 0.06), TOP, edgeZ, PI / 2 + s * -0.6, 0.1, 0.35, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat) end
		end
	end
	if d.DoubleEdge then
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			tri("Prong", s * (hw + 0.02), TOP - RH + 0.08, edgeZ, -PI / 2 + s * 0.75, 0.14, 0.5, T * 0.9, edge, edgeMat)
		end
	end
	if d.Patina and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, p in ipairs({{-0.35, 0.3, 0.22, 0.16}, {0.3, 0.6, 0.18, 0.2}, {-0.1, 0.85, 0.15, 0.12}}) do
				local ax = math.abs(p[1])
				part("Patina", Vector3.new(p[3], p[4], 0.03), CFrame.new(p[1], rectY(p[2]), Z(s, 0, 0.03, math.max(0, ax - p[3] / 2), ax + p[3] / 2)), d.Patina, SAND)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Weave and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 0, 3 do for j = 0, 2 do
				if (i + j) % 2 == 0 then
					local x = -W / 2 + W / 8 + i * W / 4
					local ax = math.abs(x)
					part("Weave", Vector3.new(W / 4 - 0.05, RH / 3 - 0.05, 0.03), CFrame.new(x, TOP - RH / 6 - j * RH / 3, Z(s, 0, 0.03, math.max(0, ax - W / 8), ax + W / 8)), d.Weave, SP)
				end
			end end
		end
	end
	if d.Hazard and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 0, 5 do
				local x = -W / 2 + W / 12 + i * W / 6
				local ax = math.abs(x)
				part("Hazard", Vector3.new(W / 6, 0.16, 0.035), CFrame.new(x, TOP - 0.12, Z(s, 0, 0.035, math.max(0, ax - W / 12), ax + W / 12)),
					i % 2 == 0 and rgb(250, 200, 40) or rgb(25, 25, 25), SP)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Bands then
		local cols = d.Bands
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i, c in ipairs(cols) do
				part("Band", Vector3.new(W * 0.96, RH / #cols, 0.03), CFrame.new(0, TOP - RH / #cols * (i - 0.5), Z(s, 0, 0.03, 0, hw)), c, SP)
			end
			for k, c in ipairs(d.TipBands or {}) do
				local f = 1 - (k - 1) * 0.28
				tri("TipBand", 0, TOP - RH, Z(s, k, 0.03, 0, hw * f), -PI / 2, hw * 0.96 * f, TH * 0.95 * f, 0.03, c, SP)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Cracks then
		local rnd = Random.new(#d.Name * 7)
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 1, 7 do
				local y = TOP - 0.12 - rnd:NextNumber() * (RH + TH * 0.6)
				local maxX = (y > TOP - RH) and (hw - 0.18) or math.max(0.05, hw * (1 - (TOP - RH - y) / math.max(TH, 0.01)) - 0.18)
				local x = (rnd:NextNumber() * 2 - 1) * maxX
				local ax = math.abs(x)
				part("Crack", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.18 + rnd:NextNumber() * 0.22, 0.03), CFrame.new(x, y, Z(s, 1 + (i % 2), 0.03, math.max(0, ax - 0.2), ax + 0.2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rnd:NextNumber() * PI), d.Cracks, NEON)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Drips then
		for _, p in ipairs({{0, bottomY - 0.12, 0.16}, {hw + 0.03, TOP - RH * 0.8, 0.12}, {-hw - 0.03, TOP - RH * 0.5, 0.11}, {0.25, bottomY + 0.3, 0.1}}) do
			ball("Drip", p[3], Vector3.new(p[1], p[2], surf(p[1])), d.Drips, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.Runes then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.22, TOP - 0.47, TOP - 0.72}) do
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.03), CFrame.new(0, y, Z(s, 3, 0.03, 0, 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), d.Runes, NEON)
			end
			for _, sx in ipairs({1, -1}) do
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.3, 0.03), CFrame.new(sx * 0.34, TOP - 0.35, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0.25, 0.43)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, sx * 0.4), d.Runes, NEON)
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.22, 0.03), CFrame.new(sx * 0.3, TOP - 0.62, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0.22, 0.38)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -sx * 0.4), d.Runes, NEON)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Thorns then
		for i, y in ipairs({1.0, 0.6, 0.2, -0.2}) do
			spike("Thorn", CFrame.new(0, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, i * 2.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -PI / 2.6), 0.32, 0.1, d.Thorns, metalMat)
		end
	end
	if d.Core then
		local cy = sh.Gem and (TOP - 0.36) or (TOP - RH * 0.55)
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			ball("Core", 0.3, Vector3.new(0, cy, Z(s, 3, 0.3, 0, 0.15)), d.Core, NEON)
			if d.Trefoil then
				for k = 0, 2 do
					local a = k * 2 * PI / 3 + PI / 2
					part("Trefoil", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.26, 0.03), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.3, cy + math.sin(a) * 0.3, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0, 0.45)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a - PI / 2), d.Core, NEON)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Crystals then
		local col, mat = d.Crystals, d.CrystalMat or GLASS
		local cp = {Transparency = 0.1}
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.05), TOP - RH * 0.35, edgeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.0), 0.6, 0.2, col, mat, cp)
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.1), TOP - RH * 0.85, surf(hw - 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.35), 0.42, 0.15, col, mat, cp)
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * 0.18, -0.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.5), 0.45, 0.15, col, mat, cp)
		end
		if d.BigCrystals then
			for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
				spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * 0.1, 1.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.9), 0.55, 0.16, col, mat, cp)
				spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.1), TOP - RH * 0.6, surf(hw - 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.6), 0.75, 0.22, col, mat, cp)
			end
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(0, bottomY + 0.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(PI, 0, 0), 0.55, 0.2, col, mat, cp)
		end
	end
	if d.Icicles then
		for _, p in ipairs({{-hw + 0.05, TOP - RH, 0.35}, {hw - 0.05, TOP - RH, 0.3}, {0.12, -0.7, 0.28}, {-0.12, -0.7, 0.22}, {0.14, 1.15, 0.25}}) do
			local z = (p[2] < -0.72) and surf(p[1]) or 0
			spike("Icicle", CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], z) * CFrame.Angles(PI, 0, 0), p[3], 0.1, d.Icicles, ICE, {Transparency = 0.05})
		end
	end
	if d.Frost then
		for _, p in ipairs({{0, 1.44, 0.4, 0.14}, {0, -0.49, 0.41, 0.12}, {0.15, 2.19, 0.5, 0.1}, {0, 0.6, 0.27, 0.1}}) do
			part("Frost", Vector3.new(p[3], p[4], p[3]), CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], 0), d.Frost, SAND)
		end
	end
	if d.Wings then
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			for k = 0, 2 do
				part("Feather", Vector3.new(0.75 - k * 0.15, 0.2, 0.06 + k * 0.012), CFrame.new(s * (0.45 + k * 0.08), -0.58 - k * 0.14, k * 0.02) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s * (0.55 - k * 0.25)),
					d.Wings, SP)
			end
			part("WingTrim", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.07, 0.1), CFrame.new(s * 0.45, -0.48, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s * 0.55), trim, metalMat, mp)
		end
	end
	if d.Halo then
		for k = 0, 11 do
			local a = k * PI / 6
			part("Halo", Vector3.new(0.26, 0.07, 0.07), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.45, 2.55, math.sin(a) * 0.45) * CFrame.Angles(0, -a + PI / 2, 0), d.Halo, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.GripGem then
		for _, z in ipairs({-0.19, 0.19}) do
			part("GripGem", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 1.36, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), d.GripGem, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.Chunks then
		for _, p in ipairs({{hw + 0.35, TOP - 0.2, 0.28}, {-hw - 0.3, TOP - RH * 0.7, 0.22}, {0.2, bottomY - 0.35, 0.2}}) do
			part("RockChunk", Vector3.new(p[3], p[3] * 0.8, p[3]), CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], 0) * CFrame.Angles(0.5, 0.7, 0.3), d.Blade or metal, BASALT)
		end
	end

	---------------- FX ----------------
	if d.Glow then light(blade, d.Glow, d.GlowRange or 7) end
	for _, fx in ipairs(d.Particles or {}) do emitter(blade, fx[1], fx[2]) end

	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.Name = "Outline"
	hl.FillTransparency = 1
	hl.OutlineColor = BLACK
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
	hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	hl.Parent = M

	M.PrimaryPart = handle
	M.WorldPivot = handle.CFrame
	local built = M
	M = nil
	return built
end

function Builder.Build(onlyNames)
	local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local folder = RS:FindFirstChild("ShovelModels") or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ShovelModels"
	folder.Parent = RS
	local ok, fail = 0, {}
	local only
	if onlyNames then only = {} for _, n in ipairs(onlyNames) do only[n] = true end end
	for _, d in ipairs(Builder.DESIGNS) do
		if only and not only[d.Name] then continue end
		local good, res = pcall(build, d)
		if good then
			local old = folder:FindFirstChild(d.Name)
			if old then old:Destroy() end
			res.Parent = folder
			ok += 1
		else
			table.insert(fail, d.Name .. ": " .. tostring(res))
		end
	end
	return ok, fail
end

return Builder

-- SNOW FIELDS
-- Fields are placed in Studio as boxes inside Workspace > SnowFieldZones.
--   * Move / resize the box: the bottom of the box is the ground level of the field.
--   * Size is snapped to whole tiles (TileSize studs). Rotation is ignored (fields are axis-aligned).
--   * Attributes on the box: DisplayName, SnowPerPhase, RegrowSeconds.
-- When the game starts the server reads the boxes, removes them, and shares the field data with clients.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SnowFields = {}

SnowFields.TileSize = 3
SnowFields.MaxPhase = 3
-- tile look & heights come from ReplicatedStorage > SnowFieldStyles
SnowFields.Spinner = {Speed = 7, Inner = 1.0, Outer = 5.3} -- Speed MUST match the visual spin
SnowFields.Defaults = {SnowPerPhase = 1, RegrowSeconds = 8}

function SnowFields.Origin(f)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return f.Center - Vector3.new(f.Width * ts / 2, 0, f.Depth * ts / 2)
end

function SnowFields.TileCenter(f, x, z)
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	return SnowFields.Origin(f) + Vector3.new((x + 0.5) * ts, 0, (z + 0.5) * ts)
end

local function readZones()
	local list, used = {}, {}
	local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
	if not zones then return list end
	local ts = SnowFields.TileSize
	for i, z in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if z:IsA("BasePart") then
			local id = z.Name
			if used[id] then id = id .. "_" .. i end
			used[id] = true
			table.insert(list, {
				Id = id,
				Name = z:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or z.Name,
				Center = Vector3.new(z.Position.X, z.Position.Y - z.Size.Y / 2, z.Position.Z),
				Width = math.max(1, math.floor(z.Size.X / ts + 0.5)),
				Depth = math.max(1, math.floor(z.Size.Z / ts + 0.5)),
				SnowPerPhase = z:GetAttribute("SnowPerPhase") or SnowFields.Defaults.SnowPerPhase,
				RegrowSeconds = z:GetAttribute("RegrowSeconds") or SnowFields.Defaults.RegrowSeconds,
				Style = z:GetAttribute("Style") or "Default",
			})
		end
	end
	return list
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	SnowFields.Fields = readZones()
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "SnowFieldData"
		for _, f in ipairs(SnowFields.Fields) do
			local c = Instance.new("Configuration")
			c.Name = f.Id
			for k, v in pairs(f) do c:SetAttribute(k, v) end
			c.Parent = folder
		end
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild("SnowFieldZones")
		if zones then zones:Destroy() end
	end
else
	SnowFields.Fields = {}
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldData")
	for _, c in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(SnowFields.Fields, c:GetAttributes())
	end
end

return SnowFields

-- Admin console: F2 (or the ADMIN button) to open, type ;commands, Enter to run.
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local cmdEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AdminCommand")

local sg = script.Parent
local window = sg:WaitForChild("Window")
local log = window:WaitForChild("Log")
local box = window:WaitForChild("Input")
local order = 0
local history, hIndex = {}, 0

-- the toggle button lives in its own always-visible ScreenGui
local tg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
tg.Name = "AdminToggle"
tg.ResetOnSpawn = false
tg.DisplayOrder = 200
tg.Parent = sg.Parent
local toggleBtn = sg:WaitForChild("ToggleTemplate"):Clone()
toggleBtn.Name = "Toggle"
toggleBtn.Parent = tg

local function add(text, color)
	for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
		order += 1
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
		l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		l.TextSize = 15
		l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		l.TextColor3 = color
		l.Text = line
		l.LayoutOrder = order
		l.Parent = log
	end
	task.defer(function() log.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1e6) end)
end

local function toggle()
	sg.Enabled = not sg.Enabled
	if sg.Enabled then task.defer(function() box:CaptureFocus() end) end
end
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then toggle()
	elseif box:IsFocused() and #history > 0 then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then hIndex = math.max(1, hIndex - 1); box.Text = history[hIndex]
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then hIndex = math.min(#history + 1, hIndex + 1); box.Text = history[hIndex] or "" end
	end
end)
toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggle)

box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
	if not enter then return end
	local text = box.Text
	if text:gsub("%s", "") == "" then return end
	if text:sub(1, 1) ~= ";" then text = ";" .. text end
	table.insert(history, text)
	hIndex = #history + 1
	add("> " .. text, Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 200))
	cmdEvent:FireServer(text)
	box.Text = ""
	task.defer(function() box:CaptureFocus() end)
end)

cmdEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg, ok)
	add(msg, ok and Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 140) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
end)

add("Admin console ready. Type help and press Enter.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60))
